weekend.usageZh: 可数名词，表示“周末”。美式英语常用 on the weekend，英式英语常用 at the weekend。常与 spend、enjoy、plan 等动词搭配，也可作定语修饰名词，如 weekend trip。

examples.sentence: I play football with my dad on the weekend.
examples.trans: 我周末和爸爸一起踢足球。

examples.sentence: We are planning a short trip to the beach this weekend.
examples.trans: 我们计划这个周末去海边短途旅行。

examples.sentence: She spent the whole weekend preparing for the science competition.
examples.trans: 她花了整个周末准备科学竞赛。

examples.sentence: Having finished all his homework on Friday night, Tom was free to enjoy the rest of the weekend.
examples.trans: 周五晚上完成了所有作业后，汤姆就可以自由享受周末剩下的时间了。

examples.sentence: Rather than staying indoors all weekend, why not join the volunteer team cleaning up the riverbank?
examples.trans: 与其整个周末都待在室内，不如加入志愿者队伍去清理河岸吧？

examples.sentence: The survey indicates that students who reserve part of the weekend for reviewing notes tend to retain knowledge more effectively than those who leave everything until Sunday night.
examples.trans: 调查表明，那些在周末留出部分时间复习笔记的学生，往往比把所有内容都拖到周日晚上才处理的学生更能有效保持知识。

outing.usageZh: 可数名词，指短途出游、远足，通常为一天以内的休闲活动。常与 go on、have、plan、organize 等动词搭配，也可说 a family outing、a school outing。

examples.sentence: Our class is going on an outing to the zoo on Friday.
examples.trans: 我们班周五要去动物园出游。

examples.sentence: The weather was so nice that we decided to have a family outing in the park.
examples.trans: 天气太好了，我们决定全家去公园出游。

examples.sentence: The teacher reminded everyone to bring a hat and water for the outing to the Great Wall.
examples.trans: 老师提醒大家去长城出游时要带上帽子和水。

examples.sentence: Organizing an outing for thirty children requires careful attention to both safety and scheduling.
examples.trans: 为三十个孩子组织一次出游，需要同时仔细关注安全和时间安排。

examples.sentence: What made the outing truly memorable was not the destination itself, but the conversations we shared along the way.
examples.trans: 让这次出游真正难忘的不是目的地本身，而是我们一路上分享的对话。

examples.sentence: Given the unpredictable weather in the mountains, the school has postponed the annual spring outing until further notice.
examples.trans: 鉴于山区天气多变，学校已将一年一度的春游推迟，具体时间另行通知。

venue.usageZh: 可数名词，指举办活动的地点或场所，常用于体育、音乐、会议等语境。常与 book、change、choose 等动词搭配，也可被 perfect、ideal、suitable 等形容词修饰。

examples.sentence: The party venue is near my house, so I can walk there.
examples.trans: 聚会地点在我家附近，所以我可以走过去。

examples.sentence: We need to find a bigger venue because too many people want to come to the concert.
examples.trans: 我们需要找一个更大的场地，因为想来听音乐会的人太多了。

examples.sentence: The museum was chosen as the venue for the city's annual art exhibition.
examples.trans: 博物馆被选为这座城市年度艺术展的举办场所。

examples.sentence: After comparing several options, the committee finally settled on a venue that could accommodate over five hundred guests.
examples.trans: 在比较了几个方案后，委员会最终选定了一个能容纳五百多位来宾的场地。

examples.sentence: The original venue having been flooded, the organizers had no choice but to relocate the conference to a hotel downtown.
examples.trans: 由于原定场地被淹，组织者别无选择，只能把会议转移到市中心的一家酒店。

examples.sentence: A venue that combines convenient transport links, sufficient parking, and flexible indoor spaces is often the deciding factor in attracting large-scale events.
examples.trans: 一个兼具便利交通、充足停车位和灵活室内空间的场地，往往是吸引大型活动的决定性因素。

select.usageZh: 动词，意为“选择；挑选”，强调从多个选项中认真挑选。常见搭配有 select from（从……中选择）、select as（选为）、be selected for（被选中参加）。可用于主动和被动语态，书面语和口语均可使用。

examples.sentence: Please select a book from the shelf.
examples.trans: 请从书架上选一本书。

examples.sentence: You can select your favorite color for the new school bag.
examples.trans: 你可以为新书包选择你最喜欢的颜色。

examples.sentence: The coach will select three players to join the school team.
examples.trans: 教练将选出三名队员加入校队。

examples.sentence: After comparing all the applications, the committee selected the most qualified candidate for the position.
examples.trans: 在比较了所有申请之后，委员会选出了最符合条件的人选担任该职位。

examples.sentence: Rather than selecting the cheapest option, the company chose the supplier with the most reliable delivery record.
examples.trans: 该公司没有选择最便宜的方案，而是选择了交货记录最可靠的供应商。

examples.sentence: Participants are randomly selected from a national database, ensuring that the survey results reflect a broad cross-section of the population.
examples.trans: 参与者从全国数据库中随机抽取，确保调查结果能反映广泛的人口截面。

trampoline.usageZh: 可数名词，意为“蹦床”。常见搭配有 jump on a trampoline（在蹦床上跳）、bounce on a trampoline（在蹦床上弹跳）、trampoline park（蹦床公园）。注意介词用 on 而不是 in。

examples.sentence: My little brother loves jumping on the trampoline in the garden.
examples.trans: 我弟弟喜欢在花园里的蹦床上跳。

examples.sentence: We went to a trampoline park last weekend and bounced for two hours.
examples.trans: 上周末我们去了蹦床公园，弹跳了两个小时。

examples.sentence: Before using the trampoline, make sure there is a safety net around it.
examples.trans: 使用蹦床前，确保周围有安全网。

examples.sentence: Having practiced on the trampoline for years, she was able to perform a perfect double somersault in the competition.
examples.trans: 经过多年在蹦床上的练习，她在比赛中完成了一个完美的空翻两周。

examples.sentence: Unlike running on hard ground, bouncing on a trampoline reduces the impact on your knees while still providing an intense cardiovascular workout.
examples.trans: 与在硬地面上跑步不同，在蹦床上弹跳能减轻对膝盖的冲击，同时仍能提供高强度的有氧锻炼。

examples.sentence: The rehabilitation program incorporates trampoline exercises to help patients regain balance and coordination after lower-limb injuries.
examples.trans: 该康复项目融入了蹦床练习，帮助下肢受伤的患者恢复平衡能力和协调性。

heaven.usageZh: 名词，通常用单数，意为“天堂；极乐世界”。常见搭配有 be in heaven（处于极乐之中）、like heaven（如同天堂）、a slice of heaven（一片乐土）。也可用于感叹，如 Good heavens!（天哪！）。

examples.sentence: After the long walk, a cold drink felt like heaven.
examples.trans: 走了很长的路之后，一杯冷饮感觉就像天堂一样。

examples.sentence: For my cat, lying in the warm sun is heaven.
examples.trans: 对我的猫来说，躺在温暖的阳光下就是天堂。

examples.sentence: When the exam was finally over, the summer holiday felt like heaven to all of us.
examples.trans: 考试终于结束时，暑假对我们所有人来说就像天堂一样。

examples.sentence: After months of eating instant noodles in the dormitory, a home-cooked meal was nothing less than heaven.
examples.trans: 在宿舍吃了几个月方便面之后，一顿家常便饭简直无异于天堂。

examples.sentence: To an exhausted hiker who has been walking in the rain for hours, a dry cabin with a fireplace is the closest thing to heaven on earth.
examples.trans: 对于在雨中跋涉了数小时、筋疲力尽的徒步者来说，一间带壁炉的干燥小屋就是人间最接近天堂的地方。

examples.sentence: Nestled between snow-capped peaks and a crystal-clear lake, the remote village offers visitors a little heaven untouched by the noise of modern life.
examples.trans: 坐落在雪山和清澈湖泊之间的偏远村庄，为游客提供了一小片未被现代生活喧嚣侵扰的天堂。

packed.usageZh: 形容词，表示“挤满的；塞满的”。常与 with 搭配，如 packed with people/activities，表示“挤满了人或活动”。口语和书面语都常用，描述场所、日程或容器。

examples.sentence: The bus is packed with students every morning.
examples.trans: 每天早上公交车都挤满了学生。

examples.sentence: My bag is packed with books and snacks for the trip.
examples.trans: 我的包里塞满了旅行用的书和零食。

examples.sentence: The small restaurant was packed with people waiting for a table.
examples.trans: 这家小餐馆挤满了等位的人。

examples.sentence: Her schedule is packed with meetings, so she has little time for lunch.
examples.trans: 她的日程排满了会议，所以几乎没有时间吃午饭。

examples.sentence: The stadium was packed to capacity, with fans waving flags and singing together.
examples.trans: 体育场座无虚席，球迷们挥舞着旗帜一起唱歌。

examples.sentence: The exhibition hall was so packed that visitors could barely move between the display stands.
examples.trans: 展厅拥挤不堪，参观者几乎无法在展台之间移动。

dull.usageZh: 形容词，表示“无聊的；乏味的”。常修饰 moment、lecture、job、weather 等名词。口语中也可表示“钝的”或“阴沉的”，但本词表侧重“乏味”义。

examples.sentence: The movie was dull, so I fell asleep halfway.
examples.trans: 这部电影很无聊，所以我看到一半就睡着了。

examples.sentence: He found the rainy afternoon dull and stayed in his room.
examples.trans: 他觉得那个下雨的下午很无聊，就待在房间里。

examples.sentence: The textbook is dull, but the teacher makes the lessons interesting.
examples.trans: 课本很枯燥，但老师把课讲得很有趣。

examples.sentence: Working on the same task every day can become dull after a while.
examples.trans: 每天做同样的工作，过一段时间就会变得乏味。

examples.sentence: Although the plot seemed dull at first, the final chapter turned out to be surprisingly powerful.
examples.trans: 虽然情节起初显得平淡，但最后一章却出人意料地有力。

examples.sentence: A dull presentation not only fails to inform the audience but also weakens the speaker's credibility.
examples.trans: 一场乏味的展示不仅无法向听众传递信息，还会削弱演讲者的可信度。

interconnected.usageZh: 形容词，表示“互相连接的；相互关联的”。常用于描述系统、网络、经济、生态等抽象或具体事物。常见搭配：highly interconnected、interconnected systems。

examples.sentence: The two rooms are interconnected by a small door.
examples.trans: 这两个房间通过一扇小门相连。

examples.sentence: All the computers in our school are interconnected.
examples.trans: 我们学校所有的电脑都是互相连接的。

examples.sentence: The lakes are interconnected by a series of narrow rivers.
examples.trans: 这些湖泊由一系列狭窄的河流相互连通。

examples.sentence: Modern cities depend on interconnected transport systems to keep people moving.
examples.trans: 现代城市依赖相互连接的交通系统来保持人员流动。

examples.sentence: The global supply chain is so interconnected that a single port closure can affect multiple industries.
examples.trans: 全球供应链紧密相连，一个港口关闭就可能影响多个行业。

examples.sentence: Climate change, food security, and public health are deeply interconnected issues that require coordinated solutions.
examples.trans: 气候变化、粮食安全和公共卫生是深度关联的问题，需要协调一致的解决方案。

surface.usageZh: 可数名词，意为“表面；外表”。常与形容词连用，如 smooth、hard、soft、flat。也可作动词，表示“浮出水面；显露”。常见搭配：on the surface（表面上）、below/beneath the surface（在表面之下）。

family.meaning: 有表面的；经过表面处理的

examples.sentence: The surface of the desk is very smooth.
examples.trans: 这张桌子的表面非常光滑。

examples.sentence: Leaves floated on the surface of the lake.
examples.trans: 树叶漂浮在湖面上。

examples.sentence: The road surface became so icy that cars could hardly move.
examples.trans: 路面结了很厚的冰，汽车几乎无法行驶。

examples.sentence: Although he seemed calm on the surface, he was actually quite nervous inside.
examples.trans: 虽然他表面上看起来很平静，但内心其实非常紧张。

examples.sentence: The diver surfaced only after staying underwater for nearly three minutes.
examples.trans: 那名潜水员在水下待了近三分钟后才浮出水面。

examples.sentence: Beneath the surface of the seemingly peaceful village lay a long history of conflict and hardship.
examples.trans: 在这个看似平静的村庄表面之下，隐藏着漫长的冲突与苦难历史。

awkward.usageZh: 形容词，意为“尴尬的；笨拙的；难处理的”。可修饰 situation、silence、moment、movement 等名词。常见搭配：awkward silence（尴尬的沉默）、awkward position（尴尬的处境）、feel awkward（感到不自在）。

examples.sentence: I felt awkward when I dropped my lunch in front of everyone.
examples.trans: 当我在大家面前把午饭掉在地上时，我感到很尴尬。

examples.sentence: The new student gave an awkward smile and looked down at his shoes.
examples.trans: 那个新学生尴尬地笑了笑，然后低头看着自己的鞋子。

examples.sentence: He tried to carry the big box by himself, but it was too awkward to hold.
examples.trans: 他试图一个人搬那个大箱子，但箱子太难拿了。

examples.sentence: Having to explain the mistake to her boss put her in an extremely awkward position.
examples.trans: 不得不向老板解释那个错误让她陷入了极其尴尬的境地。

examples.sentence: The conversation became increasingly awkward once they realized they had completely opposite views on the matter.
examples.trans: 一旦他们意识到彼此在这个问题上观点完全相反，谈话就变得越来越尴尬。

examples.sentence: The interviewer's deliberately awkward questions were designed to test how candidates would handle pressure and uncertainty.
examples.trans: 面试官故意提出的刁钻问题，旨在测试应聘者如何应对压力和不确定性。

express.usageZh: 及物动词，意为“表达；表示”。常接名词或从句作宾语，如 express one's feelings/opinions/thanks。也可接反身代词 express oneself，表示“表达自己的想法”。名词形式为 expression。

examples.sentence: She wrote a card to express her thanks to the nurse.
examples.trans: 她写了一张卡片向那位护士表达感谢。

examples.sentence: He finds it hard to express his feelings in front of his parents.
examples.trans: 他觉得在父母面前表达自己的感受很难。

examples.sentence: The artist used bright colors to express her love for the seaside town.
examples.trans: 那位画家用明亮的色彩表达了她对这座海滨小镇的热爱。

examples.sentence: Learning to express yourself confidently is an essential skill in both academic and social life.
examples.trans: 学会自信地表达自己是学术和社交生活中一项必不可少的技能。

examples.sentence: Rather than expressing his disagreement directly, he chose to remain silent and observe the discussion.
examples.trans: 他没有直接表达自己的不同意见，而是选择保持沉默并观察讨论。

examples.sentence: The report expresses serious concerns about the long-term effects of the policy on rural communities.
examples.trans: 该报告对该政策对农村社区的长期影响表达了严重关切。

athletic.usageZh: 形容词，常用来形容人身体强壮、擅长运动，或描述与运动相关的能力、体格。常见搭配有 athletic build（健壮的体格）、athletic ability（运动能力）、athletic shoes（运动鞋）。口语和书面语均可使用。

examples.sentence: My brother is very athletic and runs fast.
examples.trans: 我哥哥很健壮，跑得很快。

examples.sentence: She joined the school team because she is athletic and loves sports.
examples.trans: 她加入了校队，因为她擅长运动并且热爱体育。

examples.sentence: Although he looks thin, he is surprisingly athletic and can lift heavy weights.
examples.trans: 虽然他看起来很瘦，但他出人意料地强壮，能举起很重的东西。

examples.sentence: Having an athletic body requires not only regular training but also a balanced diet.
examples.trans: 拥有健壮的体格不仅需要规律的训练，还需要均衡的饮食。

examples.sentence: Unlike his brother, who prefers reading indoors, Tom is far more athletic and spends most weekends hiking or swimming.
examples.trans: 与他喜欢在室内读书的哥哥不同，汤姆要健壮得多，大部分周末都去远足或游泳。

examples.sentence: The scholarship is awarded to students who demonstrate both outstanding academic performance and exceptional athletic ability.
examples.trans: 该奖学金授予那些学业成绩优异且运动能力出众的学生。

gymnastics.usageZh: 不可数名词，通常作单数使用，指体操运动或体操训练。常见搭配有 do gymnastics（做体操）、gymnastics competition（体操比赛）、rhythmic gymnastics（艺术体操）。

examples.sentence: My sister does gymnastics every Saturday morning.
examples.trans: 我姐姐每周六早上练体操。

examples.sentence: Gymnastics helps children become stronger and more flexible.
examples.trans: 体操帮助孩子们变得更强壮、更灵活。

examples.sentence: She won first prize in the gymnastics competition because she practiced every day.
examples.trans: 她在体操比赛中获得了一等奖，因为她每天都练习。

examples.sentence: To excel in gymnastics, one must develop both physical strength and mental focus from an early age.
examples.trans: 要想在体操方面出类拔萃，必须从小培养身体力量和精神专注力。

examples.sentence: While gymnastics demands extreme flexibility, it is the precision of each movement that truly separates champions from ordinary athletes.
examples.trans: 虽然体操要求极高的柔韧性，但真正区分冠军与普通运动员的是每个动作的精准度。

examples.sentence: The documentary reveals how years of rigorous gymnastics training shaped her discipline, resilience, and pursuit of perfection.
examples.trans: 这部纪录片揭示了多年的严格体操训练如何塑造了她的自律、韧性和对完美的追求。

land.usageZh: 动词，意为"着陆；降落"，可指飞机、鸟类、昆虫或人从空中落到地面。常见搭配有 land safely（安全着陆）、land on one's feet（安然脱险；化险为夷）、make a smooth landing（平稳着陆）。也可引申为"获得（机会、工作等）"。

examples.sentence: The bird landed on the tree near our window.
examples.trans: 那只鸟落在了我们窗户附近的树上。

examples.sentence: The plane landed safely at the airport despite the heavy rain.
examples.trans: 尽管下着大雨，飞机还是安全降落在了机场。

examples.sentence: When the cat jumped off the table, it landed softly on the carpet.
examples.trans: 猫从桌子上跳下来时，轻轻地落在了地毯上。

examples.sentence: After months of searching, she finally landed a job at a well-known technology company.
examples.trans: 经过几个月的寻找，她终于在一家知名科技公司找到了一份工作。

examples.sentence: The spacecraft landed on the surface of Mars, marking a historic moment in space exploration.
examples.trans: 航天器降落在火星表面，标志着太空探索的历史性时刻。

examples.sentence: Despite the fierce competition, the young entrepreneur landed a major contract that secured the future of her startup.
examples.trans: 尽管竞争激烈，这位年轻的企业家还是拿到了一份重要的合同，确保了她创业公司的未来。

court.usageZh: 可数名词，常与运动名称连用，如 basketball court（篮球场）、tennis court（网球场）。也可指法庭，常见搭配 go to court（打官司）、in court（出庭）。

examples.sentence: The boys are playing basketball on the court.
examples.trans: 男孩们正在球场上打篮球。

examples.sentence: Our school has a new tennis court behind the library.
examples.trans: 我们学校图书馆后面有一个新的网球场。

examples.sentence: The witness was asked to describe what she saw in court.
examples.trans: 证人被要求在法庭上描述她所看到的情况。

examples.sentence: Having played on this court for years, he knows exactly how the ball bounces near the baseline.
examples.trans: 在这片球场打了多年球，他非常清楚球在底线附近的弹跳情况。

examples.sentence: The court ruled that the company had failed to protect its workers from harmful chemicals.
examples.trans: 法院裁定该公司未能保护工人免受有害化学品的伤害。

examples.sentence: While the public rarely sees what happens inside a courtroom, the decisions made there can reshape entire industries.
examples.trans: 尽管公众很少看到法庭内发生的事，但那里做出的裁决可能重塑整个行业。

perfect.usageZh: 作动词时意为"使完美、完善"，后接直接宾语，如 perfect a skill（完善技能）、perfect a technique（完善技术）。注意与形容词 perfect（完美的）区分，动词重音在第二音节。

examples.sentence: She practices hard to perfect her dance moves.
examples.trans: 她努力练习来完善她的舞蹈动作。

examples.sentence: He spent the whole summer perfecting his swimming skills.
examples.trans: 他花了整个夏天来完善他的游泳技能。

examples.sentence: The chef traveled to Italy to perfect his pasta-making technique.
examples.trans: 这位厨师前往意大利完善他的意面制作技术。

examples.sentence: To perfect her pronunciation, she recorded herself speaking and compared it with native speakers.
examples.trans: 为了完善发音，她录下自己的朗读并与母语者进行对比。

examples.sentence: Rather than rushing to release the product, the team spent an extra month perfecting the user interface.
examples.trans: 团队没有急于发布产品，而是多花了一个月时间完善用户界面。

examples.sentence: Scientists spent decades perfecting the vaccine, knowing that even a minor flaw could undermine public trust.
examples.trans: 科学家们花了数十年时间完善这种疫苗，因为他们知道即使微小的缺陷也可能削弱公众信任。

option.usageZh: 可数名词，常与 have、choose、select、offer 等动词搭配。常见结构：have the option of doing sth（有做某事的选择）、a viable option（一个可行的选择）。

examples.sentence: We have two options for lunch: noodles or rice.
examples.trans: 我们午餐有两个选择：面条或米饭。

examples.sentence: Taking the train is a cheaper option than flying.
examples.trans: 坐火车是比坐飞机更便宜的选择。

examples.sentence: If you want to save money, cooking at home is always a good option.
examples.trans: 如果你想省钱，在家做饭总是一个好选择。

examples.sentence: Given the heavy traffic, cycling to work has become a more attractive option for many commuters.
examples.trans: 考虑到交通拥堵，骑自行车上班已成为许多通勤者更有吸引力的选择。

examples.sentence: The university offers students the option of studying abroad for a semester without delaying graduation.
examples.trans: 这所大学为学生提供出国学习一学期而不推迟毕业的选择。

examples.sentence: When traditional treatments failed, the patient was left with no option but to participate in the experimental trial.
examples.trans: 当传统疗法失败后，这位患者别无选择，只能参加这项实验性试验。

gathering.usageZh: 可数名词，表示“聚会、聚集”。常与 family, social, small, large 等形容词搭配，也可用于正式或非正式场合。口语和书面语都常见，注意不要与动名词 gathering（正在聚集）混淆。

examples.sentence: We have a family gathering every Spring Festival.
examples.trans: 我们每年春节都有一个家庭聚会。

examples.sentence: The school organized a small gathering for new students to meet each other.
examples.trans: 学校为新生组织了一个小型聚会，让他们互相认识。

examples.sentence: After the ceremony, there was a gathering in the hall where people shared their stories.
examples.trans: 仪式结束后，大厅里有一个聚会，人们在那里分享自己的故事。

examples.sentence: The annual gathering of science teachers provides a valuable opportunity to exchange teaching methods.
examples.trans: 一年一度的科学教师聚会提供了一个交流教学方法的宝贵机会。

examples.sentence: Unlike formal conferences, a casual gathering often encourages more honest and open discussion.
examples.trans: 与正式会议不同，轻松的聚会往往能鼓励更诚实和开放的讨论。

examples.sentence: The community gathering, originally planned as a simple celebration, evolved into a platform for residents to voice concerns about local development.
examples.trans: 这场社区聚会原本只是一场简单的庆祝活动，后来演变成了居民就当地发展问题表达关切的平台。

memorable.usageZh: 形容词，表示“值得纪念的、难忘的”。常修饰 experience, trip, day, moment, event 等名词。语气比 unforgettable 稍弱，但更常用于日常表达。

examples.sentence: My first day at school was a memorable day.
examples.trans: 我上学的第一天是难忘的一天。

examples.sentence: The class trip to the science museum was a memorable experience for everyone.
examples.trans: 去科学博物馆的班级旅行对每个人来说都是一次难忘的经历。

examples.sentence: The speech she gave at the graduation ceremony was so powerful that it became the most memorable moment of the day.
examples.trans: 她在毕业典礼上的演讲非常有力量，成了当天最令人难忘的时刻。

examples.sentence: What makes a lesson truly memorable is not the amount of information delivered, but the emotional connection it creates.
examples.trans: 真正让一堂课令人难忘的，不是传递了多少信息，而是它建立的情感联系。

examples.sentence: A memorable photograph captures not just a scene, but the atmosphere and emotions that surrounded it.
examples.trans: 一张令人难忘的照片捕捉到的不仅是场景，还有围绕它的氛围和情感。

examples.sentence: The most memorable characters in literature are rarely flawless; rather, their struggles and contradictions make them profoundly human.
examples.trans: 文学中最令人难忘的人物很少是完美无缺的；相反，正是他们的挣扎与矛盾使他们具有深刻的人性。

devices.usageZh: 可数名词，常用复数形式。表示“设备、装置”，常与 electronic, digital, mobile, smart, internet-connected 等形容词搭配。注意 device 也可表示“手段、策略”，但此处为“设备”义。

examples.sentence: My father has many electronic devices at home.
examples.trans: 我爸爸家里有很多电子设备。

examples.sentence: Students should turn off their mobile devices before the exam starts.
examples.trans: 考试开始前，学生应该关掉他们的移动设备。

examples.sentence: Many families now use smart devices to control lights and temperature at home.
examples.trans: 许多家庭现在使用智能设备来控制家里的灯光和温度。

examples.sentence: The increasing number of internet-connected devices in homes has raised concerns about data privacy.
examples.trans: 家庭中联网设备数量的增加引发了人们对数据隐私的担忧。

examples.sentence: While wearable devices offer convenient health tracking, their accuracy varies significantly depending on the brand and model.
examples.trans: 虽然可穿戴设备提供了便捷的健康追踪功能，但其准确性因品牌和型号的不同而差异很大。

examples.sentence: The integration of AI-powered devices into daily life has transformed not only how we communicate, but also how we perceive the boundary between work and leisure.
examples.trans: 人工智能驱动的设备融入日常生活，不仅改变了我们的沟通方式，也改变了我们对工作与休闲界限的认知。

communication.usageZh: 不可数名词，常与动词 allow、improve、facilitate 搭配，表示“促进/改善沟通”。后可接 with（与某人）或 between（在两者之间）。口语和书面语都常用，正式场合可搭配 effective、clear、open 等形容词。

examples.sentence: My mom and I have good communication every day.
examples.trans: 我和妈妈每天都有很好的交流。

examples.sentence: Text messages are a quick way of communication between friends.
examples.trans: 短信是朋友之间一种快速的交流方式。

examples.sentence: Clear communication with your teachers helps you understand the lessons better.
examples.trans: 与老师清晰地沟通有助于你更好地理解课程内容。

examples.sentence: Effective communication requires not only speaking clearly but also listening carefully.
examples.trans: 有效的沟通不仅需要表达清晰，还需要认真倾听。

examples.sentence: Unlike face-to-face communication, online messages often lack tone and body language.
examples.trans: 与面对面交流不同，网络信息往往缺少语气和肢体语言。

examples.sentence: The breakdown of communication between the two departments led to a costly delay in the project.
examples.trans: 两个部门之间沟通的中断导致了项目代价高昂的延误。

delay.usageZh: 可作名词和动词。作名词时常与 long、short、two-hour、unexpected 等形容词连用，表示“延误/耽搁的时间”。作动词时可接动名词，如 delay doing sth（推迟做某事）。交通、航班、项目等场景中非常常用。

examples.sentence: The bus had a short delay because of the rain.
examples.trans: 因为下雨，公交车短暂延误了。

examples.sentence: We waited at the airport for an hour because of the flight delay.
examples.trans: 由于航班延误，我们在机场等了一个小时。

examples.sentence: If there is any delay in the plan, please let me know as soon as possible.
examples.trans: 如果计划有任何延误，请尽快告诉我。

examples.sentence: The construction work was delayed by heavy rain, which pushed the opening date back by two weeks.
examples.trans: 施工因大雨而延误，导致开放日期推迟了两周。

examples.sentence: Although the train was delayed for nearly an hour, the passengers remained remarkably calm.
examples.trans: 尽管火车延误了近一个小时，乘客们仍然出奇地平静。

examples.sentence: Repeated delays in the supply chain forced the company to reconsider its overseas manufacturing strategy.
examples.trans: 供应链中反复出现的延误迫使该公司重新考虑其海外制造战略。

objectively.usageZh: 副词，表示“客观地”，常置于句首或动词前，用来引出基于事实而非个人感受的判断。常见搭配有 objectively speaking、look at sth objectively、assess objectively。正式书面语和议论文中尤为常见。

examples.sentence: It is hard to judge your own work objectively.
examples.trans: 客观地评价自己的作品很难。

examples.sentence: Try to look at the problem objectively before you make a decision.
examples.trans: 在做决定之前，试着客观地看待这个问题。

examples.sentence: Objectively speaking, the new plan saves more time than the old one.
examples.trans: 客观地说，新计划比旧计划更节省时间。

examples.sentence: To evaluate the experiment objectively, the researchers removed all personal bias from the data analysis.
examples.trans: 为了客观地评估实验，研究人员在数据分析中排除了所有个人偏见。

examples.sentence: Objectively, the evidence supports neither side of the argument, which makes the case even harder to resolve.
examples.trans: 客观地说，证据既不支持争论的任何一方，这使得案件更难解决。

examples.sentence: A historian must strive to interpret events objectively, even when the available records are incomplete or contradictory.
examples.trans: 历史学家必须努力客观地解读事件，即使现有记录不完整或相互矛盾。

average.usageZh: 可作名词或形容词。作名词时常与 on、an、the 搭配，表示“平均数”；作形容词时修饰名词，表示“普通的、平均的”。口语和书面语都常用，中考常考“on average”和“the average of”。

examples.sentence: My brother sleeps eight hours a day on average.
examples.trans: 我哥哥平均每天睡八个小时。

examples.sentence: The average score of our class went up by five points this term.
examples.trans: 这学期我们班的平均分提高了五分。

examples.sentence: If you walk at an average speed, you will reach the station in about twenty minutes.
examples.trans: 如果你以平均速度步行，大约二十分钟后就能到达车站。

examples.sentence: Compared with last year, the average amount of time teenagers spend on short videos has increased sharply.
examples.trans: 与去年相比，青少年花在短视频上的平均时长急剧增加。

examples.sentence: An average reader may finish the novel in three days, whereas a careful reader will take at least a week to absorb its details.
examples.trans: 普通读者可能三天读完这本小说，而细心的读者至少要花一周才能消化其中的细节。

examples.sentence: Although the average income in this region has risen steadily, the gap between the rich and the poor remains a pressing concern.
examples.trans: 尽管该地区的平均收入稳步上升，贫富差距仍然是一个紧迫的问题。

promises.usageZh: 动词，常见搭配为 promises + 名词，表示“预示、有…的希望”；也可表示“承诺做某事”，后接不定式。作“预示”讲时多用于肯定句，主语常为事物或现象。

examples.sentence: The dark clouds promise rain this afternoon.
examples.trans: 乌云预示着今天下午会下雨。

examples.sentence: Her hard work promises a bright future in music.
examples.trans: 她的努力预示着在音乐方面会有光明的前途。

examples.sentence: The new medicine promises a quicker recovery for patients with this illness.
examples.trans: 这种新药有望让患有这种疾病的病人更快康复。

examples.sentence: The discovery of the ancient site promises to change our understanding of early trade routes.
examples.trans: 这一古代遗址的发现有望改变我们对早期贸易路线的理解。

examples.sentence: While the policy promises immediate economic growth, its long-term effects on the environment remain uncertain.
examples.trans: 尽管该政策有望带来即时的经济增长，但其对环境的长期影响仍不确定。

examples.sentence: The newly developed material promises both higher durability and lower production costs, making it a strong candidate for industrial use.
examples.trans: 这种新开发的材料兼具更高的耐用性和更低的生产成本，使其成为工业应用的有力候选材料。

artificial.usageZh: 形容词，通常放在名词前，表示“人工的、人造的”，与 natural 相对。常见搭配有 artificial intelligence、artificial light、artificial flowers 等。正式和非正式语境均可使用。

examples.sentence: These artificial flowers look very real.
examples.trans: 这些人造花看起来非常逼真。

examples.sentence: The room has no windows, so we use artificial light all day.
examples.trans: 这个房间没有窗户，所以我们整天使用人工照明。

examples.sentence: Artificial intelligence is changing the way people search for information.
examples.trans: 人工智能正在改变人们搜索信息的方式。

examples.sentence: Many athletes avoid drinks with artificial colors because they prefer natural ingredients.
examples.trans: 许多运动员避免饮用含有人工色素的饮料，因为他们更喜欢天然成分。

examples.sentence: Although artificial snow allows ski resorts to operate earlier, it cannot fully replace the quality of natural snowfall.
examples.trans: 尽管人造雪能让滑雪场更早营业，但它无法完全替代天然降雪的质量。

examples.sentence: The growing reliance on artificial intelligence in medical diagnosis has raised both hopes for accuracy and concerns about accountability.
examples.trans: 医疗诊断中对人工智能日益增长的依赖既带来了对准确性的期待，也引发了对责任归属的担忧。

intelligence.usageZh: 不可数名词。常见搭配：artificial intelligence (AI) 人工智能；intelligence test 智力测验；military intelligence 军事情报。表示“智力”时侧重学习、理解和逻辑思考的能力，比 cleverness 更正式。

examples.sentence: My dog shows great intelligence when he opens the door by himself.
examples.trans: 我的狗自己开门时表现出很高的智力。

examples.sentence: Playing chess is a good way to exercise your intelligence and patience.
examples.trans: 下棋是锻炼智力和耐心的好方法。

examples.sentence: Although the robot looks simple, its intelligence allows it to answer many different questions.
examples.trans: 虽然这个机器人看起来很简单，但它的智能使它能够回答许多不同的问题。

examples.sentence: Researchers are studying whether emotional intelligence can be improved through regular practice.
examples.trans: 研究人员正在研究情商是否可以通过定期练习来提高。

examples.sentence: Unlike physical strength, intelligence does not decline simply because a person grows older.
examples.trans: 与体力不同，智力并不会仅仅因为人变老而下降。

examples.sentence: The rapid development of artificial intelligence has forced educators to rethink what skills students truly need for the future.
examples.trans: 人工智能的快速发展迫使教育者重新思考学生未来真正需要什么技能。

symbol.usageZh: 可数名词。常见搭配：a symbol of peace/hope/freedom 和平/希望/自由的象征；chemical symbol 化学符号；status symbol 地位的象征。动词形式为 symbolize，表示“象征、代表”。

examples.sentence: The heart shape is a symbol of love all over the world.
examples.trans: 心形在全世界都是爱的象征。

examples.sentence: In chemistry class, we learned that O is the symbol for oxygen.
examples.trans: 在化学课上，我们学到了O是氧的符号。

examples.sentence: The red lantern has become a symbol of Chinese New Year celebrations in many countries.
examples.trans: 红灯笼在许多国家已经成为中国新年庆祝活动的象征。

examples.sentence: Wearing a white dress on her wedding day is a symbol of purity in her culture.
examples.trans: 在她的文化中，婚礼当天穿白色礼服是纯洁的象征。

examples.sentence: The old bridge, once a symbol of the town's industrial past, now serves mainly as a tourist attraction.
examples.trans: 这座老桥曾经是该镇工业历史的象征，现在主要作为旅游景点。

examples.sentence: For many citizens, the restoration of the ancient library was not merely a construction project but a symbol of the city's commitment to preserving its cultural heritage.
examples.trans: 对许多市民来说，修复这座古老的图书馆不仅仅是一个建筑工程，更是这座城市致力于保护文化遗产的象征。

massive.usageZh: 形容词。强调规模、数量或程度非常大，比 big 或 large 语气更强。常见搭配：massive amounts of data 海量数据；massive investment 巨额投资；massive changes 巨大变化；a massive heart attack 大面积心肌梗死。

examples.sentence: A massive elephant walked slowly across the road in front of our car.
examples.trans: 一头巨大的大象在我们车前慢慢地走过马路。

examples.sentence: The storm caused massive damage to the small fishing village last night.
examples.trans: 昨晚的暴风雨给这个小渔村造成了巨大的破坏。

examples.sentence: Because of the massive traffic jam, we arrived at the airport two hours late.
examples.trans: 由于严重的交通堵塞，我们晚了两个小时到达机场。

examples.sentence: The government launched a massive campaign to encourage young people to take up sports.
examples.trans: 政府发起了一场大规模的运动，鼓励年轻人参加体育运动。

examples.sentence: Despite massive public opposition, the city council voted to approve the construction of the new highway.
examples.trans: 尽管公众强烈反对，市议会还是投票批准了新公路的建设。

examples.sentence: The massive shift toward online learning during the pandemic has permanently altered the landscape of higher education.
examples.trans: 疫情期间向在线学习的大规模转变已经永久性地改变了高等教育的格局。

sensors.usageZh: 可数名词，常用复数形式。常与动词 collect、use、install、have 搭配，表示“收集/使用/安装/配备传感器”。可指光线、温度、运动等各类传感器，在科技和日常语境中都常见。

examples.sentence: The lights turn on when the sensors feel someone walking by.
examples.trans: 当传感器感应到有人走过时，灯就会亮起来。

examples.sentence: Our school gym has motion sensors that switch off the lights when nobody is inside.
examples.trans: 我们学校体育馆有运动传感器，没人在里面时会自动关灯。

examples.sentence: The parking garage uses sensors above each space to show drivers where they can park.
examples.trans: 停车场在每个车位上方使用传感器，向司机显示哪里可以停车。

examples.sentence: By installing temperature sensors throughout the greenhouse, farmers can adjust the heating before crops suffer damage.
examples.trans: 通过在温室各处安装温度传感器，农民可以在作物受损之前调节供暖。

examples.sentence: Unlike traditional cameras that only record images, depth sensors capture spatial information that allows robots to navigate safely around obstacles.
examples.trans: 与只记录图像的传统摄像头不同，深度传感器捕捉空间信息，使机器人能够安全地绕过障碍物。

examples.sentence: The reliability of earthquake early-warning systems depends heavily on how densely sensors are distributed across fault zones and how rapidly their signals are processed.
examples.trans: 地震预警系统的可靠性在很大程度上取决于传感器在断裂带上的分布密度以及其信号被处理的速度。

environment.usageZh: 可数名词，通常用单数形式。可指自然环境，也可指特定的工作、学习或数字环境。常见搭配有 protect the environment、a safe environment、the learning environment、digital environment。

examples.sentence: We should put rubbish in the bin to keep our environment clean.
examples.trans: 我们应该把垃圾放进垃圾桶，保持环境干净。

examples.sentence: Planting more trees is a simple way to improve the environment around our school.
examples.trans: 种更多的树是改善我们学校周边环境的一个简单方法。

examples.sentence: The new library provides a quiet environment where students can focus on their reading.
examples.trans: 新图书馆提供了一个安静的环境，学生可以在那里专心阅读。

examples.sentence: Creating a supportive environment at home encourages children to express their ideas without fear of being judged.
examples.trans: 在家里营造一个支持性的环境，能鼓励孩子表达自己的想法而不必担心被评判。

examples.sentence: While economic growth remains a priority for many governments, an increasing number of voters now demand that protecting the environment be given equal weight.
examples.trans: 尽管经济增长仍是许多政府的优先事项，但越来越多的选民现在要求将环境保护置于同等重要的地位。

examples.sentence: The extent to which an individual's behaviour is shaped by the surrounding environment, rather than by innate traits, remains a central debate in developmental psychology.
examples.trans: 个体的行为在多大程度上由周围环境而非先天特质所塑造，仍然是发展心理学中的一个核心争论。

infrastructure.usageZh: 不可数名词。常与形容词连用，如 digital infrastructure、transport infrastructure、national infrastructure。常与动词 invest in、build、upgrade、maintain 搭配，表示“投资/建设/升级/维护基础设施”。

examples.sentence: Our city needs better infrastructure, like new roads and bridges.
examples.trans: 我们的城市需要更好的基础设施，比如新的道路和桥梁。

examples.sentence: The town spent a lot of money on infrastructure such as water pipes and power lines.
examples.trans: 这个镇子在供水管道和电线等基础设施上花了很多钱。

examples.sentence: Without reliable infrastructure, remote villages struggle to get clean water and electricity.
examples.trans: 没有可靠的基础设施，偏远村庄很难获得干净的水和电。

examples.sentence: Governments that invest in digital infrastructure enable small businesses to reach customers far beyond their local markets.
examples.trans: 投资数字基础设施的政府使小企业能够接触到远超本地市场的客户。

examples.sentence: The flooding revealed how decades of underinvestment in drainage infrastructure had left the region dangerously exposed to extreme weather.
examples.trans: 洪水暴露了几十年来排水基础设施投资不足使该地区在极端天气面前处于何等危险的境地。

examples.sentence: A nation's capacity to respond to public health emergencies is determined not only by its hospitals but also by the resilience of its broader infrastructure, from transport networks to data systems.
examples.trans: 一个国家应对公共卫生紧急事件的能力不仅取决于其医院，还取决于其更广泛基础设施的韧性，从交通网络到数据系统。

augmented.usageZh: 形容词，几乎只用于固定搭配“augmented reality”（增强现实，简称AR）。指通过计算机生成的图像、声音等信息叠加在现实世界上，使体验得到增强。不用于比较级或最高级。

examples.sentence: My brother plays an augmented reality game on his phone.
examples.trans: 我哥哥在手机上玩一个增强现实游戏。

examples.sentence: The app uses augmented reality to put cartoon animals in your room.
examples.trans: 这个应用程序用增强现实把卡通动物放到你的房间里。

examples.sentence: With augmented reality glasses, you can see directions right in front of your eyes.
examples.trans: 戴上增强现实眼镜，你可以在眼前直接看到路线指示。

examples.sentence: The training program combines physical equipment with augmented reality overlays to guide new workers through each step.
examples.trans: 该培训项目将实体设备与增强现实叠加层相结合，引导新员工完成每一步操作。

examples.sentence: Unlike virtual reality, which replaces the real world entirely, augmented reality adds digital information to what you already see.
examples.trans: 与完全取代现实世界的虚拟现实不同，增强现实是在你已看到的景象上添加数字信息。

examples.sentence: Surgeons are increasingly relying on augmented reality systems that project critical patient data directly onto the operating field, reducing the need to look away from the procedure.
examples.trans: 外科医生越来越依赖增强现实系统，将关键的患者数据直接投射到手术区域，从而减少在手术过程中转移视线的需要。

virtual.usageZh: 形容词，意为“虚拟的；通过计算机或网络实现的”，常放在名词前，如 virtual reality（虚拟现实）、virtual meeting（虚拟会议）、virtual tour（虚拟游览）。也可表示“几乎的；实际上的”，如 a virtual stranger（几乎是个陌生人）。

examples.sentence: We took a virtual tour of the zoo on the computer.
examples.trans: 我们在电脑上虚拟游览了动物园。

examples.sentence: My cousin made a virtual friend from another country online.
examples.trans: 我表姐在网上交了一个来自另一个国家的虚拟朋友。

examples.sentence: The school set up a virtual classroom so students could study from home.
examples.trans: 学校建立了一个虚拟教室，让学生可以在家学习。

examples.sentence: After losing his job, he became a virtual assistant for several small companies, handling their emails and schedules remotely.
examples.trans: 失业后，他成了几家小公司的虚拟助理，远程处理他们的邮件和日程安排。

examples.sentence: The virtual conference attracted twice as many participants as last year's in-person event, largely because travel costs were eliminated.
examples.trans: 这场虚拟会议吸引的参会人数是去年线下活动的两倍，很大程度上是因为省去了差旅费用。

examples.sentence: As virtual collaboration tools become more sophisticated, the boundary between working from home and working in the office is blurring, forcing companies to rethink how they measure productivity.
examples.trans: 随着虚拟协作工具日益成熟，在家办公与在办公室工作之间的界限正在模糊，迫使企业重新思考如何衡量生产力。

mainstream.usageZh: 可作名词（通常为 the mainstream，意为“主流；主流群体”）或形容词（如 mainstream media 主流媒体、mainstream culture 主流文化）。常与动词 enter、break into、become、join 搭配，表示“进入主流”。

examples.sentence: This song is very popular on mainstream radio.
examples.trans: 这首歌在主流电台上很受欢迎。

examples.sentence: More and more people are choosing mainstream brands instead of small local shops.
examples.trans: 越来越多的人选择主流品牌，而不是当地的小店。

examples.sentence: Online learning has entered the mainstream in recent years.
examples.trans: 近年来，在线学习已经进入了主流。

examples.sentence: The technology was once considered experimental, but it has now broken into the mainstream and is used by millions of people daily.
examples.trans: 这项技术曾被视为实验性的，但如今已进入主流，每天有数百万人在使用。

examples.sentence: While independent films often explore bold ideas, mainstream cinema tends to favor familiar stories that appeal to the widest possible audience.
examples.trans: 独立电影往往探索大胆的主题，而主流电影则倾向于选择能吸引最广泛观众的熟悉故事。

examples.sentence: Once dismissed as a passing trend, plant-based meat has now gained enough traction in mainstream supermarkets to challenge traditional protein sources on both price and availability.
examples.trans: 植物肉曾被视为一时的潮流，如今已在主流超市中获得足够的市场牵引力，在价格和供应方面都开始挑战传统蛋白质来源。

eventually.usageZh: 副词，意为“最终，终于”。常放在实义动词之前，或句首、句尾。强调经过较长时间、较多努力或一系列事件之后的结果。

family.meaning: 可能发生的事件，不测事件

examples.sentence: I lost my key, but I eventually found it under the sofa.
examples.trans: 我把钥匙弄丢了，但最后在沙发下面找到了。

examples.sentence: It rained all morning, but the sun eventually came out after lunch.
examples.trans: 下了一上午的雨，但午饭后太阳终于出来了。

examples.sentence: After trying three different buses, we eventually got to the museum before it closed.
examples.trans: 换了三趟公交车之后，我们终于在闭馆前赶到了博物馆。

examples.sentence: The two sides argued for hours, but they eventually reached an agreement that satisfied everyone.
examples.trans: 双方争论了好几个小时，但最终达成了一项让所有人都满意的协议。

examples.sentence: Although the new software caused some problems at first, the team eventually managed to fix all the major bugs.
examples.trans: 尽管新软件起初造成了一些问题，团队最终还是设法修复了所有主要漏洞。

examples.sentence: Scientists believe that if the current trend continues, the species will eventually disappear from this region entirely.
examples.trans: 科学家认为，如果目前的趋势持续下去，该物种最终将从这个地区完全消失。

notable.usageZh: 形容词，意为“显著的，值得注意的”。常用于名词前作定语，或用在 be 动词等系动词后作表语。常与 for 搭配，表示“因……而著名”。

examples.sentence: My brother made a notable improvement in his handwriting this term.
examples.trans: 这学期我哥哥的书写有了明显的进步。

examples.sentence: The new library has a notable collection of picture books for young readers.
examples.trans: 新图书馆收藏了大量适合小读者的绘本，这一点很值得注意。

examples.sentence: There was a notable drop in air pollution after the city limited the use of cars on weekdays.
examples.trans: 该市限制工作日用车后，空气污染有了显著下降。

examples.sentence: The scientist is notable for her research on renewable energy, which has influenced policy in several countries.
examples.trans: 这位科学家以可再生能源研究而闻名，她的研究影响了多个国家的政策。

examples.sentence: What makes this ancient town notable is not its size but its remarkably well-preserved street layout.
examples.trans: 这座古镇之所以引人注目，不在于它的规模，而在于其保存极为完好的街道布局。

examples.sentence: The report highlights a notable shift in consumer behavior, with more people choosing second-hand goods over new ones.
examples.trans: 该报告强调了一个显著的消费行为转变：越来越多的人选择二手商品而非新品。

components.usageZh: 可数名词，常用复数形式。指构成整体的各个部分，既可以是机器的物理部件，也可以是计划、系统等抽象要素。常与 of 搭配。

examples.sentence: This toy car has many small components, so be careful not to lose any.
examples.trans: 这辆玩具车有很多小零件，小心别弄丢了。

examples.sentence: The main components of a sandwich are bread, filling, and sauce.
examples.trans: 三明治的主要成分是面包、馅料和酱料。

examples.sentence: Before you start the experiment, check that all the components of the kit are in the box.
examples.trans: 开始实验之前，检查一下套件里的所有部件是否都在盒子里。

examples.sentence: Trust and communication are essential components of a healthy relationship between parents and teenagers.
examples.trans: 信任和沟通是父母与青少年之间健康关系的重要组成部分。

examples.sentence: The engine was taken apart so that each component could be examined for signs of wear.
examples.trans: 发动机被拆开，以便检查每个部件是否有磨损的迹象。

examples.sentence: A successful marketing strategy consists of several interrelated components, including pricing, distribution, and brand positioning.
examples.trans: 一个成功的营销策略由几个相互关联的组成部分构成，包括定价、分销和品牌定位。

concentrated.usageZh: 形容词，意为“集中的，密集的”，常用于描述人口、建筑、资源等在某一区域高度聚集。常见搭配有 be concentrated in/on/at，表示“集中在……”。也可作动词 concentrate 的过去分词形式，用于被动语态或完成时。

examples.sentence: The shops are concentrated on this street.
examples.trans: 商店都集中在这条街上。

examples.sentence: Most of the factories are concentrated in the south of the city.
examples.trans: 大多数工厂都集中在城市南部。

examples.sentence: The heavy traffic is concentrated at the bridge every morning.
examples.trans: 每天早上，拥堵的交通都集中在那座桥附近。

examples.sentence: The research team concentrated its efforts on developing a cheaper battery.
examples.trans: 研究团队把精力集中在研发一种更便宜的电池上。

examples.sentence: Unlike the scattered rural settlements, the urban population is highly concentrated along the coast.
examples.trans: 与分散的农村居民点不同，城市人口高度集中在沿海地区。

examples.sentence: The report warns that economic power has become increasingly concentrated in the hands of a few global corporations.
examples.trans: 该报告警告说，经济权力已日益集中在少数几家全球性企业手中。

look forward to.usageZh: 短语动词，后接名词或动名词（-ing形式），不接不定式。用于表达对将来某事的愉快期待，口语和书面语都常用。

examples.sentence: I look forward to my birthday party every year.
examples.trans: 我每年都期待我的生日聚会。

examples.sentence: She is looking forward to visiting her grandparents this weekend.
examples.trans: 她期待着这个周末去看望她的祖父母。

examples.sentence: After months of hard work, the whole team looks forward to the final result.
examples.trans: 经过几个月的努力，整个团队都期待着最终的结果。

examples.sentence: Having heard so much about the new art museum, I really look forward to seeing the exhibition in person.
examples.trans: 听说了很多关于新美术馆的事，我真的很期待亲眼看到那个展览。

examples.sentence: Unlike his colleagues, who dread the annual meeting, Mark genuinely looks forward to the chance to present his research.
examples.trans: 与那些害怕年会的同事不同，马克真正期待这个展示他研究的机会。

examples.sentence: The committee looks forward to receiving further evidence before reaching a conclusion on the matter.
examples.trans: 委员会期待在就此事得出结论之前收到进一步的证据。

head to.usageZh: 短语动词，后直接接地点名词，表示“前往、朝某地走去”。比 go to 更口语化，常带有方向感或目的性。

examples.sentence: After school, I head to the playground with my friends.
examples.trans: 放学后，我和朋友们去操场。

examples.sentence: We packed our bags and headed to the train station early in the morning.
examples.trans: 我们收拾好行李，一大早就前往火车站。

examples.sentence: If you want to buy fresh vegetables, head to the market before nine o'clock.
examples.trans: 如果你想买新鲜蔬菜，九点之前去市场。

examples.sentence: Realizing the storm was approaching, the hikers decided to head to the nearest shelter as quickly as possible.
examples.trans: 意识到暴风雨即将来临，徒步者们决定尽快前往最近的避难所。

examples.sentence: Rather than heading straight to the hotel, the tourists chose to explore the old town on foot first.
examples.trans: 游客们没有直接前往酒店，而是选择先步行探索老城区。

examples.sentence: With fuel running low and no sign of a gas station ahead, the driver reluctantly headed to a small village off the main road.
examples.trans: 燃油即将耗尽，前方又没有加油站的迹象，司机不情愿地驶向主路旁的一个小村庄。

nothing less than.usageZh: 习语，用于名词短语前，表示强调，意为“简直是、完全是、不亚于”。语气较强，常用于评价成就、表现或品质。

examples.sentence: The magic show was nothing less than amazing.
examples.trans: 那场魔术表演简直太神奇了。

examples.sentence: Getting first prize in the school competition was nothing less than a dream come true.
examples.trans: 在学校比赛中获得一等奖简直是梦想成真。

examples.sentence: The rescue team's effort to save the trapped climbers was nothing less than heroic.
examples.trans: 救援队拯救被困登山者的努力简直是英勇的。

examples.sentence: To be invited to speak at the international conference was nothing less than a great honor for the young scientist.
examples.trans: 受邀在国际会议上发言对这位年轻科学家来说简直是极大的荣誉。

examples.sentence: The discovery of the ancient manuscript was nothing less than a turning point in the study of medieval history.
examples.trans: 这份古代手稿的发现简直是中世纪历史研究的一个转折点。

examples.sentence: Given the complexity of the negotiations, reaching an agreement within three days was nothing less than a diplomatic miracle.
examples.trans: 考虑到谈判的复杂性，三天内达成协议简直是外交上的奇迹。

packed with.usageZh: 形容词短语，后接名词，表示“挤满/充满某物”。可用于描述场所、物品或抽象事物。口语和书面语都常见，语气比 full of 更生动。

examples.sentence: My school bag is packed with books and snacks.
examples.trans: 我的书包里塞满了书和零食。

examples.sentence: The little shop was packed with customers on Saturday morning.
examples.trans: 周六早上那家小店挤满了顾客。

examples.sentence: Her diary is packed with funny stories about her classmates.
examples.trans: 她的日记里写满了关于同学们的有趣故事。

examples.sentence: The schedule is packed with back-to-back meetings, leaving no room for a lunch break.
examples.trans: 日程被连续的会议塞得满满当当，连吃午饭的时间都没有。

examples.sentence: Unlike the empty streets last year, the old town is now packed with tourists from all over the world.
examples.trans: 与去年空荡荡的街道不同，老城区现在挤满了来自世界各地的游客。

examples.sentence: The final chapter is packed with subtle clues that reward a second reading of the novel.
examples.trans: 最后一章充满了微妙的线索，值得把这部小说再读一遍。

not a dull moment.usageZh: 名词短语，通常用于否定结构，表示“没有一刻无聊”。常与 there is/was 连用，形容某段时间或经历充满趣味。口语色彩较强。

examples.sentence: At my cousin's birthday party, there was not a dull moment.
examples.trans: 在我表弟的生日聚会上，没有一刻是无聊的。

examples.sentence: With three little dogs running around the house, there is never a dull moment.
examples.trans: 有三只小狗在屋里跑来跑去，从来不会有无聊的时候。

examples.sentence: During the school trip to the farm, there was not a dull moment from morning to night.
examples.trans: 学校去农场的旅行中，从早到晚没有一刻是无聊的。

examples.sentence: Living with an artist who paints at midnight means there is never a dull moment in our apartment.
examples.trans: 和一个半夜画画的艺术家住在一起，意味着我们的公寓里从来没有无聊的时刻。

examples.sentence: The debate club attracts sharp minds and loud voices, so there is rarely a dull moment at their weekly meetings.
examples.trans: 辩论社吸引了思维敏锐、嗓门洪亮的人，所以他们的每周例会上很少有无聊的时刻。

examples.sentence: Between managing a startup and raising twins, she insists there has not been a dull moment in the past five years.
examples.trans: 在经营一家初创公司和抚养一对双胞胎之间，她坚称过去五年里没有一刻是无聊的。

rule out.usageZh: 动词短语，后接名词或动名词，表示“排除某种可能性”。常用于讨论原因、选项或嫌疑人。正式程度中等，口语和书面语均可用。

examples.sentence: The doctor ruled out a cold and said I just needed rest.
examples.trans: 医生排除了感冒的可能，说我只需要休息。

examples.sentence: We can't rule out the possibility that it will rain tomorrow.
examples.trans: 我们不能排除明天下雨的可能性。

examples.sentence: The police ruled out theft because nothing was missing from the house.
examples.trans: 警方排除了盗窃的可能，因为房子里没有丢任何东西。

examples.sentence: After checking the engine carefully, the mechanic ruled out any serious damage to the car.
examples.trans: 仔细检查发动机后，修理工排除了汽车有任何严重损坏的可能。

examples.sentence: Although the symptoms seemed mild, the doctor did not rule out the need for further tests.
examples.trans: 尽管症状看起来轻微，医生并没有排除进一步检查的必要。

examples.sentence: The committee ruled out cutting the research budget, arguing that long-term innovation would suffer irreparably.
examples.trans: 委员会排除了削减研究预算的可能，认为长期创新将遭受不可挽回的损失。

express themselves.usageZh: 反身动词短语，表示“表达自己的想法或情感”。主语变化时，反身代词要相应变化（myself, yourself, himself 等）。常用于讨论艺术、写作、演讲等话题，书面和口语都可用。

family.meaning: 富有表现力的；善于表达的

examples.sentence: Children can express themselves with crayons and paper.
examples.trans: 孩子们可以用蜡笔和纸来表达自己。

examples.sentence: Some shy students find it easier to express themselves in a diary.
examples.trans: 一些害羞的学生发现，在日记里表达自己更容易。

examples.sentence: Teenagers often use music and fashion to express themselves when words feel difficult.
examples.trans: 当言语难以表达时，青少年常常用音乐和时尚来表达自己。

examples.sentence: Debate clubs give students a safe space to express themselves without fear of being judged.
examples.trans: 辩论社团给学生提供了一个安全的空间，让他们可以表达自己而不必担心被评判。

examples.sentence: Unlike formal essays, personal blogs allow writers to express themselves with far greater freedom and spontaneity.
examples.trans: 与正式文章不同，个人博客让写作者能够以更大的自由度和自发性来表达自己。

examples.sentence: Adolescents who are consistently discouraged from expressing themselves may develop a lasting reluctance to voice their opinions in adulthood.
examples.trans: 那些一直被阻止表达自己的青少年，成年后可能会形成一种长期不愿发表意见的心理。

show off.usageZh: 动词短语，意为“炫耀；展示”。可分开使用（show something off），也可接宾语。常带贬义，指刻意吸引注意或夸耀；但有时也可中性使用，表示展示某物。

examples.sentence: He likes to show off his new toy car at school.
examples.trans: 他喜欢在学校炫耀他的新玩具车。

examples.sentence: My little brother always shows off in front of our relatives.
examples.trans: 我弟弟总是在亲戚面前炫耀。

examples.sentence: She bought a fancy phone just to show off, not because she needed it.
examples.trans: 她买了一部昂贵的手机只是为了炫耀，并不是因为需要。

examples.sentence: Rather than showing off his achievements, he quietly let the results speak for themselves.
examples.trans: 他没有炫耀自己的成就，而是让结果自己说话。

examples.sentence: The gallery owner showed off the newly restored painting with evident pride, yet avoided sounding boastful.
examples.trans: 画廊老板带着明显的自豪感展示了那幅新修复的画作，但避免了听起来像在自夸。

examples.sentence: In professional settings, those who constantly show off their expertise often undermine the collaborative atmosphere that innovation depends on.
examples.trans: 在职业环境中，那些不断炫耀自己专业知识的人往往会破坏创新所依赖的合作氛围。

in the air.usageZh: 介词短语，有两个主要含义：一是字面义“在空中”，二是比喻义“悬而未决；尚未确定”。比喻义常用于计划、决定、气氛等抽象事物。

examples.sentence: The bird is flying high in the air.
examples.trans: 鸟儿在空中高高地飞。

examples.sentence: There was a sweet smell of flowers in the air after the rain.
examples.trans: 雨后空气中弥漫着花香。

examples.sentence: Our weekend plan is still in the air because Dad hasn't decided yet.
examples.trans: 我们的周末计划还没定，因为爸爸还没决定。

examples.sentence: With the final exam approaching, a sense of nervousness hung in the air throughout the classroom.
examples.trans: 随着期末考试临近，教室里弥漫着一种紧张的气氛。

examples.sentence: Whether the company will relocate remains in the air, as the board has postponed its decision for another month.
examples.trans: 公司是否会搬迁仍然悬而未决，因为董事会已将决定推迟了一个月。

examples.sentence: The scent of pine and damp earth lingered in the air long after the storm had passed, lending the forest an almost sacred stillness.
examples.trans: 暴风雨过去很久之后，松树和潮湿泥土的气味仍萦绕在空气中，赋予森林一种近乎神圣的静谧。

count on.usageZh: 动词短语，后接名词、代词或动名词。口语和书面语都常用，表示“依靠、指望”。常见搭配：count on sb to do sth（指望某人做某事）、count on sth（指望某事发生）。

examples.sentence: You can count on me to help with your homework.
examples.trans: 你可以指望我帮你做作业。

examples.sentence: We count on the school bus to get us there on time.
examples.trans: 我们依靠校车准时把我们送到那里。

examples.sentence: If you promise to keep the secret, you can count on my support.
examples.trans: 如果你答应保守秘密，你就可以指望我的支持。

examples.sentence: Having missed the last train, she had no one to count on for a ride home.
examples.trans: 错过了最后一班火车，她没有人可以依靠送她回家。

examples.sentence: Unlike his unreliable brother, you can always count on David to keep his word.
examples.trans: 与他那个不可靠的兄弟不同，你总是可以指望大卫信守诺言。

examples.sentence: In times of economic uncertainty, few companies can count on steady growth without adjusting their strategies.
examples.trans: 在经济不确定的时期，很少有公司能够在不调整战略的情况下指望稳定增长。

slowly but surely.usageZh: 副词短语，通常置于句首或句中，表示“缓慢但稳步地”。用于描述一个逐渐但确定的过程，带有积极色彩。常见于叙述文和议论文中。

examples.sentence: Slowly but surely, the little plant grew taller every day.
examples.trans: 慢慢地但确实地，这棵小植物每天都在长高。

examples.sentence: Slowly but surely, my English is getting better with daily practice.
examples.trans: 慢慢地但确实地，通过每天练习，我的英语正在变好。

examples.sentence: Slowly but surely, the patient regained her strength after the operation.
examples.trans: 慢慢地但确实地，这位病人在手术后恢复了体力。

examples.sentence: Slowly but surely, the new policy is changing the way people think about recycling.
examples.trans: 慢慢地但确实地，这项新政策正在改变人们对回收利用的看法。

examples.sentence: Slowly but surely, the once-neglected neighborhood has transformed into a vibrant cultural hub.
examples.trans: 慢慢地但确实地，这个曾经被忽视的社区已经转变为一个充满活力的文化中心。

examples.sentence: Slowly but surely, public awareness of mental health issues has grown, prompting governments to allocate more resources to support services.
examples.trans: 慢慢地但确实地，公众对心理健康问题的意识已经增强，促使政府将更多资源分配给支持服务。

closer and closer.usageZh: 比较级短语，作副词使用，表示“越来越近”。可用于描述距离、时间、关系或抽象事物的接近。常与 get, come, move 等动词搭配。

examples.sentence: The dog ran closer and closer to the ball.
examples.trans: 狗跑得离球越来越近。

examples.sentence: As the train moved closer and closer, we could hear the wheels clearly.
examples.trans: 随着火车越来越近，我们能清楚地听到车轮声。

examples.sentence: The two friends grew closer and closer after working on the project together.
examples.trans: 这两个朋友在共同完成项目后变得越来越亲密。

examples.sentence: With each passing day, the deadline for the application is getting closer and closer.
examples.trans: 随着一天天过去，申请的截止日期越来越近了。

examples.sentence: As the investigation progressed, the detectives moved closer and closer to identifying the real culprit.
examples.trans: 随着调查的推进，侦探们越来越接近确定真正的罪犯。

examples.sentence: As artificial intelligence advances, the boundary between human and machine capabilities is being pushed closer and closer, raising profound ethical questions.
examples.trans: 随着人工智能的进步，人类与机器能力之间的界限被推得越来越近，引发了深刻的伦理问题。

lightning-fast speed.usageZh: 名词短语，常用于形容科技产品、网络、动作或变化的极快速度。可作主语、宾语或介词宾语，常与 at/with 搭配。口语和书面语均适用，带有夸张色彩。

examples.sentence: The rabbit ran across the grass at lightning-fast speed.
examples.trans: 兔子以闪电般的速度跑过草地。

examples.sentence: My brother finished his homework at lightning-fast speed so he could play basketball.
examples.trans: 我哥哥以闪电般的速度做完作业，这样他就能去打篮球了。

examples.sentence: News spreads at lightning-fast speed on social media, so we should check the facts before sharing.
examples.trans: 新闻在社交媒体上以闪电般的速度传播，所以我们在分享之前应该核实事实。

examples.sentence: With the new fiber-optic connection, downloading large files happens at lightning-fast speed.
examples.trans: 有了新的光纤连接，下载大文件以闪电般的速度完成。

examples.sentence: The company responded to the crisis with lightning-fast speed, which prevented the situation from getting worse.
examples.trans: 该公司以闪电般的速度应对危机，从而防止了局势恶化。

examples.sentence: While traditional industries often struggle to adapt, the tech sector embraces change at lightning-fast speed, leaving slower competitors far behind.
examples.trans: 传统行业往往难以适应变化，而科技行业以闪电般的速度拥抱变革，将较慢的竞争对手远远甩在身后。

objectively speaking.usageZh: 插入语，置于句首或句中，用于引出基于事实而非个人情感的判断。常用于议论文、评论或正式讨论中，语气较为正式。

examples.sentence: Objectively speaking, the blue pen writes better than the red one.
examples.trans: 客观地说，蓝色笔比红色笔写起来更好。

examples.sentence: Objectively speaking, this restaurant is cheaper than the one near our school.
examples.trans: 客观地说，这家餐厅比我们学校附近那家便宜。

examples.sentence: Objectively speaking, the new timetable gives us more time for sports than the old one did.
examples.trans: 客观地说，新时间表比旧时间表给了我们更多运动时间。

examples.sentence: Objectively speaking, the evidence supports the theory that regular exercise improves memory.
examples.trans: 客观地说，证据支持定期锻炼能改善记忆这一理论。

examples.sentence: Objectively speaking, the novel's plot is well constructed, even though its characters lack emotional depth.
examples.trans: 客观地说，这部小说的情节结构很好，尽管其人物缺乏情感深度。

examples.sentence: Objectively speaking, the policy has reduced unemployment, yet its long-term effects on small businesses remain uncertain.
examples.trans: 客观地说，该政策降低了失业率，但其对小企业的长期影响仍不确定。

in contrast.usageZh: 过渡短语，通常置于句首，用于引出与前文形成鲜明对比的事实或观点。可连接两个句子，也可用于段落之间，书面语中尤为常见。

family.meaning: 形成对比的；截然不同的

examples.sentence: My cat sleeps all day. In contrast, my dog loves to run outside.
examples.trans: 我的猫整天睡觉。相比之下，我的狗喜欢在外面跑。

examples.sentence: The north of the country is cold and dry. In contrast, the south is warm and wet.
examples.trans: 该国北部寒冷干燥。相比之下，南部温暖潮湿。

examples.sentence: Tom spends his weekends reading at home. In contrast, his sister goes out with friends every Saturday.
examples.trans: 汤姆周末在家读书。相比之下，他姐姐每个周六都和朋友出去。

examples.sentence: The first experiment produced clear results. In contrast, the second one yielded data that was difficult to interpret.
examples.trans: 第一个实验产生了清晰的结果。相比之下，第二个实验得出的数据难以解读。

examples.sentence: Urban areas offer abundant job opportunities and entertainment. In contrast, rural regions provide cleaner air and a stronger sense of community.
examples.trans: 城市地区提供丰富的就业机会和娱乐活动。相比之下，农村地区提供更清洁的空气和更强的社区感。

examples.sentence: The previous administration focused on rapid economic growth at any cost. In contrast, the current government prioritizes sustainable development and environmental protection.
examples.trans: 前任政府不惜一切代价专注于快速经济增长。相比之下，现任政府优先考虑可持续发展和环境保护。

a variety of.usageZh: 短语，后接可数名词复数或不可数名词，表示“各种各样的”。口语和书面语都常用，比 many kinds of 更正式一些。

examples.sentence: My mom cooks a variety of vegetables for dinner.
examples.trans: 妈妈晚饭做了各种各样的蔬菜。

examples.sentence: The shop sells a variety of school things, from pens to notebooks.
examples.trans: 这家商店卖各种各样的学习用品，从钢笔到笔记本都有。

examples.sentence: The museum has a variety of activities for children during the summer holiday.
examples.trans: 暑假期间，博物馆为孩子们准备了各种各样的活动。

examples.sentence: To stay healthy, you should eat a variety of foods rather than just one type.
examples.trans: 为了保持健康，你应该吃各种各样的食物，而不是只吃一种。

examples.sentence: A variety of factors, including weather and soil quality, determine how well crops grow.
examples.trans: 包括天气和土壤质量在内的多种因素决定了庄稼长得好不好。

examples.sentence: The research project gathered data from a variety of sources, ensuring that the final conclusions were both reliable and comprehensive.
examples.trans: 该研究项目从多种来源收集数据，确保最终结论既可靠又全面。

break the mainstream.usageZh: 动词短语，表示“进入主流、被大众接受”，常用于科技、潮流、文化或观念等话题。主语通常是事物或趋势。

examples.sentence: This new song is so popular that it may break the mainstream soon.
examples.trans: 这首新歌太受欢迎了，可能很快就会成为主流。

examples.sentence: Online learning began to break the mainstream when many students started using it.
examples.trans: 当许多学生开始使用在线学习时，它开始进入主流。

examples.sentence: Short videos have broken the mainstream in recent years, attracting millions of users.
examples.trans: 近年来，短视频已经进入主流，吸引了数百万用户。

examples.sentence: Once considered a niche hobby, playing video games has now broken the mainstream and become a global industry.
examples.trans: 打电子游戏曾被视为小众爱好，如今已进入主流，成为一个全球性产业。

examples.sentence: It took years for renewable energy to break the mainstream, but falling costs finally made it competitive with fossil fuels.
examples.trans: 可再生能源花了多年时间才进入主流，但成本下降最终使其能与化石燃料竞争。

examples.sentence: The idea that mental health deserves the same attention as physical health has only recently begun to break the mainstream in public discourse.
examples.trans: 心理健康应得到与身体健康同等关注这一观念，直到最近才开始在公共讨论中进入主流。

weighed down.usageZh: 动词短语，常用被动语态 be weighed down with/by，表示“被……压得喘不过气、负担沉重”。既可指身体负重，也可指心理压力。

examples.sentence: My schoolbag is weighed down with too many books.
examples.trans: 我的书包被太多书压得很重。

examples.sentence: He felt weighed down by all the homework he had to finish before Friday.
examples.trans: 他因为必须在周五前完成所有作业而感到压力很大。

examples.sentence: The little boat was weighed down with fish after a long day at sea.
examples.trans: 在海上忙了一整天后，小船被鱼压得沉甸甸的。

examples.sentence: She walked slowly, weighed down by the heavy boxes and the even heavier news she had just received.
examples.trans: 她走得很慢，沉重的箱子以及刚刚收到的更沉重的消息让她不堪重负。

examples.sentence: Unlike his colleagues, who seemed full of energy, he appeared weighed down by years of unanswered questions and unfulfilled promises.
examples.trans: 与那些看起来精力充沛的同事不同，他似乎被多年未解的问题和未兑现的承诺压得疲惫不堪。

examples.sentence: The investigation was weighed down by conflicting testimonies and a lack of reliable evidence, making it nearly impossible to reach a fair conclusion.
examples.trans: 调查因相互矛盾的证词和缺乏可靠证据而举步维艰，几乎无法得出公正的结论。

in the meantime.usageZh: 副词性短语，常置于句首或句末，表示“在等待期间”或“两件事之间”。口语和书面语都常用，可替换 meanwhile。注意不要写成 in the mean time。

examples.sentence: Mom is cooking dinner. In the meantime, I do my homework.
examples.trans: 妈妈在做晚饭。与此同时，我做作业。

examples.sentence: The bus won't come for another ten minutes. In the meantime, let's check the map again.
examples.trans: 公交车还要十分钟才来。趁这会儿，我们再看看地图。

examples.sentence: The doctor is busy with another patient. In the meantime, please fill out this form.
examples.trans: 医生正在看另一位病人。在此期间，请填写这张表格。

examples.sentence: The software update takes about an hour. In the meantime, you can continue working on other files.
examples.trans: 软件更新大约需要一个小时。在此期间，你可以继续处理其他文件。

examples.sentence: The committee has not reached a final decision. In the meantime, all existing rules remain in effect.
examples.trans: 委员会尚未做出最终决定。在此期间，所有现行规则仍然有效。

examples.sentence: Negotiations are expected to resume next month; in the meantime, both sides have agreed to maintain the ceasefire.
examples.trans: 谈判预计下月恢复；在此期间，双方已同意维持停火。

make sure.usageZh: 动词短语，后接 that 从句（that 可省略）或 of 短语。表示“确保某事发生”或“查明某事属实”。口语中常用于叮嘱或提醒，语气比 check 更强。

examples.sentence: Make sure you bring your umbrella. It looks rainy.
examples.trans: 记得带上雨伞。天看起来要下雨。

examples.sentence: Before you hand in your test paper, make sure your name is written on it.
examples.trans: 交卷之前，确认你的名字写在上面了。

examples.sentence: Make sure the door is locked when you leave the house.
examples.trans: 离开家时，确保门锁好了。

examples.sentence: Before submitting your application, make sure that all required documents have been uploaded.
examples.trans: 提交申请之前，请确保所有必需的文件都已上传。

examples.sentence: The editor made sure that every factual claim in the article was supported by a reliable source.
examples.trans: 编辑确保文章中的每一条事实性陈述都有可靠来源支撑。

examples.sentence: To avoid any misunderstanding, the contract makes sure that both parties' responsibilities are clearly defined.
examples.trans: 为避免任何误解，合同确保双方的责任得到明确界定。

grammar.title: 情态动词 can 表示能力与可能性（拓展：could / be able to / may / might）
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verb 'can' for Ability/Possibility (Extended: could / be able to / may / might)
grammar.usage:
情态动词 can 的核心功能是表示能力、可能性以及口语中的许可。它没有人称和数的变化，后面必须直接跟动词原形，构成“主语+can+动词原形”的基本结构。例如：You can do many things on weekends. 周末你可以做很多事情。这一结构在肯定句、否定句和疑问句中都保持动词原形不变。

肯定句：主语 + can + 动词原形（+其他）。例如：She can speak English. 否定句：主语 + cannot/can't + 动词原形（+其他）。例如：He can't drive. 疑问句：Can + 主语 + 动词原形（+其他）？例如：Can you help me? 简略回答用 Yes, 主语+can. 或 No, 主语+can't. 注意不能加 do/does 构成疑问。

与近义结构对比：can 只有现在式和过去式 could，不能直接用于将来时或完成时。而 be able to 可用于各种时态，如 will be able to, has been able to 等。当强调过去某一次具体成功做到某事时，多用 was/were able to 或 managed to，而 could 通常表示过去一般能力或潜在可能。may 和 might 也可表示可能性，但语气更为正式或不确定；表示许可时，may 比 can 正式，might 更委婉。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 can 表示能力、请求许可、基本肯定/否定/疑问结构，例如 I can swim, Can I open the window? 高中阶段则需拓展：could 用于现在或将来表示委婉请求或建议；could have done 表示“本来能做而未做”；may/might have done 表示对过去情况的推测；在书面语和正式语域中，may 表示许可比 can 更得体，might 表示可能性比 may 更小；can't 可表示否定推测“不可能”，与 may not/might not（可能不）存在明显语义差异。

易错点：1）情态动词 can 不能加-s，不能说 He cans swim；后面不能接带 to 的不定式，不能说 can to do。2）could 并非仅仅表示过去，它在高中阶段常表示委婉语气或虚拟，如 Could you...? 或 could have done。3）be able to 与 could 在肯定句中表示过去能力时有区别：could 偏向“有能力但不一定做到”，was/were able to 偏向“具体做到了”。4）may/might have done 用于对过去的推测时，might 可能性更低，高考阅读中常考语义辨析。5）疑问句不能使用助动词 do/does，例如不能说 Do you can swim?
forms: 肯定式：主语 + can + 动词原形 (+ 其他)
否定式：主语 + cannot / can't + 动词原形 (+ 其他)
疑问式：Can + 主语 + 动词原形 (+ 其他)？
过去式/委婉式：主语 + could + 动词原形 (+ 其他)
其他时态：主语 + be able to + 动词原形（如 will be able to / have been able to）
对过去推测：主语 + may/might/could + have + 过去分词
notes: 情态动词 can 没有人称和数的变化，后面永远接动词原形，不能写 He cans swim 或 She can to swim。
could 不只能表示过去，在高中书面语和口语中常用来表示礼貌请求或委婉建议，如 Could you...? 语气比 can 更客气。
表示过去具体某一次成功做到某事时，常用 was/were able to 或 managed to，could 多表示一般能力或潜在可能，高考阅读及书面表达中需辨析。
can't 可表示否定推测“不可能”，与 may not / might not（可能不）含义不同，书面语中注意区分可能性强度。
may 表示正式许可或可能性，might 语气更不确定、更婉转；高考语篇中常出现 may/might + have done 表示对过去的推测。

examples.en: My little brother can swim very fast.
examples.cn: 我弟弟能游得非常快。

examples.en: Can you pass me the salt, please?
examples.cn: 请把盐递给我好吗？

examples.en: She could read when she was four.
examples.cn: 她四岁时就能阅读了。

examples.en: If you try again, you will be able to solve the problem.
examples.cn: 如果你再试一次，你就能解决这个问题。

examples.en: He may have missed the early bus, so he is late.
examples.cn: 他可能错过了早班车，所以迟到了。

examples.en: You could have asked me for help instead of staying up all night.
examples.cn: 你本来可以向我求助，而不是熬夜。

exercises.explain: can 后面直接跟动词原形，没有人称和数的变化。

exercises.q: ______ you swim? Yes, I can.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 构成疑问句时直接提前到主语前。

exercises.q: Birds ______ fly high in the sky.
exercises.explain: can 表示能力，后接动词原形，不随主语变化。

exercises.q: I ______ play the piano, but I can play the guitar.
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式是 can't 或 cannot，后面直接跟动词原形。

exercises.q: ______ your sister speak English?
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 构成疑问句时直接提前，不需要助动词。

exercises.q: She ______ (can) dance very well.
exercises.explain: can 没有人称变化，主语是第三人称单数时仍用 can。

exercises.q: They ______ (not can) come to the party tonight.
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式是 cannot 或 can't。

exercises.q: ______ you help me with my homework?
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 构成疑问句时放在句首。

exercises.q: He cans run very fast.
exercises.explain: can 是情态动词，没有第三人称单数形式，不能说 cans。

exercises.q: My father can cook delicious food.
exercises.explain: can 后接动词原形 cook，表示能力，句子结构正确。

exercises.q: I can swim. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式是 cannot 或 can't，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: She can sing English songs. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 构成疑问句时直接提前到主语前。

exercises.q: They can play basketball. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式是 cannot 或 can't，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: He can plays the violin.
exercises.explain: can 后必须接动词原形，不能接第三人称单数形式 plays。

exercises.q: She cans speak three languages.
exercises.explain: can 是情态动词，没有第三人称单数形式，不能说 cans。

exercises.q: When I was five, I ______ read, but now I can read very well.
exercises.explain: could 是 can 的过去式，表示过去的能力，否定形式为 couldn't。

exercises.q: ______ you please open the window? It's hot here.
exercises.explain: Could 可以表示委婉的请求，比 can 更礼貌。

exercises.q: I'm sorry, but I ______ come to your party tomorrow. I have to visit my grandma.
exercises.explain: can't 表示现在或将来的不可能，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: She ______ be at home now. I saw her in the library just now.
exercises.explain: can't 可以表示否定的推测，意为"不可能"。

exercises.q: My brother ______ swim across the river when he was only ten years old.
exercises.explain: could 表示过去的能力，与时间状语 when he was ten 一致。

exercises.q: ______ you swim when you were seven years old?
exercises.explain: could 是 can 的过去式，用于询问过去的能力。

exercises.q: I ______ (not can) find my keys anywhere. I'm worried.
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式是 cannot 或 can't，表示"不能"。

exercises.q: She ______ (can) speak three languages when she was young.
exercises.explain: could 是 can 的过去式，表示过去的能力。

exercises.q: He could speaks French when he lived in Paris.
exercises.explain: could 后必须接动词原形，不能接第三人称单数形式 speaks。

exercises.q: Can you tell me the way to the station?
exercises.explain: can 可以用于礼貌地请求帮助，句子结构正确。

exercises.q: He could play chess when he was six. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: He couldn't play chess when he was six.
exercises.explain: could 的否定形式是 couldn't，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: They can finish the work today. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Can they finish the work today?
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 构成疑问句时直接提前到主语前。

exercises.q: She is able to solve this problem. (用 can 改写)
exercises.explain: be able to 和 can 都可以表示能力，此处可以互换。

exercises.q: I don't can understand what you mean.
exercises.answer: I can't understand what you mean.
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式是 can't，不需要借助助动词 don't。
