exercises.answer: She could sing very well when she was a child.
exercises.explain: could 后必须接动词原形，不能接第三人称单数形式 sings。

exercises.q: By the time he was ten, he ______ already solve complex math problems.
exercises.explain: could 表示过去的能力，与时间状语 by the time he was ten 一致。

exercises.q: You ______ be tired after working all day. Why don't you take a rest?
exercises.explain: must 表示肯定的推测，意为"一定"，符合语境。

exercises.q: I ______ find my phone anywhere. I think I left it at the office.
exercises.explain: can't 表示"不能"，此处指找不到手机的能力缺失。

exercises.q: ______ you mind helping me carry these books upstairs?
exercises.explain: Would you mind doing 是固定句型，表示礼貌的请求。

exercises.q: If you try hard enough, you ______ achieve your goals.
exercises.explain: can 表示可能性，在条件句中表示"能够"。

exercises.q: She ______ (not can) have gone to the party because she was in hospital at that time.
exercises.explain: cannot have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测，意为"不可能做过"。

exercises.q: ______ you possibly lend me some money until payday?
exercises.explain: Could 用于礼貌的请求，比 can 更委婉。

exercises.q: He ______ (can) speak five languages by the time he was twenty.
exercises.explain: could 表示过去的能力，与 by the time he was twenty 一致。

exercises.q: She can't have finished the project so quickly; it requires at least a week.
exercises.explain: can't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测，句子结构正确。

exercises.q: He could be able to swim when he was five.
exercises.explain: could 和 be able to 不能同时使用，应改为 could swim 或 was able to swim。

exercises.q: It is possible that she is at home now. (用 can 改写)
exercises.answer: She can be at home now.
exercises.explain: can 可以表示可能性，意为"可能"，用于肯定句。

exercises.q: He was able to finish the race despite the injury. (用 could 改写)
exercises.answer: He could finish the race despite the injury.
exercises.explain: could 和 was able to 都可以表示过去的能力，此处可以互换。

exercises.q: I'm sure she didn't forget the meeting. (用 can't 改写)
exercises.answer: She can't have forgotten the meeting.
exercises.explain: can't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测，意为"不可能做过"。

exercises.q: You mustn't be serious. You can't really want to quit your job.
exercises.answer: You can't be serious. You can't really want to quit your job.
exercises.explain: mustn't 表示"禁止"，此处应使用 can't 表示"不可能"的推测。

exercises.q: She can have been at the meeting, but I'm not sure.
exercises.answer: She may have been at the meeting, but I'm not sure.
exercises.explain: can have done 不用于肯定句的推测，应使用 may/might have done。

exercises.q: My little brother ______ ride a bike now, but he couldn't last year.
exercises.explain: can 后面直接跟动词原形，没有人称和数的变化。

exercises.q: ______ you help me carry this box, please?
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 构成疑问句时直接提前，不需要助动词 do/does。

exercises.q: She ______ speak three languages very well.
exercises.explain: can 表示能力，主语是第三人称单数时也不加 -s。

exercises.q: I'm sorry, but I ______ come to your party tomorrow.
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式是 cannot/can't，后面直接跟动词原形。

exercises.q: Birds ______ fly, but dogs ______.
exercises.explain: can 表示能力，否定用 can't，前后形成对比。

exercises.q: My grandpa is 80 years old, but he ______ still walk for an hour every day.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 表示能力，后面直接跟动词原形 walk。

exercises.q: ______ you swim across this river? It looks very wide.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 构成一般疑问句时放在句首。

exercises.q: We ______ hear you clearly. Please speak louder.
exercises.explain: 根据语境表示“不能听清”，用 can 的否定形式 can't。

exercises.q: He cans play the guitar very well.
exercises.explain: can 是情态动词，第三人称单数不加 -s，应为 He can play。

exercises.q: Can you to open the window?
exercises.explain: can 后面直接跟动词原形，不能加 to。

exercises.q: She can dance very well. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式是 can't，后面动词原形保持不变。

exercises.q: They can play basketball after school. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Can they play basketball after school?
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 构成疑问句时直接提前到主语前。

exercises.q: I can finish the work today. (用 be able to 改写，时态不变)
exercises.answer: I am able to finish the work today.
exercises.explain: can 表示能力时可与 be able to 互换，注意 be 动词要随主语变化。

exercises.q: My father cans cook delicious food.
exercises.answer: My father can cook delicious food.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 没有人称和数的变化，不能加 -s。

exercises.q: Do you can speak English?
exercises.explain: can 构成疑问句时直接提前，不需要助动词 Do。

exercises.q: When I was young, I ______ run very fast, but now I ______.
exercises.explain: could 表示过去的能力，can't 表示现在不具备该能力，形成时间对比。

exercises.q: You ______ be tired after such a long journey. Why not take a rest?
exercises.explain: must 在此表示很有把握的推测，意为“一定”，比 can 表示推测时语气更强。

exercises.q: ______ I borrow your dictionary for a moment? I forgot mine at home.
exercises.explain: May I... 表示礼貌地请求许可，比 Can I... 更正式。

exercises.q: She ______ be at home now because the lights are all off.
exercises.explain: can't 在此表示否定的推测，意为“不可能”，根据灯全灭可判断她不在家。

exercises.q: If you practice more, you ______ improve your spoken English quickly.
exercises.explain: can 在此表示可能性，条件句主句用 can 表示“能够、可以”。

exercises.q: He ______ have gone to Beijing, because I saw him in the library just now.
exercises.explain: can't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测，意为“不可能做过”。

exercises.q: ______ you please tell me the way to the nearest subway station?
exercises.explain: Could you please... 是比 Can you please... 更礼貌的请求表达。

exercises.q: With the help of the new software, we ______ finish the project two weeks earlier than planned.
exercises.explain: 表示过去具体某次成功做成某事时，用 were able to 而不用 could。

exercises.q: He could swim across the river when he was only six years old.
exercises.explain: could 表示过去具备的能力，句子语法和语义均正确。

exercises.q: She can be at home now, because I saw her go out ten minutes ago.
exercises.explain: 根据“十分钟前看见她出去”可知她现在不可能在家，应用 can't be 表示否定推测。

exercises.q: It is possible for him to finish the task alone. (用 can 改写)
exercises.answer: He can finish the task alone.
exercises.explain: It is possible for sb. to do sth. 可转换为 sb. can do sth.，表示可能性。

exercises.q: I was able to solve the math problem after thinking for an hour. (用 could 改写，保持意思基本不变)
exercises.answer: I could solve the math problem after thinking for an hour.
exercises.explain: 在表示过去具备的能力时，could 与 was/were able to 可以互换。

exercises.q: Can you tell me how to get to the museum? (改为更礼貌的表达)
exercises.answer: Could you tell me how to get to the museum?
exercises.explain: Could you... 比 Can you... 语气更委婉礼貌。

exercises.q: She mustn't be at the office now because her car is not in the parking lot.
exercises.answer: She can't be at the office now because her car is not in the parking lot.
exercises.explain: 表示否定推测“不可能”用 can't，mustn't 表示“禁止”，不用于推测。

exercises.q: He could finish the difficult task yesterday, so he was very happy.
exercises.answer: He was able to finish the difficult task yesterday, so he was very happy.
exercises.explain: 表示过去某次具体成功做成某事，用 was/were able to，不用 could。

exercises.q: Having practiced for months, the team ______ win the championship if they maintain their current form.
exercises.explain: can 在此表示具备实现某结果的能力或可能性，与条件句搭配合理。

exercises.q: The witness's account ______ be true, but we need more evidence to confirm it.
exercises.explain: may 表示不确定的推测，意为“可能”，与后文“需要更多证据”呼应。

exercises.q: ______ he have forgotten about the meeting? He seemed so well-prepared yesterday.
exercises.explain: Can he have done... 表示对过去情况的怀疑或惊讶，意为“他可能……吗”。

exercises.q: Given the complexity of the experiment, no single researcher ______ complete it without collaboration.
exercises.explain: can 在此表示在现有条件下具备的能力，主语为单数也不加 -s。

exercises.q: The ancient manuscript ______ be deciphered until scholars discovered the key to the code.
exercises.explain: couldn't 表示过去不具备某种能力，与 until 引导的时间状语从句搭配。

exercises.q: The results of the survey ______ be interpreted in several different ways, depending on the perspective.
exercises.explain: can 在此表示客观可能性，意为“可以、能够”。

exercises.q: If we had left earlier, we ______ have caught the last train.
exercises.explain: could have done 表示过去本可以做但未做，与虚拟条件句搭配。

exercises.q: Under no circumstances ______ the safety regulations be ignored in the laboratory.
exercises.explain: 否定状语置于句首时句子部分倒装，情态动词 can 提前到主语前。

exercises.q: He can't have attended the lecture yesterday, for he was in hospital at that time.
exercises.explain: can't have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测，与 for 引导的原因状语从句逻辑一致。

exercises.q: She must be able to speak French fluently after living in Paris for ten years.
exercises.explain: must 表示肯定推测，be able to 表示能力，两者连用表示“一定能够”。

exercises.q: It is impossible that he has finished the report in such a short time. (用 can't 改写)
exercises.answer: He can't have finished the report in such a short time.
exercises.explain: It is impossible that... 可转换为 can't have done，表示对过去情况的否定推测。

exercises.q: Perhaps she is waiting for us at the school gate. (用 may 改写)
exercises.answer: She may be waiting for us at the school gate.
exercises.explain: Perhaps 可转换为 may be doing，表示对现在正在进行的动作的推测。

exercises.q: I was not able to understand the professor's lecture because it was too abstract. (用 could 改写)
exercises.answer: I couldn't understand the professor's lecture because it was too abstract.
exercises.explain: 表示过去不具备某种能力时，couldn't 与 was not able to 可以互换。

exercises.q: He mustn't have known the truth, otherwise he would have told us.
exercises.answer: He couldn't have known the truth, otherwise he would have told us.
exercises.explain: 对过去情况的否定推测用 couldn't have done，mustn't 不用于推测。

exercises.q: The data suggests that the new drug can be effective in treating the disease, but further trials are needed.
exercises.answer: The data suggest that the new drug can be effective in treating the disease, but further trials are needed.
exercises.explain: data 是 datum 的复数形式，谓语动词应用 suggest，情态动词 can 用法正确。

grammar.title: 关系副词 where 引导的定语从句（含 such where、in which 等拓展）
grammar.usage:
核心结构：关系副词 where 在定语从句中作地点状语，相当于“介词 + which”。它引导的从句修饰表示地点的名词或抽象名词（如 point, case, situation, stage），从句内部必须是一个完整的句子，即主谓宾或主系表结构齐全。典型结构为：先行词（表地点的名词）+ where + 完整从句。例如：This is the house where I grew up.（这就是我长大的房子。）where 在从句中相当于 in the house。

肯定、否定和疑问形式：where 本身不参与肯定或否定，肯定与否定主要由从句谓语动词体现。肯定句如：I know a place where we can buy fresh bread. 否定句如：We need a place where there isn't too much noise. 疑问句如：Do you know a restaurant where we can have lunch? 注意疑问句中的 where 仍然引导定语从句，而不是疑问副词，判断依据是它前面有被修饰的名词。

与近义结构对比：where 与 which/that 的区别在于，which/that 在从句中作主语或宾语，where 只能作地点状语。如果先行词在从句中作 visited, saw, bought 等动词的宾语，就不能用 where，而要用 which/that，例如：This is the factory (that/which) I visited. 而不能说 This is the factory where I visited. where 与 in which 多数情况下可以互换，但 in which 更正式，且介词可能根据搭配变为 at which, on which 等。such where 属于较正式、书面化的结构，相当于 such a place where，但在日常口语和现代英语中比较少见。

初中用法 vs 高中用法：初中阶段主要学习 where 引导的定语从句，先行词多为具体地点名词，如 place, school, city, park, restaurant, house 等，从句说明在该地点发生的事情。高中阶段则扩展到抽象地点名词，如 point, case, situation, stage, position 等，表示“在某种情况、阶段、境地”，并进一步掌握介词 + which 的正式替换、such where 等书面语结构，以及 where 从句与地点状语从句的区分。

易错点：第一，不能仅凭先行词是地点名词就选 where，关键要看它在从句中作什么成分。第二，such where 结构较正式，高考书面表达中可以谨慎使用，但不要误用为 such which 或 such that where。第三，where 引导的定语从句与 where 引导的地点状语从句容易混淆：定语从句前有被修饰的名词，状语从句前没有先行词，例如：Stay where you are.（状语从句）对比：This is the place where I stay.（定语从句）。第四，在介词 + which 结构中，介词不能省略，也不能用 where 直接替换后再加介词。
forms: 先行词（地点名词）+ where + 完整从句（主谓宾/主系表齐全）
先行词（抽象地点名词：point, case, situation, stage 等）+ where + 完整从句
先行词 + 介词（in/at/on）+ which + 完整从句（相当于 where，更正式）
such + where + 完整从句（正式/书面语，相当于 such a place where）
the place where / a place where / the venue where + 完整从句
notes: 高考中常考抽象地点名词（如 point, case, situation, stage）后用 where 引导定语从句，表示“在……的地步、情况、阶段”，此时不能改用 which/that。
书面语或正式语体中，where 常可改写为 in/at/on which，但介词的选择必须符合先行词的搭配或语境。
such where 是较正式的文学性表达，高考作文中如使用需确保语域一致，不宜与口语化句子混用。
注意区分定语从句和地点状语从句：定语从句前必须有被修饰的名词，状语从句前是动词或整个主句。
先行词虽为地点名词，但若在从句中作宾语或主语，必须用 which/that，不能用 where。

examples.en: This is the park where we often play football.
examples.cn: 这就是我们经常踢足球的公园。

examples.en: Is there a shop where I can buy some postcards?
examples.cn: 有没有一家我能买到明信片的商店？

examples.en: She wants to find a quiet place where she can study without being disturbed.
examples.cn: 她想找一个安静的地方，在那里学习不会被打扰。

examples.en: We have reached a point where we must make a final decision.
examples.cn: 我们已经到了必须做出最后决定的地步。

examples.en: The situation where a student feels too anxious to speak in class is more common than we think.
examples.cn: 学生在课堂上因过于焦虑而不敢发言的情况比我们想象的更普遍。

examples.en: This is a formal occasion in which one is expected to behave with particular dignity, much like a state dinner where protocol takes precedence over personal preference.
examples.cn: 这是一种正式场合，在这种场合中人们应表现得格外庄重，很像国宴，礼节优先于个人偏好。

exercises.q: This is the park ______ we often play football.
exercises.explain: 先行词 park 是地点，从句中缺地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: I like the restaurant ______ my father works.
exercises.explain: restaurant 是地点，从句中 work 是不及物动词，缺地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: The school ______ I study is very big.
exercises.explain: study 在此表示“学习”，school 是地点，从句缺地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: This is the house ______ my uncle lives.
exercises.explain: live 是不及物动词，house 是地点，从句缺地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: Do you know a place ______ we can buy some fruit?
exercises.explain: place 是地点，从句中缺地点状语，用 where 引导定语从句。

exercises.q: This is the library ______ I often read books.
exercises.explain: library 是地点，从句缺地点状语，填 where。

exercises.q: That is the shop ______ my mother buys vegetables.
exercises.explain: shop 是地点，从句缺地点状语，填 where。

exercises.q: I want to visit the city ______ my grandparents live.
exercises.explain: city 是地点，live 是不及物动词，从句缺地点状语，填 where。

exercises.q: This is the room where I sleep every night.
exercises.explain: room 是地点，sleep 是不及物动词，where 在从句中作地点状语，句子正确。

exercises.q: This is the book where I bought yesterday.
exercises.explain: book 不是地点，且 bought 后缺宾语，不能用 where，应用 which/that。

exercises.q: This is the school. I study in this school. (用 where 合并句子)
exercises.answer: This is the school where I study.
exercises.explain: 用 where 代替 in this school，引导定语从句修饰 school。

exercises.q: That is the park. We play in the park. (用 where 合并句子)
exercises.answer: That is the park where we play.
exercises.explain: 用 where 代替 in the park，引导定语从句修饰 park。

exercises.q: This is the city. My aunt lives in the city. (用 where 合并句子)
exercises.answer: This is the city where my aunt lives.
exercises.explain: 用 where 代替 in the city，引导定语从句修饰 city。

exercises.q: This is the school which I study.
exercises.answer: This is the school where I study.
exercises.explain: study 在此是不及物动词，school 在从句中作地点状语，应用 where。

exercises.q: That is the shop which my mother buys fruit.
exercises.answer: That is the shop where my mother buys fruit.
exercises.explain: shop 在从句中作地点状语，应用 where，不能用 which。

exercises.q: The village ______ my father grew up is very quiet.
exercises.explain: village 是地点，grow up 是不及物动词短语，从句缺地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: This is the office ______ Mr. Li works.
exercises.explain: office 是地点，work 是不及物动词，从句缺地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: I will never forget the day ______ we first met.
exercises.explain: day 是时间，从句缺时间状语，用 when，不能用 where。

exercises.q: The museum ______ we visited last week is very famous.
exercises.explain: museum 在从句中作 visited 的宾语，不是地点状语，用 which。

exercises.q: This is the town ______ my best friend was born.
exercises.explain: town 是地点，be born 表示出生，从句缺地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: The hotel ______ we stayed last summer was near the sea.
exercises.explain: hotel 是地点，stay 是不及物动词，从句缺地点状语，填 where。

exercises.q: This is the classroom ______ we have English lessons.
exercises.explain: classroom 是地点，从句缺地点状语，填 where。

exercises.q: The factory ______ my uncle works makes cars.
exercises.explain: factory 是地点，work 是不及物动词，从句缺地点状语，填 where。

exercises.q: This is the cinema where we saw the film last night.
exercises.explain: cinema 是地点，从句缺地点状语，where 使用正确。

exercises.q: This is the cinema where we visited last night.
exercises.explain: visited 是及物动词，cinema 在从句中作宾语，应用 which/that，不能用 where。

exercises.q: This is the hospital. My mother works in the hospital. (用 where 合并句子)
exercises.answer: This is the hospital where my mother works.
exercises.explain: 用 where 代替 in the hospital，引导定语从句修饰 hospital。

exercises.q: That is the beach. We often swim at the beach. (用 where 合并句子)
exercises.answer: That is the beach where we often swim.
exercises.explain: 用 where 代替 at the beach，引导定语从句修饰 beach。

exercises.q: This is the library. I borrowed the book from the library. (用 where 合并句子)
exercises.answer: This is the library where I borrowed the book.
exercises.explain: 用 where 代替 from the library，引导定语从句修饰 library。

exercises.q: The house which my grandparents live is very old.
exercises.answer: The house where my grandparents live is very old.
exercises.explain: live 是不及物动词，house 在从句中作地点状语，应用 where。

exercises.q: This is the school which I study English.
exercises.answer: This is the school where I study English.
exercises.explain: school 在从句中作地点状语，应用 where，不能用 which。

exercises.q: The research center ______ the scientists are working is well equipped.
exercises.explain: research center 是地点，work 是不及物动词，从句缺地点状语，用 where。

exercises.q: This is the stage ______ the famous singer will perform.

grammar.title: 含情态动词的被动语态：can / could / may / might / must / should / ought to / have to 的拓展用法
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice with Modal Verbs: can, could, may, might, must, should, ought to, have to
grammar.usage:
含情态动词的被动语态用于表达“某事可以被做、必须被做、应该被做”等含义，同时将注意力放在动作的承受者上，而不是执行者。其核心结构为：情态动词 + be + 过去分词。其中 be 永远保持原形，不受主语人称和数的影响；过去分词由主要动词变化而来。

肯定句结构为“主语 + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词（+ by 短语）”，例如：The door must be locked at night. 否定句在情态动词后加 not，结构为“主语 + 情态动词 + not + be + 过去分词”，例如：Personal information should not be shared online. 疑问句将情态动词提至主语前，结构为“情态动词 + 主语 + be + 过去分词？”，例如：Can this machine be repaired? 回答时用“Yes, 主语 + 情态动词”或“No, 主语 + 情态动词 + not”。

与一般现在时被动语态（am/is/are + 过去分词）和一般过去时被动语态（was/were + 过去分词）不同，含情态动词的被动语态不直接表明动作发生的时间，而是表达说话人对动作的态度、判断或推测。例如“The work is done”表示工作已经完成这一事实，而“The work must be done”表示说话人认为工作必须被完成，带有强烈的主观色彩。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 can、must、should 三个情态动词的被动语态，且多用于规则、指令、要求等语境。高中阶段则进一步拓展到 may、might、could、ought to、have to、need 等情态动词的被动形式，并涉及“情态动词 + have been + 过去分词”表示对过去情况的推测或评价，例如：The letter may have been sent to the wrong address. 此外，高中还要求理解含情态动词被动语态在书面语、科技文、新闻、学术写作中的高频使用，以及它与形式主语 it 结构的转换关系。

易错点一：情态动词后漏掉 be，直接写过去分词，如“The work must done”是错误的，正确为“The work must be done”。易错点二：把 be 误写成 is/am/are/was/were，如“The rules can are changed”是错误的，情态动词后必须用动词原形 be。易错点三：否定形式中 not 的位置错误，not 应紧跟在情态动词之后，而不是 be 之后，如“The task should be not delayed”应改为“The task should not be delayed”。易错点四：混淆“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”与“情态动词 + have been + 过去分词”，前者针对现在或将来，后者针对过去，两者时间指向完全不同。
forms: 肯定式：主语 + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词（+ by + 执行者）
否定式：主语 + 情态动词 + not + be + 过去分词
一般疑问式：情态动词 + 主语 + be + 过去分词？
特殊疑问式：疑问词 + 情态动词 + 主语 + be + 过去分词？
过去推测式：主语 + 情态动词 + have been + 过去分词
there be 被动式：there + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词
notes: 情态动词后的 be 永远用原形，不能写成 is/am/are/was/were，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。
否定词 not 必须放在情态动词之后、be 之前，书面语中尤其要注意语序，不能写成 be not done。
may/might/could + have been + 过去分词 表示对过去情况的不确定推测，与 must have been done（肯定推测）和 can't have been done（否定推测）构成高考完形和阅读中的常见语义辨析点。
在科技文、新闻报道和学术写作中，含情态动词的被动语态常用来表达客观、严谨的立场，避免直接提及执行者，写作时可有意使用以提升语域。
ought to 和 have to 的被动语态分别为 ought to be done 和 have/has to be done，注意 ought to 的否定形式为 ought not to be done，to 不可省略。

exercises.explain: should not be ignored 是含情态动词的被动语态否定形式。

exercises.q: The possibility of getting hurt can is completely ruled out.
exercises.answer: The possibility of getting hurt can be completely ruled out.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后应接 be，不能接 is。

exercises.q: The safety rules must are followed by all workers.
exercises.answer: The safety rules must be followed by all workers.
exercises.explain: must 后应接 be，不能接 are。

exercises.q: The safety rules ______ by every visitor before entering the park.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 must 后接 be 加过去分词，构成含情态动词的被动语态。

exercises.q: This broken machine ______ immediately, or someone may get hurt.
exercises.explain: should 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“应该被修理”。

exercises.q: The final decision ______ by the manager tomorrow.
exercises.explain: will 是情态动词，后接 be 加过去分词构成被动语态。

exercises.q: Dangerous items ______ into the exhibition hall.
exercises.explain: 情态动词否定式 must not 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“禁止被带入”。

exercises.q: The windows ______ before the storm comes.
exercises.explain: can 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“能够被关上”。

exercises.q: The homework ______ (must / finish) before Friday.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 must 后接 be 加过去分词，构成被动语态。

exercises.q: These old photos ______ (can / keep) in this box.
exercises.explain: can 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“可以被保存”。

exercises.q: The report ______ (should / write) in English.
exercises.explain: should 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“应该被写”。

exercises.q: The sentence "The door can opened by this key." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后必须接 be 加过去分词，应改为 can be opened。

exercises.q: The sentence "The rules must be obeyed by everyone." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: must be obeyed 是含情态动词的被动语态，结构正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in passive voice: You must clean the room.
exercises.explain: 主动语态变被动语态时，宾语 the room 作主语，情态动词后接 be 加过去分词。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in passive voice: They can solve the problem.
exercises.explain: 宾语 the problem 变为主语，can 后接 be 加过去分词 solved。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in passive voice: We should water the plants every day.
exercises.answer: The plants should be watered every day.
exercises.explain: 宾语 the plants 作主语，should 后接 be 加过去分词 watered。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The letter can sent by email.
exercises.answer: The letter can be sent by email.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后缺少 be，应改为 can be sent。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The food must is cooked well.
exercises.answer: The food must be cooked well.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 must 后应接动词原形 be，而不是 is。

exercises.q: The injured player ______ off the field by the medical team a moment ago.
exercises.explain: had to 是 must 的过去式，后接 be 加过去分词，表示过去不得不被抬走。

exercises.q: These documents ______ in a safe place so that they won't be lost.
exercises.explain: ought to 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“应该被保存”。

exercises.q: The new bridge ______ by the end of next year.
exercises.explain: may 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“可能被完成”。

exercises.q: No mistakes ______ in the final copy of the report.
exercises.explain: should 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“应该被发现”，此处用否定表示“不应该有错误”。

exercises.q: The secret ______ by anyone outside the team.
exercises.explain: must not 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“禁止被泄露”。

exercises.q: The broken window ______ (have to / repair) before winter arrives.
exercises.explain: have to 后接 be 加过去分词，主语为单数，用 has to be repaired。

exercises.q: The results of the experiment ______ (can / predict) with this model.
exercises.explain: can 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“能够被预测”。

exercises.q: All the lights ______ (should / turn off) before leaving the lab.
exercises.explain: should 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“应该被关掉”。

exercises.q: The sentence "The project might be finished ahead of schedule." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: might be finished 是含情态动词 might 的被动语态，结构正确。

exercises.q: The sentence "These rules ought to be obey by all students." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: ought to 后应接 be 加过去分词 obeyed，而不是动词原形 obey。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in passive voice: The committee may discuss the proposal next week.
exercises.answer: The proposal may be discussed by the committee next week.
exercises.explain: 宾语 the proposal 作主语，may 后接 be 加过去分词 discussed。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in passive voice: They ought to have checked the equipment before the test.
exercises.answer: The equipment ought to have been checked before the test.
exercises.explain: ought to 后接 have been 加过去分词，表示过去本应被检查。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in passive voice: You must not leave the door unlocked.
exercises.answer: The door must not be left unlocked.
exercises.explain: 宾语 the door 作主语，must not 后接 be 加过去分词 left。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The package should be deliver by noon.
exercises.answer: The package should be delivered by noon.
exercises.explain: should be 后应接过去分词 delivered，而不是动词原形 deliver。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: These files can be access only by authorized staff.
exercises.answer: These files can be accessed only by authorized staff.
exercises.explain: can be 后应接过去分词 accessed，而不是名词 access。

exercises.q: Given the complexity of the procedure, it is essential that every step ______ with extreme caution.
exercises.explain: 在 it is essential that 引导的主语从句中，谓语用虚拟语气，即动词原形 be 加过去分词。

exercises.q: The committee insisted that the outdated regulations ______ at the earliest opportunity.
exercises.explain: insist 表示“坚持要求”时，宾语从句用虚拟语气，即 be 加过去分词。

exercises.q: Had the safety measures been strictly enforced, the accident ______.
exercises.explain: 对过去情况的虚拟，主句用 could have been 加过去分词，表示“本可以被避免”。

exercises.q: The proposal, once ______ by the board, will be implemented without delay.
exercises.explain: once 引导的省略状语从句中，主语与主句一致且为被动关系，用过去分词 approved。

exercises.q: It is imperative that no unauthorized personnel ______ access to the restricted area.
exercises.explain: it is imperative that 引导的主语从句用虚拟语气，be 加过去分词表示被动。

exercises.q: The evidence suggests that the document ______ (must / forge) sometime in the 1990s.
exercises.explain: must have been 加过去分词表示对过去情况的肯定推测，且为被动语态。

exercises.q: Under no circumstances ______ (should / compromise) the safety standards.
exercises.answer: should the safety standards be compromised
exercises.explain: 否定状语置于句首引起部分倒装，should 后接主语再接 be 加过去分词。

exercises.q: The theory, though widely criticized, ______ (cannot / dismiss) entirely.
exercises.explain: cannot 后接 be 加过去分词，表示“不能被完全否定”。

exercises.q: The sentence "The data need not be processed manually." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: need not 后接 be 加过去分词，构成含情态动词的被动语态，结构正确。

exercises.q: The sentence "The proposal is to be reconsidered at the next meeting." is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: be to 结构表示将来安排，后接 be 加过去分词构成被动语态，结构正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using passive voice with a modal verb: It is possible that the ancient artifacts were stolen by organized criminals.
exercises.answer: The ancient artifacts may have been stolen by organized criminals.
exercises.explain: may have been 加过去分词表示对过去情况的可能性推测，且为被动语态。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using passive voice with a modal verb: The regulations require that all visitors register at the front desk.
exercises.answer: All visitors are required to register at the front desk.
exercises.explain: require 的被动语态 are required 后接不定式，表达规定要求。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using passive voice with a modal verb: People should not take photographs inside the museum.
exercises.answer: Photographs should not be taken inside the museum.
exercises.explain: 宾语 photographs 作主语，should not 后接 be 加过去分词 taken。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The results of the survey are to be analyze by an independent agency.
exercises.answer: The results of the survey are to be analyzed by an independent agency.
exercises.explain: be to 后接 be 加过去分词，analyze 应改为过去分词 analyzed。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: It is crucial that the error be corrected before the report is submitted, but it needn't be mention to the whole team.
exercises.answer: It is crucial that the error be corrected before the report is submitted, but it needn't be mentioned to the whole team.
exercises.explain: needn't be 后应接过去分词 mentioned，而不是动词原形 mention。

grammar.title: so 引导的结果状语从句（含 so / so that / because 辨析）
grammar.titleEn: Result Clauses with 'so' (vs. so that / because)
grammar.usage:
so 引导结果状语从句时，表示“因此、所以”，用来引出前面情况所导致的自然结果或实际后果。其核心结构为：原因分句 + so + 结果分句。so 是并列连词，连接两个在逻辑上具有因果关系的分句，前一分句说明原因或条件，后一分句说明由此产生的结果。

肯定句结构为“原因分句 + so + 结果分句”，否定句和疑问句的变化主要体现在结果分句内部，so 本身不参与否定或疑问的构成。例如否定结果时，在结果分句的谓语部分加否定词；疑问句则对结果分句进行提问。so 引导结果状语从句时，通常位于句首的原因分句之后，不能置于句首单独引导结果。

so 与 so that 是高中阶段最易混淆的一组结构。so 引导结果状语从句，表示“因此、所以”，强调已经发生或必然发生的结果；so that 引导目的状语从句，表示“为了、以便”，强调主观意图和目的，且目的状语从句中常含有情态动词 can / could / may / might / will / would。此外，so...that... 是另一个独立结构，表示“如此……以至于……”，其中 so 修饰形容词或副词，that 引导结果状语从句，与单独使用 so 连接两个分句的结构不同。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 so 表示“所以”的基本用法，并能与 because 进行简单辨析。高中阶段则进一步要求：第一，在书面表达中准确区分 so（结果）与 so that（目的），避免混用；第二，理解 so 在语篇中的逻辑衔接功能，能够判断前后句的因果关系是否成立；第三，掌握 so...that... 与 such...that... 的转换关系，以及 so...that... 结构中 so 置于句首时的倒装现象。

易错点一：because 与 so 不能同时出现在同一个句子中。英语中一个句子只能有一个表示因果关系的连词，because 引导原因状语从句时，主句前不能再加 so。易错点二：so 与 so that 的语义混淆。判断标准是看从句表达的是“实际结果”还是“主观目的”。易错点三：so...that... 结构中 that 在口语或非正式文体中可以省略，但在书面语中建议保留，以免造成结构不清。易错点四：so 作为连词连接两个分句时，前面通常用逗号与原因分句隔开；但在较短的句子中，逗号可以省略。
forms: 原因分句 + so + 结果分句（肯定式）
原因分句 + so + 结果分句（否定式：结果分句谓语加 not/never）
原因分句 + so + 结果分句（疑问式：对结果分句进行提问）
so + 形容词/副词 + that + 结果状语从句（so...that... 结构）
so + 形容词 + a/an + 单数可数名词 + that 从句（书面语/正式语体）
so + many/few + 复数名词 + that 从句 / so + much/little + 不可数名词 + that 从句
notes: because 与 so 不可连用：英语中一个句子只能保留一个因果连词，because 引导原因状语从句时，主句前不能再加 so。高考短文改错和语法填空中常以此设置陷阱。
so 与 so that 的语域差异：so 引导结果状语从句，语气直接、口语化；so that 引导目的状语从句，书面语色彩更强，且从句中常出现情态动词 can/could/may/might。高考书面表达中应根据语境选择。
so...that... 与 such...that... 的转换：so 修饰形容词或副词，such 修饰名词。当名词前有 many/much/few/little 等表示数量的词时，只能用 so，不能用 such。这是高考语法填空的高频考点。
so...that... 结构中 so 置于句首时，主句需部分倒装。例如：So fast did he run that nobody could catch him. 这种倒装结构属于高中书面语中的高级表达，适用于高考写作提分。
so 连接两个分句时，逗号的使用在正式书面语中较为规范，但在新闻标题、广告语等简洁语域中可以省略逗号。高考写作中建议保留逗号以体现逻辑清晰。

examples.en: I was tired, so I went to bed early.
examples.cn: 我累了，所以早早上床睡觉了。

examples.en: The bus was late, so we had to wait for a long time.
examples.cn: 公交车晚点了，所以我们不得不等了很长时间。

examples.en: He didn't bring his umbrella, so he got wet in the rain.
examples.cn: 他没有带伞，所以被雨淋湿了。

examples.en: The traffic was extremely heavy, so we missed our flight.
examples.cn: 交通极其拥堵，所以我们错过了航班。

examples.en: She spoke so quietly that hardly anyone could hear her.
examples.cn: 她说话声音如此之轻，以至于几乎没有人能听见她。

examples.en: So convincing was his argument that the committee unanimously approved the proposal.
examples.cn: 他的论证如此有说服力，以至于委员会一致通过了这项提案。

exercises.q: I was hungry, ______ I ate a sandwich.
exercises.explain: so 连接原因和结果，表示“所以”。

exercises.q: The box was heavy, ______ Tom asked for help.
exercises.explain: 前因“箱子重”导致结果“求助”，用 so。

exercises.q: It was very cold, ______ we stayed inside.
exercises.explain: 天气冷是原因，待在家里是结果，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: She was tired, ______ she went to bed early.
exercises.explain: 累了所以早睡，so 表示结果。

exercises.q: The movie was boring, ______ we left early.
exercises.explain: 电影无聊导致提前离开，用 so 表结果。

exercises.q: He was late, ______ he ran to school.
exercises.explain: 迟到是原因，跑着去是结果，填 so。

exercises.q: The bag was full, ______ I couldn't put more books in it.
exercises.explain: 包满了所以放不下更多书，用 so 连接结果。

exercises.q: She didn't feel well, ______ she saw a doctor.
exercises.explain: 不舒服所以去看医生，填 so。

exercises.q: The sentence "It rained, so we took an umbrella." means we took an umbrella because it rained.
exercises.explain: so 表示结果，带伞是下雨的结果。

exercises.q: In the sentence "He was hungry, so he ate lunch.", the word "so" means "because".
exercises.explain: so 表示“所以”，because 表示“因为”，意思不同。

exercises.q: I was thirsty. I drank some water. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: I was thirsty, so I drank some water.
exercises.explain: 用 so 连接原因和结果两个分句。

exercises.q: The bus was late. We waited at the station. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The bus was late, so we waited at the station.
exercises.explain: 前因后果用 so 连接。

exercises.q: She lost her key. She couldn't open the door. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: She lost her key, so she couldn't open the door.
exercises.explain: 丢钥匙导致开不了门，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: Because it was cold, so I wore a coat.
exercises.answer: Because it was cold, I wore a coat. / It was cold, so I wore a coat.
exercises.explain: because 和 so 不能同时使用，二者选一。

exercises.q: He was tired, because he went to bed.
exercises.answer: He was tired, so he went to bed.
exercises.explain: 累是原因，睡觉是结果，应用 so 而非 because。

exercises.q: The music was too loud, ______ we couldn't hear each other.
exercises.explain: 音乐太响导致听不见，so 表结果。

exercises.q: He studied hard, ______ he passed the exam easily.
exercises.explain: 努力是原因，通过是结果，用 so。

exercises.q: The road was icy, ______ the car skidded off the road.
exercises.explain: 路面结冰导致车打滑，so 表结果。

exercises.q: She forgot her umbrella, ______ she got wet in the rain.
exercises.explain: 忘带伞所以淋湿了，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: The store was closed, ______ we went home.
exercises.explain: 商店关门所以回家，so 表结果。

exercises.q: He didn't set his alarm, ______ he overslept.
exercises.explain: 没设闹钟导致睡过头，填 so。

exercises.q: The tickets were sold out, ______ we couldn't see the show.
exercises.explain: 票卖完了所以看不了演出，用 so。

exercises.q: She practiced every day, ______ she improved quickly.
exercises.explain: 每天练习所以进步快，填 so。

exercises.q: The sentence "He ran fast, so he caught the bus." means he caught the bus because he ran fast.
exercises.explain: 跑得快是原因，赶上公交是结果。

exercises.q: In "She was ill, so she stayed home.", the word "so" can be replaced by "because" without changing the meaning.
exercises.explain: so 表结果，because 表原因，不能互换。

exercises.q: The weather was bad. The match was cancelled. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The weather was bad, so the match was cancelled.
exercises.explain: 天气差导致比赛取消，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: He didn't have enough money. He couldn't buy the book. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: He didn't have enough money, so he couldn't buy the book.
exercises.explain: 钱不够所以买不了书，so 表结果。

exercises.q: The computer crashed. I lost all my work. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The computer crashed, so I lost all my work.
exercises.explain: 电脑崩溃导致工作丢失，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: Because the traffic was heavy, so we arrived late.
exercises.answer: Because the traffic was heavy, we arrived late. / The traffic was heavy, so we arrived late.
exercises.explain: because 和 so 不能同时出现在一个句子中。

exercises.q: She was very happy, because she smiled all day.
exercises.answer: She was very happy, so she smiled all day.
exercises.explain: 开心是原因，笑是结果，应用 so。

exercises.q: The instructions were unclear, ______ many participants made mistakes.
exercises.explain: 指令不清导致参与者犯错，so 表结果。

exercises.q: He had been working for twelve hours straight, ______ he was completely exhausted.
exercises.explain: 连续工作导致精疲力竭，用 so 连接结果。

exercises.q: The evidence was insufficient, ______ the case was dismissed.
exercises.explain: 证据不足导致案件被驳回，so 表结果。

exercises.q: The company suffered heavy losses, ______ it had to lay off many employees.
exercises.explain: 亏损导致裁员，so 连接因果。

exercises.q: The bridge was damaged in the storm, ______ all traffic was diverted.
exercises.explain: 桥损坏导致交通改道，用 so 表结果。

exercises.q: The experiment failed repeatedly, ______ the researchers decided to change their approach.
exercises.explain: 实验反复失败所以改变方法，填 so。

exercises.q: He had forgotten his password, ______ he couldn't access his account.
exercises.explain: 忘记密码导致无法登录，用 so。

exercises.q: The deadline was approaching fast, ______ the team worked overtime.
exercises.explain: 截止日期临近所以加班，填 so。

exercises.q: In the sentence "The software had a critical bug, so the release was postponed.", the result clause is "the release was postponed".
exercises.explain: so 后面是结果分句，表示发布被推迟。

exercises.q: The sentence "He was so tired that he fell asleep immediately" uses "so" to introduce a result clause in the same way as "He was tired, so he fell asleep."
exercises.explain: so...that 是固定结构表程度结果，与单独 so 连接分句不同。

exercises.q: The flight was overbooked. Several passengers were asked to take a later flight. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The flight was overbooked, so several passengers were asked to take a later flight.
exercises.explain: 超售导致乘客被要求改签，用 so 连接。

exercises.q: The company failed to meet its targets. The CEO resigned. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The company failed to meet its targets, so the CEO resigned.
exercises.explain: 未达标导致 CEO 辞职，so 表结果。

exercises.q: The data was corrupted. The analysis had to be redone from scratch. (用 so 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The data was corrupted, so the analysis had to be redone from scratch.

grammar.key: Present Simple Tense for General Facts/Habits
grammar.title: 一般现在时：客观事实、习惯与普遍状态（拓展：与现在进行时、情态动词被动搭配）
grammar.titleEn: Present Simple Tense for General Facts, Habits and General States
grammar.usage:
一般现在时主要用来表达普遍真理、客观事实、经常性或习惯性的动作，以及当前一段时期内相对稳定的状态。其核心结构为“主语 + 动词原形/动词第三人称单数形式 + 其他”。当主语是第三人称单数（he/she/it 或单数名词）时，行为动词需要加 -s 或 -es；be 动词则根据主语分别使用 am/is/are。肯定句中动词形式随主语变化，否定句和疑问句需要借助助动词 do/does 构成，此时助动词已经体现人称和数，后面的实义动词必须恢复原形。例如肯定句“She likes music.”，否定句是“She does not/doesn't like music.”，疑问句是“Does she like music?”。

在初中阶段，一般现在时主要考查第三人称单数动词变化、do/does 的基本用法以及 always、usually、often、sometimes、every day 等频率副词或时间状语的搭配。进入高中阶段后，一般现在时往往不再单独作为简单考点出现，而是与情态动词、被动语态、定语从句、主语从句等结构结合，用来表达普遍性判断、客观评价或长期有效的观点。例如“Weekends are a special time that shouldn't be wasted easily.”中，主句“Weekends are...”用一般现在时说明普遍事实，从句中“shouldn't be wasted”则是情态动词被动结构，表达的是一种普遍性建议，而不是一次性动作。

与现在进行时相比，一般现在时强调常态、习惯或事实，而现在进行时强调说话时正在发生或现阶段暂时进行的动作。例如“He usually plays basketball after school.”表示习惯，而“He is playing basketball now.”表示此刻正在发生。部分动词如 know、believe、like、want、belong 等表示心理状态、情感或所属关系，通常只用于一般现在时，不用于进行时。

易错点一：第三人称单数动词变化规则掌握不牢，尤其以辅音字母加 y 结尾的动词要变 y 为 i 再加 -es，如 study→studies，但 play→plays。易错点二：否定句和疑问句中用了 does/do 后，实义动词仍误加 -s/-es，如“He doesn't likes...”是错误的。易错点三：在复合句或含有情态动词的被动结构中，误把整个结构都写成过去时或进行时，忽略了普遍事实和一般性观点应使用一般现在时。易错点四：把表示客观事实的句子与表示一次性安排或临时情况的句子混用，例如描述自然规律、科学结论时应使用一般现在时，而不是现在进行时或一般将来时。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + 动词原形/动词第三人称单数形式 + 其他。（I/You/We/They work. He/She/It works.）
否定句：主语 + do/does + not + 动词原形 + 其他。（I don't work. He doesn't work.）
一般疑问句：Do/Does + 主语 + 动词原形 + 其他？（Do you work? Does she work?）
be 动词一般现在时：主语 + am/is/are + 表语。（Weekends are a special time.）
情态动词被动结构：主语 + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词。（Weekends shouldn't be wasted easily.）
频率副词位置：主语 + 频率副词 + 动词；be 动词后接频率副词。（She usually goes by bus. He is always late.）
notes: 高考书面表达中，描述图表、社会现象或普遍规律时，应优先使用一般现在时，避免随意切换成过去时或将来时。
在“It is important/necessary/natural that...”等主语从句结构中，从句常用一般现在时表达普遍观点，注意不要因主句时态变化而误改从句时态。
情态动词被动结构“shouldn't be wasted”表达的是一般性建议，不是过去发生的事，语域上属于正式书面语，适合议论文或说明文。
一般现在时与现在进行时在语域上有分工：正式说明、定义、科学结论用一般现在时；口语中描述眼前临时动作才用进行时。
第三人称单数动词变化中，以 -ch、-sh、-s、-x、-o 结尾的动词加 -es，如 teach→teaches、go→goes，高考语法填空常考此类拼写。
