exercises.q: He go to school at seven o'clock.
exercises.explain: 主语 he 是第三人称单数，go 应改为 goes。

exercises.q: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
exercises.explain: 表示自然规律用一般现在时，主语 water 不可数名词视为单数。

exercises.q: She likes apples. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: 一般现在时第三人称单数否定句用 does not，动词恢复原形。

exercises.q: They play basketball after school. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Do they play basketball after school?
exercises.explain: 一般现在时复数主语疑问句用 Do 开头，动词用原形。

exercises.q: He goes to the park on Sundays. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Does he go to the park on Sundays?
exercises.explain: 第三人称单数疑问句用 Does 开头，动词恢复原形。

exercises.q: My mother cook dinner every day.
exercises.answer: My mother cooks dinner every day.
exercises.explain: 主语 my mother 是第三人称单数，cook 应改为 cooks。

exercises.q: Does she likes reading books?
exercises.explain: Does 后面的动词要用原形，likes 应改为 like。

exercises.q: By the time he arrives, the meeting ______ already started.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时表将来，主句用将来完成时。

exercises.q: She always ______ her homework before watching TV.
exercises.explain: always 表示习惯性动作，主语 she 是第三人称单数。

exercises.q: The teacher told us that the earth ______ around the sun.
exercises.explain: 宾语从句中表示客观真理，即使主句是过去时，从句仍用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
exercises.explain: 条件状语从句中用一般现在时表示将来。

exercises.q: My sister ______ to music every night before she goes to bed.
exercises.explain: every night 表示经常性习惯，主语 my sister 是第三人称单数。

exercises.q: The train ______ (leave) at 8:00 every morning.
exercises.explain: 表示按时刻表发生的动作，用一般现在时，主语 the train 是第三人称单数。

exercises.q: He usually ______ (not eat) breakfast at home.
exercises.explain: usually 表示习惯，主语 he 是第三人称单数，否定用 does not。

exercises.q: Light ______ (travel) faster than sound.
exercises.explain: 表示客观真理用一般现在时，主语 light 是第三人称单数。

exercises.q: She don't like playing the piano.
exercises.explain: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，don't 应改为 doesn't。

exercises.q: The museum opens at nine o'clock every day.
exercises.explain: 表示经常性安排或时刻表，用一般现在时，主语 the museum 是单数。

exercises.q: He often plays computer games after school. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: He does not often play computer games after school.
exercises.explain: 第三人称单数否定句用 does not，动词恢复原形。

exercises.q: She is a teacher. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: be 动词的一般现在时疑问句将 be 提到主语前。

exercises.q: My father reads newspapers every morning. (对划线部分提问)
exercises.answer: What does your father do every morning?
exercises.explain: 对动作提问用 what，第三人称单数疑问句用 does，动词恢复原形。

exercises.q: The children doesn't like vegetables.
exercises.explain: 主语 the children 是复数，否定用 don't 而不是 doesn't。

exercises.q: My brother and I goes to the same school.
exercises.answer: My brother and I go to the same school.
exercises.explain: 主语 my brother and I 是复数，动词用原形 go。

exercises.q: The fact that water ______ at 100 degrees Celsius is known to all.
exercises.explain: 同位语从句中表示客观真理，用一般现在时，主语 water 不可数。

exercises.q: It is essential that every student ______ the safety rules before entering the lab.
exercises.explain: 在 It is essential that 句型中，从句用虚拟语气，动词用原形。

exercises.q: Hardly ______ when the phone rang.
exercises.explain: Hardly...when 句型中，主句用过去完成时且部分倒装。

exercises.q: The scientist claimed that no one ______ the experiment before him.
exercises.explain: 主句用一般过去时，从句动作发生在主句之前，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: Not until he finished his homework ______ to play outside.
exercises.explain: Not until 置于句首，主句要部分倒装。

exercises.q: It is the first time that I ______ (visit) the Great Wall.
exercises.explain: It is the first time that 句型中，从句用现在完成时。

exercises.q: By the end of last year, they ______ (complete) the project.
exercises.explain: by the end of last year 表示到过去某时间为止，用过去完成时。

exercises.q: The teacher demanded that every student ______ (submit) the assignment on time.
exercises.explain: demand 后的宾语从句用虚拟语气，动词用原形。

exercises.q: It is high time that we take measures to protect the environment.
exercises.explain: It is high time that 句型中，从句动词要用过去式或 should 加动词原形。

exercises.q: The news that our team won the championship excited everyone.
exercises.explain: that 引导同位语从句解释 news 的内容，从句时态与主句一致。

exercises.q: He said, "I have finished my homework." (改为间接引语)
exercises.answer: He said that he had finished his homework.
exercises.explain: 直接引语变间接引语时，现在完成时要改为过去完成时。

exercises.q: She is too young to go to school. (改为同义句)
exercises.answer: She is so young that she cannot go to school.
exercises.explain: too...to 结构可转换为 so...that 从句，表示否定含义。

exercises.q: They didn't realize the importance of the problem until they faced it. (改为倒装句)
exercises.answer: Not until they faced it did they realize the importance of the problem.
exercises.explain: Not until 置于句首，主句部分倒装。

exercises.q: The teacher suggested that we went to the library more often.
exercises.answer: The teacher suggested that we go to the library more often.
exercises.explain: suggest 表示建议时，宾语从句用虚拟语气，动词用原形。

exercises.q: It was not until midnight when he came back home.
exercises.answer: It was not until midnight that he came back home.
exercises.explain: 强调句结构 It was...that...，不能用 when。

grammar.title: “越来越……”比较级递进结构：-er and -er / more and more（拓展至比较级连用与语域差异）
grammar.titleEn: Comparative Structure with 'and': -er and -er / more and more
grammar.usage:
本语法点核心结构为“比较级 + and + 比较级”，用来表达某一性质在程度上的持续增强或变化，相当于汉语的“越来越……”。该结构可细分为两类：单音节及部分双音节形容词、副词用“-er and -er”形式，如 closer and closer, faster and faster；多音节或部分双音节形容词、副词则用“more and more + 原级”形式，如 more and more beautiful, more and more carefully。

肯定句直接使用该结构作表语、状语或定语，例如：The city is becoming more and more modern. 否定句通常在谓语部分否定，而不是否定比较级本身，例如：It isn't getting any colder. 或 The situation is not becoming more and more serious. 疑问句则借助助动词或系动词提前，例如：Is the problem becoming more and more serious? 注意该结构本身不因疑问或否定而改变形式。

与近义结构对比：本结构强调“同一性质程度不断加深”，而“比较级 + than”强调两者之间的比较，例如 He is taller than his brother 并不表示“越来越高”。另外，“the + 比较级, the + 比较级”结构表示“越……就越……”，强调两个变化之间的关联，如 The more you practice, the better you become，与本结构侧重点不同。

初中阶段主要要求掌握常见单音节形容词的“-er and -er”形式以及“more and more + 多音节形容词”的基本用法，多用于描述天气、人物感受等日常话题。高中阶段则进一步要求：在书面表达中灵活运用该结构描写趋势、变化过程；注意与副词连用，如 work more and more efficiently；理解该结构在正式语体中的替代表达，如 increasingly + 形容词，以提升表达的多样性和正式度。

易错点：一是忘记双写末尾辅音字母，如 big 应变为 bigger and bigger，而不是 biger and biger；二是把多音节形容词误加 -er，如不能说 beautifuler and beautifuler；三是混淆“more and more + 原级”与“more + 比较级”的搭配，如不能说 more and more better；四是在否定句中误把比较级变成原级，例如不能说 It isn't getting colder and colder 而应说 It isn't getting any colder。
forms: 单音节形容词/副词：adj./adv.-er + and + adj./adv.-er（如 faster and faster）
多音节形容词/副词：more and more + adj./adv. 原级（如 more and more important）
表语用法：主语 + 系动词 + 比较级 and 比较级（如 The noise is getting louder and louder）
状语用法：主语 + 谓语 + more and more + 副词原级（如 She speaks more and more fluently）
定语用法：more and more + 形容词原级 + 名词（如 more and more people）
正式书面语替代：increasingly + 形容词原级（如 increasingly difficult）
notes: 高考书面表达中，连续使用“more and more”容易显得重复，可适当替换为 increasingly、growingly 等副词，提升语域正式度。
注意“more and more + 名词”结构中的名词通常为可数名词复数或不可数名词，如 more and more students，而不是 more and more student。
该结构强调同一主体的程度变化，不要与“比较级 + than”的双方比较混用；若句中出现 than，则不能再用 and 连接两个比较级。
部分双音节形容词有两种比较级形式，如 clever → cleverer / more clever，但在“越来越……”结构中通常只取一种，避免混搭，如不说 more and more cleverer。
在正式书面语中，该结构多用于描述趋势、变化过程，不宜用于静态事实描述，如不宜说 The mountain is higher and higher 来表示山本身很高。

examples.en: The weather is getting colder and colder.
examples.cn: 天气变得越来越冷。

examples.en: She became more and more confident as she practiced.
examples.cn: 随着练习，她变得越来越自信。

examples.en: More and more people are choosing to work from home.
examples.cn: 越来越多的人选择在家工作。

examples.en: As the exam approached, he studied more and more efficiently.
examples.cn: 随着考试临近，他学习效率越来越高。

examples.en: The gap between urban and rural areas is becoming increasingly narrow.
examples.cn: 城乡之间的差距正变得越来越小。

examples.en: With the advancement of technology, our reliance on digital devices has grown more and more profound.
examples.cn: 随着技术的进步，我们对数字设备的依赖变得越来越深。

exercises.q: The weather is getting ______ and ______ in spring.
exercises.explain: 单音节形容词 warm 的比较级是 warmer，用“比较级+and+比较级”表示“越来越暖和”。

exercises.q: My little brother is growing ______ and ______.
exercises.explain: tall 是单音节形容词，比较级为 taller，表示“越来越高”。

exercises.q: The car runs ______ and ______.
exercises.explain: fast 的比较级是 faster，用“比较级+and+比较级”表示“越来越快”。

exercises.q: Our school is becoming ______ and ______.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词 beautiful 要用“more and more + 形容词原级”表示“越来越美丽”。

exercises.q: The baby is getting ______ and ______ every day.
exercises.explain: big 是重读闭音节，双写 g 再加 er，表示“越来越大”。

exercises.q: The days are getting ______ and ______ in summer.
exercises.explain: long 的比较级是 longer，表示“越来越长”。

exercises.q: English is becoming ______ and ______ important.
exercises.explain: important 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 原级”表示“越来越重要”。

exercises.q: The city is getting ______ and ______ crowded.
exercises.explain: crowded 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 原级”表示“越来越拥挤”。

exercises.q: The sentence "It is getting colder and colder." means the temperature is going down.
exercises.explain: colder and colder 表示“越来越冷”，即温度在下降。

exercises.q: We can say "more and more taller" to mean someone is growing.
exercises.explain: taller 已经是比较级，不能再加 more，正确形式是 taller and taller。

exercises.q: The tree is growing tall. (用“越来越……”改写)
exercises.answer: The tree is growing taller and taller.
exercises.explain: 用“比较级+and+比较级”结构把 tall 改成 taller and taller。

exercises.q: The music is becoming loud. (用“越来越……”改写)
exercises.answer: The music is becoming louder and louder.
exercises.explain: loud 的比较级是 louder，表示“越来越大声”。

exercises.q: The story is getting interesting. (用“越来越……”改写)
exercises.answer: The story is getting more and more interesting.
exercises.explain: interesting 是多音节形容词，用 more and more interesting 表示“越来越有趣”。

exercises.q: The box is getting more and more heavy.
exercises.answer: The box is getting heavier and heavier.
exercises.explain: heavy 是双音节形容词，比较级为 heavier，不用 more。

exercises.q: She is becoming more and more busier.
exercises.answer: She is becoming busier and busier.
exercises.explain: busier 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: With the development of technology, our life is becoming ______ and ______ convenient.
exercises.explain: convenient 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 原级”表示“越来越方便”。

exercises.q: The young man practiced speaking English every day, and his pronunciation got ______ and ______.
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是 better，表示“越来越好”。

exercises.q: As the exam was coming, Mary felt ______ and ______ nervous.
exercises.explain: nervous 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 原级”表示“越来越紧张”。

exercises.q: The little girl is becoming ______ and ______ confident when she speaks in public.
exercises.explain: confident 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 原级”表示“越来越自信”。

exercises.q: The river near our village is getting ______ and ______ because of pollution.
exercises.explain: dirty 的比较级是 dirtier，表示“越来越脏”。

exercises.q: As winter comes, the nights become ______ and ______.
exercises.explain: long 的比较级是 longer，表示“越来越长”。

exercises.q: The problem seems to be getting ______ and ______ serious.
exercises.explain: serious 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 原级”表示“越来越严重”。

exercises.q: With more practice, his handwriting is becoming ______ and ______.
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是 better，表示“越来越好”。

exercises.q: The phrase "more and more people" means the number of people is increasing.
exercises.explain: more and more 修饰名词 people，表示“越来越多的人”。

exercises.q: We can say "The weather is getting more and more hot" in standard English.
exercises.explain: hot 是单音节形容词，比较级为 hotter，正确形式是 hotter and hotter。

exercises.q: The city is becoming noisy. (用“越来越……”改写)
exercises.answer: The city is becoming noisier and noisier.
exercises.explain: noisy 的比较级是 noisier，表示“越来越吵闹”。

exercises.q: People are using smartphones in their daily life. The number is increasing. (合并为一句，用“越来越……”)
exercises.answer: More and more people are using smartphones in their daily life.
exercises.explain: 用 more and more 修饰名词 people，表示“越来越多的人”。

exercises.q: The situation is becoming difficult. (用“越来越……”改写)
exercises.answer: The situation is becoming more and more difficult.
exercises.explain: difficult 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 原级”表示“越来越困难”。

exercises.q: The traffic is getting more and more bad in big cities.
exercises.answer: The traffic is getting worse and worse in big cities.
exercises.explain: bad 的比较级是 worse，正确形式是 worse and worse。

exercises.q: She is becoming more and more happier with her new job.
exercises.answer: She is becoming happier and happier with her new job.
exercises.explain: happier 已经是比较级，不能再加 more。

exercises.q: As artificial intelligence develops, machines are playing a ______ and ______ important role in our daily lives.
exercises.explain: important 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 原级”表示“越来越重要”。

exercises.q: The gap between the rich and the poor in some areas is becoming ______ and ______, which worries many economists.
exercises.explain: wide 的比较级是 wider，表示“越来越大”。

exercises.q: With the spread of the Internet, information travels ______ and ______ than ever before.
exercises.explain: fast 的比较级是 faster，表示“越来越快”。

exercises.q: The environmental problems in some regions are getting ______ and ______ serious, so immediate action should be taken.
exercises.explain: serious 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 原级”表示“越来越严重”。

exercises.q: As the global population continues to grow, the demand for natural resources becomes ______ and ______ urgent.
exercises.explain: urgent 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 原级”表示“越来越紧迫”。

exercises.q: As the competition in the job market intensifies, young people are becoming ______ and ______ anxious about their future.
exercises.explain: anxious 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 原级”表示“越来越焦虑”。

exercises.q: The relationship between the two countries is getting ______ and ______ complicated.
exercises.explain: complicated 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 原级”表示“越来越复杂”。

exercises.q: With the rapid development of online education, learning resources are becoming ______ and ______ accessible.
exercises.explain: accessible 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 原级”表示“越来越容易获取”。

exercises.q: In the sentence "The situation is becoming increasingly difficult", the word "increasingly" has a similar meaning to "more and more".
exercises.explain: increasingly 表示“越来越”，与 more and more 含义相近。

exercises.q: The structure "comparative + and + comparative" can only be used with short adjectives.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词可以用“more and more + 原级”形式，并非只能用于短形容词。

exercises.q: The influence of social media on teenagers is growing. (用“越来越……”改写)
exercises.answer: The influence of social media on teenagers is growing more and more significant.
exercises.explain: 用 more and more significant 表示“越来越重要/显著”。

exercises.q: As the project progressed, the challenges became difficult. (用“越来越……”改写)
exercises.answer: As the project progressed, the challenges became more and more difficult.
exercises.explain: difficult 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 原级”表示“越来越困难”。

exercises.q: The company's profits are increasing. The growth is steady. (合并为一句，用“越来越……”)
exercises.answer: The company's profits are becoming larger and larger.
exercises.explain: 用 larger and larger 表示利润“越来越大”。

exercises.q: The cultural differences between the two regions are becoming more and more small due to globalization.
exercises.answer: The cultural differences between the two regions are becoming smaller and smaller due to globalization.
exercises.explain: small 是单音节形容词，比较级为 smaller，不用 more。

exercises.q: As the economy develops, the income gap is getting more and more wide in some countries.
exercises.answer: As the economy develops, the income gap is getting wider and wider in some countries.
exercises.explain: wide 是单音节形容词，比较级为 wider，不用 more。

exercises.q: As autumn comes, the days get ______.
exercises.explain: 单音节形容词 short 的比较级是 shorter，用“比较级+and+比较级”表示“越来越短”。

exercises.q: The little tree is growing ______.
exercises.explain: tall 是单音节形容词，比较级为 taller，表示“越来越高”。

exercises.q: With practice, her English is getting ______.
exercises.explain: good 的比较级是不规则形式 better，表示“越来越好”。

exercises.q: The city is becoming ______ crowded.
exercises.explain: crowded 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 形容词”表示“越来越拥挤”。

exercises.q: When spring arrives, the weather gets ______.
exercises.explain: warm 是单音节形容词，比较级为 warmer，表示“越来越暖和”。

exercises.q: The baby is growing ______ and ______ every day.
exercises.explain: big 是重读闭音节，双写 g 再加 er，表示“越来越大”。

exercises.q: As we climbed higher, the air became ______ and ______.
exercises.explain: thin 是重读闭音节，双写 n 再加 er，表示“越来越稀薄”。

exercises.q: The story gets ______ and ______ interesting.
exercises.explain: interesting 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 形容词”表示“越来越有趣”。

exercises.q: The sentence "It is getting colder and colder" means the temperature is going down continuously.
exercises.explain: colder and colder 表示“越来越冷”，说明温度在持续下降。

exercises.q: We can say "more and more taller" to mean "越来越高".
exercises.explain: taller 已经是比较级，不能再加 more，应说 taller and taller。

exercises.q: The music is becoming louder and louder. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: The music is not becoming louder and louder.
exercises.explain: 在 be 动词后加 not 构成否定句，保留比较级结构。

exercises.q: The city is getting more and more beautiful. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Is the city getting more and more beautiful?
exercises.explain: 将 be 动词提前构成一般疑问句，比较级结构不变。

exercises.q: The train runs faster and faster. (用 slow 改写为反义句)
exercises.answer: The train runs slower and slower.
exercises.explain: 将 faster 换成反义词 slower，保持“比较级+and+比较级”结构。

exercises.q: The box is getting more and more heavy.
exercises.answer: The box is getting heavier and heavier.
exercises.explain: heavy 是双音节形容词，比较级为 heavier，不用 more and more heavy。

exercises.q: Our school is becoming beautifuler and beautifuler.
exercises.answer: Our school is becoming more and more beautiful.
exercises.explain: beautiful 是多音节形容词，比较级用 more beautiful，不能加 -er。

exercises.q: As the final exam approaches, the students feel ______ pressure.
exercises.explain: pressure 是不可数名词，用 more and more 修饰，表示“越来越多的压力”。

exercises.q: The situation is becoming ______ difficult to control.
exercises.explain: difficult 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 形容词”表示“越来越难”。

exercises.q: With the development of technology, our lives are getting ______ convenient.
exercises.explain: convenient 是多音节形容词，用 more and more 表示“越来越方便”。

exercises.q: The gap between the rich and the poor is becoming ______.
exercises.explain: wide 是单音节形容词，比较级为 wider，表示“越来越宽”。

exercises.q: As the speech went on, his voice became ______.
exercises.explain: weak 是单音节形容词，比较级为 weaker，表示“越来越弱”。

exercises.q: As the economy develops, people are becoming ______ and ______ wealthy.
exercises.explain: wealthy 是双音节形容词，用“more and more + 形容词”表示“越来越富有”。

exercises.q: The competition for jobs is getting ______ and ______ fierce.
exercises.explain: fierce 是单音节形容词，但常用 more and more fierce 表示“越来越激烈”。

exercises.q: As the storm approached, the wind blew ______ and ______.
exercises.explain: hard 的比较级是 harder，表示风刮得“越来越猛烈”。

exercises.q: The phrase "more and more people" means the number of people is decreasing.
exercises.explain: more and more people 表示“越来越多的人”，数量在增加而非减少。

exercises.q: In the sentence "She is becoming more and more confident", "confident" is used in its comparative form.
exercises.explain: confident 是原级，比较级由 more 体现，不能说 more and more confident 中 confident 本身是比较级。

exercises.q: The problem is becoming more and more serious. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: The problem is not becoming more and more serious.
exercises.explain: 在 be 动词后加 not 构成否定句，保留 more and more 结构。

exercises.q: The students are working harder and harder. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Are the students working harder and harder?
exercises.explain: 将 be 动词提前构成一般疑问句，比较级结构不变。

exercises.q: The environment is becoming worse and worse. (用 better 改写为反义句)
exercises.answer: The environment is becoming better and better.
exercises.explain: 将 worse 换成反义词 better，保持“比较级+and+比较级”结构。

exercises.q: As time goes by, the situation is getting more and more bad.
exercises.answer: As time goes by, the situation is getting worse and worse.
exercises.explain: bad 的比较级是不规则形式 worse，不能用 more and more bad。

exercises.q: The number of cars on the road is becoming larger and larger, which makes the traffic more and more crowded.
exercises.answer: The number of cars on the road is becoming larger and larger, which makes the traffic heavier and heavier.
exercises.explain: traffic 用 heavy 修饰，表示交通拥挤程度用 heavier and heavier，crowded 不用于修饰 traffic。

exercises.q: As the debate continued, the arguments on both sides became ______ convincing.
exercises.explain: convincing 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 形容词”表示“越来越有说服力”。

exercises.q: With each passing year, the influence of social media on public opinion grows ______.
exercises.explain: strong 是单音节形容词，比较级为 stronger，表示“越来越强”。

exercises.q: The evidence presented in court became ______ contradictory, making it difficult for the jury to reach a verdict.
exercises.explain: contradictory 是多音节形容词，用 more and more 表示“越来越矛盾”。

exercises.q: As the project deadline approached, the tension among team members became ______ palpable.
exercises.explain: palpable 是多音节形容词，用 more and more 表示“越来越明显”。

exercises.q: The gap between theoretical research and practical application is becoming ______ difficult to bridge.
exercises.explain: difficult 是多音节形容词，用 more and more 表示“越来越难”。

exercises.q: As artificial intelligence advances, the boundary between human and machine is becoming ______ and ______ blurred.
exercises.explain: blurred 是多音节形容词，用“more and more + 形容词”表示“越来越模糊”。

exercises.q: The more data we collected, the ______ and ______ complex the analysis became.
exercises.explain: complex 是多音节形容词，用 more and more 表示“越来越复杂”。

exercises.q: As the investigation deepened, the truth became ______ and ______ elusive.
exercises.explain: elusive 是多音节形容词，用 more and more 表示“越来越难以捉摸”。

exercises.q: The structure "comparative + and + comparative" can only be used with single-syllable adjectives.
exercises.explain: 多音节形容词可以用“more and more + 形容词”形式，不限于单音节。

exercises.q: In the sentence "The situation is becoming increasingly complex", "increasingly complex" conveys a similar meaning to "more and more complex".
exercises.explain: increasingly complex 与 more and more complex 都表示“越来越复杂”，含义相近。

exercises.q: The influence of traditional media is declining more and more rapidly. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: The influence of traditional media is not declining more and more rapidly.
exercises.explain: 在 be 动词后加 not 构成否定句，保留 more and more 结构。

exercises.q: The gap between urban and rural education is widening more and more. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Is the gap between urban and rural education widening more and more?
exercises.explain: 将 be 动词提前构成一般疑问句，比较级结构不变。

exercises.q: The public is becoming more and more concerned about environmental issues. (用 increasingly 改写)
exercises.answer: The public is becoming increasingly concerned about environmental issues.
exercises.explain: increasingly + 形容词可以替换 more and more + 形容词，表达相同含义。

exercises.q: As the experiment progressed, the results became more and more clearer.
exercises.answer: As the experiment progressed, the results became clearer and clearer.
exercises.explain: clearer 已经是比较级，不能再加 more，应说 clearer and clearer。

exercises.q: The relationship between the two countries is becoming more and more tenser.
exercises.answer: The relationship between the two countries is becoming more and more tense.
exercises.explain: tense 的比较级是 more tense，不能说 tenser，应保持原级用 more and more 修饰。

grammar.title: 一般将来时 will 表预测（拓展：will / be going to / may / might / could 的预测用法）
grammar.titleEn: Future with 'will' for Predictions (Extended: will / be going to / may / might / could)
grammar.usage:
“will + 动词原形”表示对将来情况的预测，即说话人根据主观判断、经验或对未来的推测，认为某事将会发生。这种预测通常不强调事先安排或已有迹象，而是表达一种对未来的信念或看法。核心结构为：主语 + will + 动词原形，否定形式在 will 后加 not（可缩写为 won't），疑问形式将 will 提到主语之前。

在高中阶段，will 表预测需要与 be going to 进行区分。be going to 多用于两种情况：一是表示事先计划、打算做某事；二是表示根据现有迹象判断某事即将发生。而 will 更侧重于说话人的主观判断、推测或对遥远未来的预测，常与 I think、I believe、probably、perhaps、in the future 等搭配。

此外，高中英语还要求掌握其他情态动词表预测的用法。may 和 might 表示“可能”，语气比 will 弱，其中 might 比 may 更不确定；could 也可以表示“有可能”，但语气同样较为委婉。在书面语和高考阅读中，这些情态动词常与 will 交替出现，以体现预测的确定程度差异。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 will 的基本结构以及 will 与 be going to 的简单区别；高中阶段则进一步要求能在语境中根据预测的确定程度选择 will、may、might、could，并能在书面表达中灵活运用，避免一味使用 will 造成语气过于绝对。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + will + 动词原形
否定句：主语 + will not (won't) + 动词原形
一般疑问句：Will + 主语 + 动词原形?
be going to + 动词原形（表计划或已有迹象的预测）
主语 + may / might / could + 动词原形（表可能性较弱的预测）
There will be + 名词（表某事物将来会出现）
notes: will 表预测时后必须接动词原形，不可接 to do 或 doing；高考短文改错和语法填空中常在此设错。
will 与 be going to 并非完全等同：表示“根据现有迹象判断即将发生”时，书面语中更倾向用 be going to，如 Look at the clouds. It is going to rain.
在高考书面表达中，连续使用 will 会使语气过于绝对，可适当换用 may、might 或 be likely to，以体现语言丰富性和预测的层次感。
will 表预测时，时间状语并非必须出现，但在科技类说明文或议论文中，常与 in the future、by 2050、in the coming years 等搭配，以明确预测的时间范围。
注意 will 与 would 的语域差异：would 可用于过去将来时的预测，也可使语气更委婉，在间接引语和虚拟语气中常见，高考语法填空需根据主句时态判断是否用 would。

examples.en: I think robots will help us a lot in the future.
examples.cn: 我认为未来机器人会帮我们很多忙。

examples.en: There will be more electric cars on the road in ten years.
examples.cn: 十年后路上将会有更多电动汽车。

examples.en: Look at the dark clouds—it is going to rain soon.
examples.cn: 看那些乌云——很快就要下雨了。

examples.en: Scientists believe that sea levels will rise significantly by the end of this century.
examples.cn: 科学家们认为，到本世纪末海平面将显著上升。

examples.en: The new technology might reduce energy consumption, but further tests are needed.
examples.cn: 这项新技术可能会降低能耗，但还需要进一步测试。

examples.en: If current trends continue, artificial intelligence could transform the job market within a decade.
examples.cn: 如果当前趋势持续下去，人工智能可能在十年内改变就业市场。

exercises.q: I think it ______ sunny tomorrow.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形，表示对明天天气的预测。

exercises.q: Robots ______ our houses in the future.
exercises.explain: in the future 提示用 will 加动词原形表示未来预测。

exercises.q: My brother ______ twelve years old next month.
exercises.explain: next month 是将来时间，用 will be 表示未来事实。

exercises.q: People ______ on the moon one day.
exercises.explain: one day 表示未来某一天，用 will live 作预测。

exercises.q: The train ______ at 9 o'clock tonight.
exercises.explain: tonight 是将来时间，用 will arrive 表示预测。

exercises.q: She ______ (be) a doctor when she grows up.
exercises.explain: when she grows up 表示将来，用 will be。

exercises.q: They ______ (not go) to school tomorrow because it is a holiday.
exercises.explain: tomorrow 提示将来，否定形式用 will not go。

exercises.q: I think our team ______ (win) the game.
exercises.explain: I think 后接 will win 表示对未来的预测。

exercises.q: The sentence 'He will goes to Beijing next week.' is correct.
exercises.explain: will 后必须接动词原形，goes 应改为 go。

exercises.q: The sentence 'It will be cold in winter.' is correct.
exercises.explain: will be 表示对冬天天气的客观预测，结构正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: I will buy a new phone.
exercises.answer: I will not buy a new phone.
exercises.explain: 否定形式在 will 后加 not。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a question: She will come to the party.
exercises.answer: Will she come to the party?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 will 提到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'will': He is going to be late.
exercises.explain: be going to 表预测时可转换为 will。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: They will plays football after school.
exercises.answer: They will play football after school.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形，plays 应改为 play。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: My father will to buy a car.
exercises.answer: My father will buy a car.
exercises.explain: will 后直接接动词原形，不需要 to。

exercises.q: I'm sure you ______ the exam if you study hard.
exercises.explain: if 条件句表将来预测，主句用 will pass。

exercises.q: Look at the clouds! It ______ soon.
exercises.explain: 根据现有迹象（乌云）预测，用 be going to 更合适。

exercises.q: In 2050, cars ______ without drivers.
exercises.explain: In 2050 是将来时间，用 will run 表示预测。

exercises.q: Don't worry. I ______ you with your homework.
exercises.explain: 此处表示说话时的即时决定，用 will help。

exercises.q: Scientists believe that sea levels ______ in the next 50 years.
exercises.explain: in the next 50 years 是将来时间，用 will rise 表预测。

exercises.q: By 2030, most people ______ (use) smartphones to pay for everything.
exercises.explain: By 2030 是将来时间，用 will use 表示预测。

exercises.q: I promise I ______ (not tell) anyone your secret.
exercises.explain: promise 后接 will not tell 表示承诺。

exercises.q: There ______ (be) more electric cars on the road in the future.
exercises.explain: in the future 提示用 there will be 表示将来存在。

exercises.q: The sentence 'I will be able to drive a car when I am 18.' is correct.
exercises.explain: will be able to 表示将来有能力，结构正确。

exercises.q: The sentence 'She will can speak English well.' is correct.
exercises.explain: will 和 can 不能连用，应改为 will be able to。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'will': We are going to visit our grandparents this weekend.
exercises.answer: We will visit our grandparents this weekend.
exercises.explain: be going to 表计划时可转换为 will。

exercises.q: Rewrite as a question: They will finish the project on time.
exercises.answer: Will they finish the project on time?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 will 提到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'be able to': He will can solve the problem.
exercises.answer: He will be able to solve the problem.
exercises.explain: will 后不能接 can，用 will be able to 表示将来能力。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: The meeting will is held next Monday.
exercises.answer: The meeting will be held next Monday.
exercises.explain: 被动语态将来时用 will be held，is 应改为 be。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: I think it will not rains tomorrow.
exercises.answer: I think it will not rain tomorrow.
exercises.explain: will not 后接动词原形，rains 应改为 rain。

exercises.q: By the time you arrive, the concert ______ already ______.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导时间状语，用将来完成时表示将来某时已完成的动作。

exercises.q: The new technology ______ widely used in the next decade.
exercises.explain: in the next decade 是将来时间，用 will be 表预测。

exercises.q: If global warming continues, many coastal cities ______ under water.
exercises.explain: if 条件句表将来预测，主句用 will be。

exercises.q: I doubt whether he ______ the truth.
exercises.explain: doubt whether 后接将来时，表示对将来行为的怀疑。

exercises.q: The company has announced that it ______ a new factory in the region.
exercises.explain: has announced 后接 that 从句，用 will build 表示将来计划。

exercises.q: By 2050, the world's population ______ (reach) nine billion.
exercises.explain: by 2050 用将来完成时表示到那时已完成的预测。

exercises.q: The government predicts that the economy ______ (grow) by 3% next year.
exercises.explain: predicts 后接 that 从句，用 will grow 表示预测。

exercises.q: Unless we act now, the problem ______ (become) worse.
exercises.explain: unless 条件句表将来，主句用 will become。

exercises.q: The sentence 'By next year, she will have graduated from college.' is correct.
exercises.explain: by next year 用将来完成时 will have graduated，结构正确。

exercises.q: The sentence 'He will be able to speak three languages by the time he is ten.' is correct.
exercises.explain: will be able to 表示将来能力，by the time 引导时间状语，结构正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'will have done': By the end of this year, she will finish her research.
exercises.answer: By the end of this year, she will have finished her research.
exercises.explain: by the end of this year 用将来完成时 will have finished。

exercises.q: Rewrite as a negative sentence: The government will approve the new law.
exercises.answer: The government will not approve the new law.
exercises.explain: 否定形式在 will 后加 not。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'be going to': I think it will snow tonight.
exercises.answer: I think it is going to snow tonight.
exercises.explain: 表预测时 will 可转换为 be going to。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: By 2030, scientists will have find a cure for the disease.
exercises.answer: By 2030, scientists will have found a cure for the disease.
exercises.explain: 将来完成时用 will have found，find 应改为过去分词 found。

exercises.q: Find and correct the mistake: The report says that the company will expands its business overseas.
exercises.answer: The report says that the company will expand its business overseas.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形，expands 应改为 expand。

exercises.q: By 2030, most cars on the road ______ electric.
exercises.explain: will 后必须接动词原形，be 是原形，其他选项形式错误。

exercises.q: I think it ______ tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
exercises.explain: will 表对未来的预测，后接动词原形 rain。

exercises.q: Don't worry about the exam. You ______ fine.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形 do，表示对对方未来表现的预测。

exercises.q: In the future, people ______ on Mars.
exercises.explain: will 表未来预测，后接动词原形 live。

exercises.q: The new technology ______ communication much faster.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形 make，表示对未来技术影响的预测。

exercises.q: Scientists believe that sea levels ______ rise in the next fifty years.
exercises.explain: 根据科学家预测，用 will 表示对未来的客观预测。

exercises.q: She ______ (be) a great doctor one day.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形 be，表示对未来的预测。

exercises.q: The Internet of Things ______ (change) our daily lives completely.
exercises.explain: will 后接动词原形 change，表示对未来变化的预测。

exercises.q: The sentence 'He will goes to school tomorrow' is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: will 后必须接动词原形 go，不能接 goes。

exercises.q: In the sentence 'I will call you tonight', 'will' expresses a prediction about the future.
exercises.explain: will 在这里表示对将来行为的预测或承诺，属于将来时用法。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: The meeting will start at 9 a.m.
exercises.answer: The meeting will not start at 9 a.m.
exercises.explain: 否定形式在 will 后加 not，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a question: You will finish the project next week.
exercises.answer: Will you finish the project next week?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 will 提到主语之前，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'will': She is going to be late for the meeting.
exercises.answer: She will be late for the meeting.
exercises.explain: be going to 表预测时可与 will 互换，will 后接动词原形。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The weather will gets colder next month.
exercises.answer: The weather will get colder next month.
exercises.explain: will 后必须接动词原形 get，不能接 gets。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: They will to visit us next summer.
exercises.answer: They will visit us next summer.
exercises.explain: will 后直接接动词原形，不需要加 to。

exercises.q: By the time you arrive, the concert ______ already ______.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导将来时间状语，主句用将来完成时 will have done 表示将来某时已完成的动作。

exercises.q: Don't call me at 8 p.m. I ______ dinner with my family then.
exercises.explain: 将来某一具体时刻正在进行的动作，用将来进行时 will be doing。

exercises.q: Look at those dark clouds! It ______ soon.
exercises.explain: 有迹象表明即将发生的事，用 be going to 而非 will。

exercises.q: I'm not sure if he ______ the job, but I think he has a good chance.
exercises.explain: 表示不确定的预测，用 will 而非 be going to。

exercises.q: By next year, the company ______ its new product line.
exercises.explain: by next year 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时 will have done。

exercises.q: This time next week, we ______ (fly) to London.
exercises.explain: this time next week 表示将来某一具体时刻，用将来进行时。

exercises.q: By the end of this century, scientists ______ (discover) a cure for many diseases.
exercises.explain: by the end of this century 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时。

exercises.q: The train ______ (leave) at 6 p.m. tomorrow, so don't be late.
exercises.explain: 按时刻表发生的将来事件，用 will 或一般现在时均可，此处用 will leave 表预测。

exercises.q: The sentence 'By 2050, the population will have reached 10 billion' uses the future perfect tense correctly.
exercises.explain: by 2050 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时 will have done 正确。

exercises.q: In the sentence 'I will be studying at 9 p.m. tomorrow', the action is a completed action in the future.
exercises.explain: will be doing 表示将来某时正在进行的动作，不是已完成。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'will have done': By next month, she will finish her thesis.
exercises.answer: By next month, she will have finished her thesis.
exercises.explain: by next month 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时 will have finished。

exercises.q: Rewrite as a negative sentence: The company will be expanding its operations next year.
exercises.answer: The company will not be expanding its operations next year.
exercises.explain: 将来进行时的否定在 will 后加 not，保持 be doing 结构。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'be going to': I think it will snow tomorrow.
exercises.answer: I think it is going to snow tomorrow.
exercises.explain: 表示有迹象的预测时，be going to 比 will 更合适。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: By the time you get home, I will finished my homework.
exercises.answer: By the time you get home, I will have finished my homework.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导将来时间，主句用将来完成时 will have done。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: This time tomorrow, I will attend a conference.
exercises.answer: This time tomorrow, I will be attending a conference.
exercises.explain: this time tomorrow 表示将来某一具体时刻，用将来进行时 will be doing。

exercises.q: Had the technology been available a decade earlier, the company ______ the market.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句，主句用 would have done。

exercises.q: By the time the new regulations take effect, the industry ______ significantly.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导将来时间，主句用将来完成时表示到那时已完成的转变。

exercises.q: The report predicts that artificial intelligence ______ nearly every aspect of our lives within two decades.
exercises.explain: within two decades 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时强调完成的变革。

exercises.q: If current trends continue, sea levels ______ by at least 30 centimeters by 2100.
exercises.explain: by 2100 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时表示已上升的幅度。

exercises.q: At this time next year, the researchers ______ clinical trials on the new drug.
exercises.explain: at this time next year 表示将来某一具体时刻，用将来进行时。

exercises.q: By the time the project is completed, the team ______ (invest) over five years in research.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导将来时间，主句用将来完成时表示到那时已投入的时间。

exercises.q: The company predicts that its new device ______ (replace) traditional smartphones within a decade.
exercises.explain: within a decade 表示到将来某时为止，用将来完成时强调已完成的替代。

exercises.q: At 10 a.m. tomorrow, the engineers ______ (test) the new system.
exercises.explain: at 10 a.m. tomorrow 表示将来某一具体时刻，用将来进行时。

exercises.q: The sentence 'By 2030, the technology will have been widely adopted' is in the future perfect passive voice.
exercises.explain: will have been adopted 是将来完成时的被动语态，结构正确。

exercises.q: In the sentence 'The new policy will be implemented next year', 'will be implemented' is a future continuous passive.
exercises.explain: will be implemented 是一般将来时的被动语态，不是将来进行时被动。

exercises.q: Rewrite using the future perfect passive: By 2035, they will have replaced all fossil fuel vehicles.
exercises.answer: By 2035, all fossil fuel vehicles will have been replaced.
exercises.explain: 将来完成时被动语态结构为 will have been done。

exercises.q: Rewrite using 'will be doing': The scientists will conduct experiments at 9 a.m. tomorrow.
exercises.answer: The scientists will be conducting experiments at 9 a.m. tomorrow.
exercises.explain: 将来某一具体时刻正在进行的动作，用将来进行时 will be doing。

exercises.q: Rewrite as a conditional sentence: The company will succeed because it invests heavily in research.
exercises.answer: If the company invests heavily in research, it will succeed.
exercises.explain: 将原因状语从句改写为 if 条件句，主句用 will 表将来结果。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: By the time the conference ends, the speakers will have been discussing the topic for three hours.
exercises.answer: By the time the conference ends, the speakers will have discussed the topic for three hours.
exercises.explain: 强调到将来某时已完成的动作，用将来完成时 will have discussed，而非将来完成进行时。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The new software will be being installed at this time tomorrow.
exercises.answer: The new software will be installed at this time tomorrow.
exercises.explain: 一般将来时被动语态用 will be done，不用 will be being done。

grammar.title: 对比连接词：in contrast 及其近义结构（on the other hand / however / whereas / unlike）
grammar.titleEn: Contrast Connectors: 'In contrast' and Related Structures
grammar.usage:
“In contrast” 是一个表示“鲜明对比”的连接短语，用来引出与前面所述内容在性质、程度、特点等方面明显不同的信息。它强调两个对象、观点或事实之间的差异，而不是简单的补充或因果。

核心结构上，“In contrast” 通常位于句首，后面用逗号与主句隔开，形成“In contrast, + 完整句子”的格式。它既可以连接两个独立的句子，也可以在一个段落中引出与前文相对的新信息。肯定句中直接使用“In contrast, A does/is...”；否定句中则写“In contrast, A does not / is not...”；疑问句中较少直接使用，但可以出现在对比性提问中，如“In contrast, what does B offer?”。

与近义结构相比，“In contrast” 偏向书面语和正式语体，强调客观对比；“On the other hand” 更常用于引出另一种观点或事物的另一面，语气稍缓和；“However” 是副词，表示转折，但不一定强调两者之间的直接对比；“Whereas” 和 “While” 是从属连词，常放在句中连接两个分句；“Unlike” 是介词，后面直接接名词或代词，表示“与……不同”。

初中阶段，学生主要接触 “but” 和 “however” 表示转折，对 “in contrast” 的要求以识别和理解为主，常见于阅读理解中判断逻辑关系。高中阶段则要求能够在书面表达中主动运用 “in contrast” 来增强论证的层次感和正式感，同时能够根据语境在 “in contrast / on the other hand / whereas / unlike” 之间做出恰当选择。

易错点一：把 “in contrast” 当作连词直接连接两个句子，写成 “A is fast, in contrast B is slow”，这是错误的，正确写法应为 “A is fast. In contrast, B is slow.” 或使用分号。易错点二：混淆 “in contrast” 与 “on the contrary”。“on the contrary” 表示“恰恰相反”，用于否定前文观点并给出相反判断，而 “in contrast” 只是客观呈现差异，不一定要否定前文。易错点三：在口语或非正式写作中过度使用 “in contrast”，会显得生硬，此时可换用 “but” 或 “on the other hand”。易错点四：使用 “in contrast to” 时后面接名词或动名词，而不是接完整句子，例如 “In contrast to his brother, John is outgoing.”
forms: In contrast, + 完整句子（肯定/否定/疑问）
In contrast to + 名词/代词/动名词, + 完整句子
A is... In contrast, B is...（两个独立句子，句号分隔）
A is...; in contrast, B is...（分号连接，in contrast 小写）
Whereas/While + 从句, + 主句（表示对比，句中位置）
Unlike + 名词/代词, + 完整句子（表示“与……不同”）
notes: “In contrast” 是介词短语，不是连词，不能直接连接两个完整句子，必须用句号或分号隔开。
“In contrast to” 后面接名词、代词或动名词，不能接完整句子；接句子时要用 “whereas” 或 “while”。
高考书面表达中，“In contrast” 适合用于议论文和说明文的对比论证，但不要每段都用，一篇作文使用 1–2 次即可，避免重复。
“On the contrary” 表示“恰恰相反”，用于否定前文观点；“In contrast” 只是呈现差异，不否定前文，两者不可混用。
在正式语域中，“In contrast” 比 “but” 和 “on the other hand” 更客观、更书面化，适合学术写作和正式报告。

examples.en: Cats are quiet and independent. In contrast, dogs need more attention.
examples.cn: 猫安静而独立。相比之下，狗需要更多关注。

examples.en: My school is small. In contrast, my cousin's school has over two thousand students.
examples.cn: 我的学校很小。相比之下，我表弟的学校有两千多名学生。

examples.en: In contrast to his earlier novels, the author's latest work focuses on modern city life.
examples.cn: 与他早期的小说相比，这位作者的最新作品聚焦于现代城市生活。

examples.en: Whereas traditional cars rely on petrol, electric vehicles use rechargeable batteries.
examples.cn: 传统汽车依赖汽油，而电动汽车使用可充电电池。

examples.en: The northern region suffers from water shortages. In contrast, the southern provinces enjoy abundant rainfall throughout the year.
examples.cn: 北部地区饱受水资源短缺之苦。相比之下，南部省份全年雨水充沛。

examples.en: Unlike previous economic models, this framework emphasizes sustainability over short-term growth; in contrast, earlier approaches prioritized immediate profits.
examples.cn: 与以往的经济模型不同，这一框架强调可持续性而非短期增长；相比之下，早期的方法优先考虑即时利润。

exercises.q: Tom is very tall. ______, his brother is quite short.
exercises.explain: 前后是身高高矮的对比，用 In contrast 引出相反信息。

exercises.q: Cats like to sleep a lot. ______, dogs often want to play outside.
exercises.explain: 猫爱睡觉和狗爱出去玩是两种不同的行为，用 In contrast 表示对比。

exercises.q: The north of the country is cold in winter. ______, the south stays warm.
exercises.explain: 北方冷和南方暖形成明显差异，用 In contrast 连接。

exercises.q: My sister loves pop music. ______, I prefer rock music.
exercises.explain: 姐姐喜欢流行乐和我喜欢摇滚乐是两种不同喜好，用 In contrast 表示对比。

exercises.q: The old phone is heavy and slow. ______, the new one is light and fast.
exercises.explain: 旧手机又重又慢与新手机又轻又快形成对比，用 In contrast 引出差异。

exercises.q: The city is noisy and busy. ______, the village is quiet and peaceful.
exercises.explain: 城市吵闹忙碌与乡村安静平和形成对比，句首用 In contrast。

exercises.q: Some people like hot weather. ______, others enjoy cold weather.
exercises.explain: 喜欢热天和喜欢冷天是两种相反偏好，用 In contrast 引出对比。

exercises.q: The first movie was funny. ______, the second one was very serious.
exercises.explain: 第一部有趣和第二部严肃形成对比，句首用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The phrase 'In contrast' is used to show that two things are similar.
exercises.explain: In contrast 表示对比差异，不是表示相似。

exercises.q: We usually put a comma after 'In contrast' when it is at the beginning of a sentence.
exercises.explain: In contrast 位于句首时后面通常加逗号。

exercises.q: The first book is short. The second book is long. (用 In contrast 合并句子)
exercises.answer: The first book is short. In contrast, the second book is long.
exercises.explain: 用 In contrast 连接两个形成对比的句子，注意句首加逗号。

exercises.q: My room is always clean. My brother's room is always messy. (用 In contrast 改写)
exercises.answer: My room is always clean. In contrast, my brother's room is always messy.
exercises.explain: 两个房间状态形成对比，用 In contrast 引出第二句。

exercises.q: The train is fast. The bus is slow. (用 In contrast 合并)
exercises.answer: The train is fast. In contrast, the bus is slow.
exercises.explain: 火车快和公交车慢形成对比，用 In contrast 连接。

exercises.q: In contrast the weather was cold, we still went swimming.
exercises.answer: In contrast, the weather was cold, but we still went swimming.
exercises.explain: In contrast 后需加逗号，且此处逻辑上应加 but 连接转折。

exercises.q: He likes apples. In contrast he likes oranges.
exercises.answer: He likes apples. In contrast, he likes oranges.
exercises.explain: In contrast 位于句首时后面需要加逗号。

exercises.q: The old system could only handle a few users at a time. ______, the new system supports thousands of users at once.
exercises.explain: 旧系统只能处理少量用户与新系统支持数千用户形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: Many people believe that technology makes us busier. ______, others argue that it saves us time.
exercises.explain: 两种相反观点形成对比，用 In contrast 引出不同看法。

exercises.q: The first half of the book is slow and boring. ______, the second half is full of action.
exercises.explain: 书的前半部分无聊与后半部分充满动作形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: Traditional phones could only make calls. ______, smartphones can do many things like taking photos and surfing the Internet.
exercises.explain: 传统手机功能单一与智能手机功能多样形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The north of the city is modern and developed. ______, the south remains quite traditional.
exercises.explain: 城市北部现代与南部传统形成对比，用 In contrast 引出差异。

exercises.q: The old model was expensive and difficult to use. ______, the new model is cheap and user-friendly.
exercises.explain: 旧型号昂贵难用与新型号便宜好用形成对比，句首用 In contrast。

exercises.q: Some students prefer to study alone. ______, others learn better in groups.
exercises.explain: 独自学习和小组学习是两种不同偏好，用 In contrast 引出对比。

exercises.q: The first experiment failed completely. ______, the second experiment was a great success.
exercises.explain: 第一次实验失败与第二次实验成功形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The phrase 'In contrast' can be used to introduce an example.
exercises.explain: In contrast 用于引出对比信息，不是引出例子。

exercises.q: 'In contrast' and 'However' can both be used to show a difference between two ideas.
exercises.explain: In contrast 和 However 都可以表示对比或转折。

exercises.q: The old computer takes five minutes to start. The new computer starts in ten seconds. (用 In contrast 合并)
exercises.answer: The old computer takes five minutes to start. In contrast, the new computer starts in ten seconds.
exercises.explain: 旧电脑启动慢与新电脑启动快形成对比，用 In contrast 连接。

exercises.q: Some people enjoy living in big cities. Others prefer the quiet life in the countryside. (用 In contrast 改写)
exercises.answer: Some people enjoy living in big cities. In contrast, others prefer the quiet life in the countryside.
exercises.explain: 喜欢大城市生活和喜欢乡村宁静生活形成对比，用 In contrast 引出第二句。

exercises.q: The first version of the app was slow and full of bugs. The latest version is fast and stable. (用 In contrast 合并)
exercises.answer: The first version of the app was slow and full of bugs. In contrast, the latest version is fast and stable.
exercises.explain: 旧版本慢且多漏洞与新版本快且稳定形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The old phone battery lasted only two hours. In contrast the new phone battery lasts two days.
exercises.answer: The old phone battery lasted only two hours. In contrast, the new phone battery lasts two days.
exercises.explain: In contrast 位于句首时后面需要加逗号。

exercises.q: He is very good at math. In contrast, he is also good at English.
exercises.answer: He is very good at math. In addition, he is also good at English.
exercises.explain: 数学好和英语好是并列补充关系，不是对比关系，应用 In addition。

exercises.q: The previous generation of mobile networks focused mainly on voice calls. ______, 5G is designed to connect billions of devices with extremely low latency.
exercises.explain: 前代网络侧重语音通话与5G侧重海量设备连接形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: While 4G brought faster mobile Internet to smartphones, 5G, ______, promises to transform entire industries such as healthcare and transportation.
exercises.explain: 4G仅提升手机上网速度与5G变革整个行业形成对比，用 in contrast。

exercises.q: The old manufacturing process required hundreds of workers. ______, the automated system needs only a few technicians to operate.
exercises.explain: 旧流程需要数百工人与自动化系统只需少数技术员形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: Many traditional classrooms rely heavily on textbooks and lectures. ______, modern classrooms often use interactive digital tools and project-based learning.
exercises.explain: 传统课堂依赖课本与现代课堂使用互动数字工具形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The first smartphones were slow and had limited storage. ______, today's devices are powerful enough to run complex applications and store thousands of files.
exercises.explain: 早期智能手机性能弱与如今设备性能强形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The old network could only support a few hundred connections per cell. ______, 5G can support up to a million connections in the same area.
exercises.explain: 旧网络连接数少与5G连接数多形成对比，句首用 In contrast。

exercises.q: Traditional farming depends heavily on weather conditions. ______, modern vertical farming uses controlled environments to grow crops all year round.
exercises.explain: 传统农业依赖天气与现代垂直农业使用受控环境形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The first computers filled entire rooms and could only perform simple calculations. ______, today's smartphones are millions of times more powerful and fit in a pocket.
exercises.explain: 早期计算机体积大功能弱与如今智能手机体积小功能强形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The phrase 'In contrast' is often used at the beginning of a sentence to introduce a point that is very different from the previous one.
exercises.explain: In contrast 常位于句首，用于引出与前文非常不同的信息。

exercises.q: 'In contrast' and 'Whereas' can both be used to show a difference, but 'Whereas' is usually placed at the beginning of a sentence followed by a comma.
exercises.explain: Whereas 通常用于句中连接两个分句，不是句首加逗号。

exercises.q: The previous model required users to press several buttons to complete a task. The new model can be controlled entirely by voice commands. (用 In contrast 合并)
exercises.answer: The previous model required users to press several buttons to complete a task. In contrast, the new model can be controlled entirely by voice commands.
exercises.explain: 旧型号需要按键操作与新型号可用语音控制形成对比，用 In contrast 连接。

exercises.q: Traditional advertising relies on TV and print media to reach customers. Digital advertising uses social media and search engines to target specific audiences. (用 In contrast 改写)
exercises.answer: Traditional advertising relies on TV and print media to reach customers. In contrast, digital advertising uses social media and search engines to target specific audiences.
exercises.explain: 传统广告依赖电视印刷媒体与数字广告使用社交媒体搜索引擎形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The old software required users to manually save their work every few minutes. The new version automatically saves changes in real time. (用 In contrast 合并)
exercises.answer: The old software required users to manually save their work every few minutes. In contrast, the new version automatically saves changes in real time.
exercises.explain: 旧软件需手动保存与新版本自动实时保存形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The first prototype was heavy and consumed a lot of power. In contrast the final product is lightweight and energy-efficient.
exercises.answer: The first prototype was heavy and consumed a lot of power. In contrast, the final product is lightweight and energy-efficient.
exercises.explain: In contrast 位于句首时后面需要加逗号。

exercises.q: The new system is faster than the old one. In contrast, it is also cheaper to maintain.
exercises.answer: The new system is faster than the old one. In addition, it is also cheaper to maintain.
exercises.explain: 更快和更便宜是并列优点，不是对比关系，应用 In addition。

exercises.q: The old phone only supports 3G. ______, the new model can connect to 5G networks.
exercises.explain: 前后两句是对比关系，用 In contrast 引出差异。

exercises.q: Tom is very tall. ______, his younger brother is quite short.
exercises.explain: tall 和 short 形成鲜明对比，应选 In contrast。

exercises.q: The north of the country is cold and dry. ______, the south is warm and wet.
exercises.explain: 南北气候差异明显，用 In contrast 表示对比。

exercises.q: My sister loves pop music. ______, I prefer classical music.
exercises.explain: 两人音乐喜好不同，用 In contrast 引出对比。

exercises.q: The first movie was exciting. ______, the second one was boring.
exercises.explain: exciting 与 boring 形成对比，选 In contrast。

exercises.q: The city center is always busy. ______, the suburbs are quiet and peaceful.
exercises.explain: busy 与 quiet 形成对比，句首用 In contrast 引出差异。

exercises.q: Cats are usually independent. ______, dogs often need more attention from their owners.
exercises.explain: 猫和狗的性格差异用 In contrast 引出。

exercises.q: The old road is narrow and dangerous. ______, the new highway is wide and safe.
exercises.explain: 新旧道路特点相反，用 In contrast 表示对比。

exercises.q: In the sentence 'In contrast, 5G promises gigabit speeds', the phrase 'In contrast' is used to show a similarity between two things.
exercises.explain: In contrast 表示对比差异，不是相似性。

exercises.q: The phrase 'In contrast' is usually placed at the beginning of a sentence and followed by a comma.
exercises.explain: In contrast 通常位于句首，后面加逗号。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'In contrast': The old phone is slow. The new phone is very fast.
exercises.answer: The old phone is slow. In contrast, the new phone is very fast.
exercises.explain: 用 In contrast 连接两个对比的句子，注意句首位置和逗号。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'In contrast': Winter in Beijing is cold. Summer in Beijing is hot.
exercises.answer: Winter in Beijing is cold. In contrast, summer in Beijing is hot.
exercises.explain: 冷热对比，用 In contrast 引出第二句。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'In contrast': The first book is easy to read. The second book is difficult.
exercises.answer: The first book is easy to read. In contrast, the second book is difficult.
exercises.explain: easy 与 difficult 对比，用 In contrast 连接。

exercises.q: The company's traditional business model relied on physical stores. ______, its new strategy prioritizes e-commerce and digital platforms.
exercises.explain: 传统模式与新策略形成对比，用 In contrast 引出。

exercises.q: While the first study emphasized the economic benefits of urbanization, the second study, ______, highlighted its environmental costs.
exercises.explain: 两项研究侧重点相反，用 in contrast 表示对比。

exercises.q: The author's earlier works were characterized by optimism and hope. ______, her later novels reveal a deep sense of disillusionment.
exercises.explain: 早期乐观与后期幻灭形成对比，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: Conventional batteries require several hours to recharge fully. ______, the newly developed graphene batteries can reach full capacity in minutes.
exercises.explain: 传统电池与新型电池充电时间差异巨大，用 In contrast。

exercises.q: The first theory assumes that human behavior is largely determined by genetics. ______, the second theory emphasizes the role of environmental factors.
exercises.explain: 两种理论观点相反，用 In contrast 引出第二种理论。

exercises.q: The initial draft of the report was vague and poorly organized. ______, the final version was concise and logically structured.
exercises.explain: 初稿与终稿质量对比，用 In contrast 引出。

exercises.q: The first approach to solving the problem proved costly and inefficient. ______, the alternative method was both economical and highly effective.
exercises.explain: 两种方法效果对比，用 In contrast 引出。

exercises.q: The phrase 'In contrast' can be used interchangeably with 'However' in all contexts without any change in nuance.

exercises.q: When 'In contrast' is placed at the beginning of a sentence, it is typically followed by a comma.

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'In contrast': The first policy led to a significant increase in employment. The second policy resulted in widespread job losses.
exercises.answer: The first policy led to a significant increase in employment. In contrast, the second policy resulted in widespread job losses.
exercises.explain: 两项政策结果相反，用 In contrast 连接。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'In contrast': The original design was complex and difficult to manufacture. The revised design is simple and cost-effective.
exercises.answer: The original design was complex and difficult to manufacture. In contrast, the revised design is simple and cost-effective.
exercises.explain: 原设计与修改后设计对比，用 In contrast 引出。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using 'In contrast': The first hypothesis predicted a positive correlation between the variables. The second hypothesis predicted a negative correlation.
exercises.answer: The first hypothesis predicted a positive correlation between the variables. In contrast, the second hypothesis predicted a negative correlation.
exercises.explain: 两个假设预测方向相反，用 In contrast 连接。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The first experiment demonstrated a clear causal relationship. In contrast, the second experiment confirmed the same causal relationship.
exercises.answer: The first experiment demonstrated a clear causal relationship. Similarly, the second experiment confirmed the same causal relationship.

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: The initial findings suggested that the drug was ineffective. In contrast, further analysis revealed that it was even less effective than a placebo.
exercises.answer: The initial findings suggested that the drug was ineffective. Moreover, further analysis revealed that it was even less effective than a placebo.
exercises.explain: 进一步分析是递进关系，不是对比关系，应用 Moreover。

grammar.key: Present Perfect for Unfinished Time / Experience
grammar.title: 现在完成时：未完成时间与经历（含 yet / ever / never / before / already）
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect for Unfinished Time and Experience
grammar.usage:
现在完成时由“have/has + 过去分词”构成，核心功能之一是把过去发生的动作或状态与现在联系起来。本讲重点掌握两类高频用法：一是“未完成时间”，即动作从过去持续或延续到现在，常与 yet、already、so far、up to now、recently 等连用，表示“到说话时为止尚未发生或已经发生”；二是“经历”，即谈论某人一生中到目前为止是否有过某种经历，常与 ever、never、before、once、twice 等连用。

肯定句结构为“主语 + have/has + 过去分词”，否定句在 have/has 后加 not，疑问句把 have/has 提到主语前。例如：She has already seen that film. / He hasn't replied yet. / Have you ever tried VR glasses? 注意 have/has 常与主语缩略为 've / 's，否定缩略为 haven't / hasn't。

与一般过去时的对比是高中阶段的重点：一般过去时只陈述过去某一具体时间发生的动作，常与 yesterday、last week、in 2019、two days ago 等明确的过去时间状语连用；而现在完成时强调动作对现在的影响或与现在的联系，不与具体过去时间连用。例如“I lost my key yesterday.”只说明昨天丢了钥匙；“I have lost my key.”则强调现在钥匙仍然找不到。

初中阶段通常只要求掌握 have/has + 过去分词的基本形式以及 yet、ever、never 的简单搭配；高中阶段则进一步要求区分现在完成时与一般过去时、现在完成进行时的语用差异，理解“未完成时间”与“已完成动作”的边界，并能在科技、新闻、议论等书面语体中准确使用 yet to do、have yet to break into 等较正式结构。

易错点一：yet 在否定句和疑问句中通常置于句末，但也可放在否定词之后、过去分词之前，如 have not yet broken into，这种语序更正式，常见于书面语。易错点二：already 多用于肯定句，yet 多用于否定句和疑问句，但在表示“惊讶”的疑问句中也可用 already，如 Have you finished already? 易错点三：have been to 表示“去过某地（已回来）”，have gone to 表示“去了某地（尚未回来）”，两者不可混淆。易错点四：现在完成时不能与 yesterday、last year 等明确的过去时间状语连用，但可与 today、this week、this month 等尚未结束的时间段连用。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + have/has + 过去分词（+ 时间状语）
否定句：主语 + have/has + not + 过去分词（+ yet）
疑问句：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词（+ ever/yet）?
have/has + yet + 过去分词（正式书面语序，用于否定句）
have/has + been to + 地点（表示“去过某地”）
have/has + gone to + 地点（表示“去了某地”）
notes: yet 放在否定词后、过去分词前（如 have not yet broken into）是较正式的书面语序，高考阅读和写作中常见，不要误认为语序错误。
ever 多用于疑问句表示“曾经”，never 用于否定句表示“从未”，两者都常与现在完成时搭配谈论人生经历。
have been to 与 have gone to 含义不同：前者表示“去过已回”，后者表示“去了未回”，高考单选和完形填空常考。
现在完成时不能与 yesterday、last night、in 2020 等已结束的过去时间连用，但可与 today、this year、so far 等包含现在的时间段连用。
书面语中 have yet to do 相当于 haven't done yet，但语气更正式，常见于议论文和新闻报道，如 The technology has yet to reach the mass market.

examples.cn: 增强现实眼镜尚未成为主流，但技术正在迅速进步。

examples.cn: 该公司尚未就数据泄露事件发布官方声明。
