examples.cn: 虚拟现实技术从未以如此前所未有的速度发展过。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework yet.
exercises.explain: yet 用于现在完成时否定句，表示“还没有完成”。

exercises.q: ______ you ever ______ to Beijing?
exercises.explain: ever 常与现在完成时连用，询问“曾经是否去过”。

exercises.q: She has ______ seen that film.
exercises.explain: already 用于现在完成时肯定句，表示“已经”。

exercises.q: My brother ______ his key. He can't open the door.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时强调过去动作对现在的影响——钥匙丢了，现在开不了门。

exercises.q: They ______ in this city since 2018.
exercises.explain: since 2018 表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: We ______ (not see) the new teacher yet.
exercises.explain: yet 提示用现在完成时否定形式。

exercises.q: ______ he ______ (finish) his work?
exercises.explain: 现在完成时疑问句结构：Has + 主语 + 过去分词。

exercises.q: I have ______ (read) this book twice.
exercises.explain: read 的过去分词与原形相同，twice 表示经历。

exercises.q: He has gone to Shanghai yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是具体过去时间，应用一般过去时，不能用现在完成时。

exercises.q: Have you ever eaten sushi?
exercises.explain: ever 与现在完成时连用询问经历，句子结构正确。

exercises.q: I have finished my homework. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定在 have/has 后加 not。

exercises.q: She has visited the Great Wall. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Has she visited the Great Wall?
exercises.explain: 现在完成时疑问句将 have/has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: They have already had lunch. (改为否定句，用 yet)
exercises.explain: already 用于肯定句，否定句中改为 yet 并置于句末。

exercises.q: I have saw this movie before.
exercises.answer: I have seen this movie before.
exercises.explain: see 的过去分词是 seen，不是 saw。

exercises.q: She don't have finished her work yet.
exercises.answer: She hasn't finished her work yet.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定用 has not，而不是 don't。

exercises.q: I ______ my keys. Can you help me find them?
exercises.explain: 强调过去丢钥匙对现在的影响——现在找不到。

exercises.q: He ______ in this school for three years.
exercises.explain: for three years 表示持续到现在的时间段，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: ______ you ______ the news yet?
exercises.explain: yet 用于现在完成时疑问句，询问是否已经听说。

exercises.q: She has ______ been to Japan twice.
exercises.explain: already 用于肯定句表示“已经”，twice 强调经历次数。

exercises.q: The train ______. We can board now.
exercises.explain: 火车已到，强调对现在的影响——可以上车了。

exercises.q: So far, we ______ (learn) about 500 English words.
exercises.explain: so far 表示“到目前为止”，常与现在完成时连用。

exercises.q: It's the first time I ______ (be) to Shanghai.
exercises.explain: It's the first time 后用现在完成时表示经历。

exercises.q: She ______ (not reply) to my email yet.
exercises.explain: yet 提示现在完成时否定，主语为第三人称单数用 has。

exercises.q: I have met him last week.
exercises.explain: last week 是具体过去时间，应用一般过去时。

exercises.q: She has never tried Indian food before.
exercises.explain: never 与现在完成时连用表示“从未有过某经历”，句子正确。

exercises.q: He bought this phone two years ago. (用现在完成时改写，强调他拥有这部手机两年了)
exercises.answer: He has had this phone for two years.
exercises.explain: buy 是非延续性动词，不能与 for 连用，需改为 have。

exercises.q: I have never been to Beijing. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Have you ever been to Beijing?
exercises.explain: 否定句中的 never 在疑问句中改为 ever。

exercises.q: She has already finished the report. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: She hasn't finished the report yet.
exercises.explain: 肯定句中的 already 在否定句中改为 yet。

exercises.q: They have went to the library.
exercises.answer: They have gone to the library.
exercises.explain: go 的过去分词是 gone，不是 went。

exercises.q: I have lived here since five years.
exercises.answer: I have lived here for five years.
exercises.explain: since 后接时间点，for 后接时间段。

exercises.q: By the time we arrived, the film ______ for ten minutes.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间，主句用过去完成时，且 be on 表状态。

exercises.q: This is the most interesting book I ______.
exercises.explain: This is the most... 后用现在完成时表示“至今为止的经历”。

exercises.q: He ______ in the company since he graduated from college.
exercises.explain: since 引导时间状语从句，主句用现在完成时表示持续。

exercises.q: I ______ my passport. I can't find it anywhere.
exercises.explain: 强调护照丢失对现在的影响——现在找不到。

exercises.q: It is the second time that he ______ the exam.
exercises.explain: It is the second time 后用现在完成时表示“这是第几次做某事”。

exercises.q: Great changes ______ (take place) in our city over the past ten years.
exercises.explain: over the past ten years 表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She is the first student who ______ (win) the prize twice.
exercises.explain: the first...who 后用现在完成时表示“第一个做到某事的人”。

exercises.q: I ______ (know) him since we were in primary school.
exercises.explain: know 是延续性动词，与 since 连用表示从过去持续到现在。

exercises.q: He has gone to Beijing three times.
exercises.explain: has gone to 表示“去了某地未回来”，不能与次数连用，应改为 has been to。

exercises.q: I have been knowing him for ten years.
exercises.explain: know 是状态动词，本身表持续，不用进行时态，应说 have known。

exercises.q: He joined the army three years ago. (用现在完成时改写，强调他参军三年了)
exercises.answer: He has been in the army for three years.
exercises.explain: join 是非延续性动词，不能与 for 连用，需改为 be in。

exercises.q: I have never seen such a beautiful sunset before. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Have you ever seen such a beautiful sunset before?
exercises.explain: never 在疑问句中改为 ever，have 提前。

exercises.q: She has already told me the truth. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: She hasn't told me the truth yet.
exercises.explain: already 在否定句中改为 yet，has 后加 not。

exercises.q: The new technology has not yet broke into the mainstream.
exercises.answer: The new technology has not yet broken into the mainstream.
exercises.explain: break 的过去分词是 broken，不是 broke。

exercises.q: I have finished my homework just now.
exercises.answer: I finished my homework just now.
exercises.explain: just now 是具体过去时间，应用一般过去时。

exercises.q: I ______ my homework yet. Please give me ten more minutes.
exercises.explain: yet 用于否定句时，常与现在完成时连用，表示到现在为止还未完成。

exercises.q: She has ______ been to Beijing three times. She loves that city.
exercises.explain: already 用于肯定句中，表示“已经”，强调经历。

exercises.q: ______ you ever ______ a virtual reality headset?
exercises.explain: 询问“是否曾经做过某事”用现在完成时，结构为 Have + 主语 + 过去分词。

exercises.q: My brother ______ his key, so he can't open the door now.
exercises.explain: 强调过去丢钥匙对现在造成的影响（现在开不了门），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: They ______ in this city since 2018.
exercises.explain: since 引导的时间状语常与现在完成时连用，表示从过去持续到现在的状态。

exercises.q: We ______ (not see) that new film yet.
exercises.explain: yet 提示用现在完成时的否定形式，结构为 haven't + 过去分词。

exercises.q: ______ you ever ______ (eat) sushi?
exercises.explain: 询问经历用现在完成时疑问句，结构为 Have + 主语 + 过去分词。

exercises.q: He ______ (already / finish) his homework, so he can play games.
exercises.explain: already 在现在完成时中常放在 have/has 与过去分词之间。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have seen him yesterday" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是具体的过去时间，不能与现在完成时连用，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.q: The sentence "She hasn't called me yet" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: yet 用于现在完成时否定句句末，表示“还没有”，结构正确。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence into negative: I have finished my homework.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定形式在 have/has 后加 not，缩写为 haven't/hasn't。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence into a question: She has visited the museum.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时疑问句将 have/has 提到主语前。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "yet": He hasn't arrived. (Use "yet" at the end)
exercises.explain: yet 通常放在现在完成时否定句的句末，表示“还（没有）”。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: I have went to the library.
exercises.answer: I have gone to the library.
exercises.explain: go 的过去分词是 gone，不是 went。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: She don't have finished her work yet.
exercises.answer: She hasn't finished her work yet.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定形式用 has not (hasn't) + 过去分词，不能用 don't。

exercises.q: By the time we arrived at the cinema, the film ______ already ______.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间状语从句时，主句用过去完成时，表示“在到达之前电影已开始”。

exercises.q: This is the first time I ______ such a beautiful sunset.
exercises.explain: This is the first time 句型中，从句用现在完成时，表示“到目前为止第一次”。

exercises.q: He ______ in London for five years, but he still can't speak English well.
exercises.explain: for five years 表示持续到现在的状态，用现在完成时。

exercises.q: I ______ my phone. I can't find it anywhere.
exercises.explain: 强调过去丢手机对现在的影响（现在找不到），用现在完成时。

exercises.q: She ______ to the new shopping mall twice since it opened.
exercises.explain: since 引导的时间状语从句常与现在完成时连用，表示从过去到现在的经历。

exercises.q: The children ______ (not / clean) their room yet, so they can't go out to play.
exercises.explain: yet 提示用现在完成时否定式，结构为 haven't + 过去分词。

exercises.q: How many times ______ you ______ (be) to Shanghai?
exercises.explain: 询问经历次数用现在完成时，结构为 have + 主语 + been to。

exercises.q: She ______ (just / return) from her trip to Japan.
exercises.explain: just 在现在完成时中表示“刚刚”，放在 have/has 与过去分词之间。

exercises.q: The sentence "He has gone to Beijing last week" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: last week 是具体的过去时间，不能与现在完成时连用，应改为一般过去时。

exercises.q: The sentence "I have known her since we were children" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: since 引导的时间状语从句与现在完成时连用，表示从过去持续到现在的状态。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "since": I started learning English in 2019. I still learn English now.
exercises.explain: since 后接过去时间点，主句用现在完成时，表示从过去持续到现在的动作。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "for": She moved to this city three years ago. She still lives here.
exercises.answer: She has lived in this city for three years.
exercises.explain: for 后接时间段，主句用现在完成时，表示动作持续的时间长度。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence into a negative question: You have finished your project.
exercises.explain: 现在完成时否定疑问句将 haven't/hasn't 提到主语前，表示惊讶或确认。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: They have never went to a concert before.
exercises.answer: They have never been to a concert before.
exercises.explain: go 的过去分词是 gone/been，表示“去过”用 been to，不能用 went。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: I have finished my homework yesterday.
exercises.explain: yesterday 是具体的过去时间，应用一般过去时，不能用现在完成时。

exercises.q: By the end of next month, she ______ in this company for ten years.
exercises.explain: by the end of next month 表示将来某一时间点之前完成的动作，用将来完成时。

exercises.q: It is the third time that he ______ the same mistake.
exercises.explain: It is the + 序数词 + time 句型中，从句用现在完成时，表示“到目前第几次做某事”。

exercises.q: Hardly ______ the station when the train left.
exercises.explain: Hardly...when 句型中，hardly 置于句首时主句用过去完成时且部分倒装。

exercises.q: The new technology ______ into the mainstream yet, despite years of development.
exercises.explain: yet 与现在完成时连用，表示“尚未”，强调从过去到现在仍未发生。

exercises.q: I would rather you ______ about this to anyone until we have more evidence.
exercises.explain: would rather 后的从句用虚拟语气，表示现在或将来的愿望时用一般过去时。

exercises.q: Not until he took off his sunglasses ______ I ______ (recognize) him.
exercises.explain: Not until 置于句首时，主句用部分倒装，结构为 did + 主语 + 动词原形。

exercises.q: By the time the police arrived, the thief ______ (already / escape).
exercises.explain: by the time 引导过去时间状语从句时，主句用过去完成时，表示“在警察到达之前小偷已逃跑”。

exercises.q: It's high time that we ______ (take) action to protect the environment.
exercises.explain: It's high time that 句型中，从句用一般过去时表示虚拟语气，意为“早该做某事了”。

exercises.q: The sentence "She has been writing the report for three hours and hasn't finished it yet" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: has been writing 是现在完成进行时，与 hasn't finished 的现在完成时并列，结构正确。

exercises.q: The sentence "If I have known about the meeting, I would have attended it" is grammatically correct.
exercises.explain: 与过去事实相反的虚拟条件句应用过去完成时，应改为 If I had known。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using inversion: I had no sooner fallen asleep than the phone rang.
exercises.answer: No sooner had I fallen asleep than the phone rang.
exercises.explain: No sooner 置于句首时，主句用过去完成时且部分倒装。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "not until": He didn't realize his mistake until he saw the results.
exercises.answer: Not until he saw the results did he realize his mistake.
exercises.explain: Not until 置于句首时，主句用部分倒装，结构为 did + 主语 + 动词原形。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "by the time": She will finish the project. Then the deadline will arrive.
exercises.answer: She will have finished the project by the time the deadline arrives.
exercises.explain: by the time 引导时间状语从句时，主句用将来完成时，表示在将来某一时间点之前完成。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: Scarcely had he finished speaking than the audience burst into applause.
exercises.answer: Scarcely had he finished speaking when the audience burst into applause.
exercises.explain: Scarcely...when 是固定搭配，不能用 than，than 用于 no sooner...than 句型。

exercises.q: Find and correct the error: It is the first time that he has ever been accused of such a crime, hasn't he?
exercises.answer: It is the first time that he has ever been accused of such a crime, isn't it?
exercises.explain: 反意疑问句的主语应与主句主语 It 一致，助动词用 isn't，而不是 hasn't。

grammar.title: 情态动词被动语态：could / can / may / might / must / should + be + 过去分词
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice with Modal Verbs: could / can / may / might / must / should + be + past participle
grammar.usage:
情态动词被动语态用于表达“某事可以被做、可能被做、必须被做”等含义，核心结构为：情态动词 + be + 过去分词（V3）。其中情态动词承担时态、语气和情态意义，be 保持不变，过去分词表示被动动作。

肯定句结构为“主语 + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词”，如：The work can be done quickly. 否定句在情态动词后加 not，如：The work cannot be done quickly. 一般疑问句将情态动词提到句首，如：Can the work be done quickly? 特殊疑问句则在疑问词后接情态动词，如：How can the work be done quickly?

与主动语态相比，情态动词被动语态把焦点放在动作的承受者上，而不是执行者上。主动句“We could replace these devices”强调“我们”这个执行者；被动句“These devices could be replaced”则强调“这些设备”会怎样。当执行者不重要、不可知或显而易见时，用被动语态更自然。若需要说明执行者，用“by + 执行者”引出，如：These devices could be replaced by our smartphones.

初中阶段主要掌握 can / must / should + be + 过去分词的基本用法，理解“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”这一结构即可。高中阶段则需进一步掌握 could / might / may 表示“可能性”的被动用法，并能在书面表达中灵活运用情态动词被动语态来表达推测、建议、要求等语气。同时，高中还要求能准确区分“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”与“情态动词 + have been + 过去分词”的区别：前者表示现在或将来的被动可能性，后者表示对过去情况的被动推测，如：The letter could have been sent to the wrong address.

易错点一：情态动词后的 be 不能随主语人称和数变化，始终用原形 be，不可写成 is / am / are / was / were。易错点二：过去分词必须使用正确的形式，不规则动词的过去分词要单独记忆，如 replace → replaced，但 write → written，break → broken。易错点三：否定形式中 not 的位置在情态动词之后、be 之前，如 could not be replaced，不可写成 could be not replaced。易错点四：不要混淆“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”和“情态动词 + 动词原形”的主动形式，如“The door can open”表示门自己能开，而“The door can be opened”表示门可以被打开，两者含义不同。
forms: 肯定句：主语 + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词（V3）
否定句：主语 + 情态动词 + not + be + 过去分词（V3）
一般疑问句：情态动词 + 主语 + be + 过去分词（V3）？
特殊疑问句：疑问词 + 情态动词 + 主语 + be + 过去分词（V3）？
含执行者：主语 + 情态动词 + be + 过去分词 + by + 执行者
过去推测：主语 + 情态动词 + have been + 过去分词（V3）
notes: 情态动词后的 be 永远用原形，不受主语人称和数的影响，高考书面表达中常见错误是写成 is / are / was / were。
could 在被动语态中既可表示过去的能力，也可表示现在或将来的可能性，具体含义需结合语境判断，高考阅读理解中常考这种歧义。
“情态动词 + have been + 过去分词”表示对过去情况的被动推测，与“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”的现在/将来含义不同，高考语法填空和短文改错中经常涉及。
书面语中，当执行者不重要或不想指明时，直接用情态动词被动语态，不必强行加 by 短语，否则会显得啰嗦。
注意区分“情态动词 + be + 形容词”和“情态动词 + be + 过去分词”：前者是系表结构，后者是被动语态，判断依据是过去分词是否表示动作。

examples.en: The homework must be handed in before class.
examples.cn: 作业必须在课前上交。

examples.en: This song can be sung by everyone in our class.
examples.cn: 这首歌我们班每个人都会唱。

examples.en: The broken window should be repaired as soon as possible.
examples.cn: 那扇破窗户应该尽快修好。

examples.en: These old buildings may be pulled down to make room for a new park.
examples.cn: 这些旧建筑可能会被拆除，以腾出地方建一个新公园。

examples.en: The data could be accessed remotely, which made the system vulnerable to attacks.
examples.cn: 这些数据可以被远程访问，这使得系统容易受到攻击。

examples.en: Had the safety guidelines been followed, the accident might have been avoided.
examples.cn: 如果当时遵守了安全准则，这场事故或许本可以避免。

exercises.q: The window ______ by the wind last night.
exercises.explain: 主语window是动作的承受者，情态动词被动结构为could be + 过去分词。

exercises.q: This old house ______ many years ago.
exercises.explain: 被动结构需用be + 过去分词，build的过去分词是built。

exercises.q: The homework ______ by the students tomorrow.
exercises.explain: 情态动词will后接be + 过去分词构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The song ______ by everyone in our class.
exercises.explain: 主语song是动作承受者，can后接be + 过去分词sung。

exercises.q: These books ______ to the library next week.
exercises.explain: books与return是被动关系，情态动词被动结构为could be + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The letter ______ ______ ______ (send) by email.
exercises.explain: 情态动词could后接be + 过去分词sent构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The room ______ ______ ______ (clean) by my mother every day.
exercises.explain: can后接be + 过去分词cleaned，表示"能够被清洁"。

exercises.q: The cake ______ ______ ______ (make) by my sister yesterday.
exercises.explain: could be + 过去分词made构成被动语态，表示过去可能被做。

exercises.q: The sentence "The door could be opened by Tom" means Tom opened the door.
exercises.explain: 被动语态表示门被Tom打开，但could表示可能性，不一定是事实。

exercises.q: In the sentence "The car could be repaired", the car is the doer of the action.
exercises.explain: car是动作的承受者，不是执行者，所以是被动语态。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in passive voice: People could see the stars clearly.
exercises.answer: The stars could be seen clearly.
exercises.explain: 主动语态转被动语态，宾语stars变主语，谓语用could be + 过去分词seen。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in active voice: The ball could be thrown by John.
exercises.explain: 被动转主动，主语John执行动作，谓语用could + 动词原形throw。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in passive voice: We can finish the work today.
exercises.answer: The work can be finished today.
exercises.explain: 主动转被动，宾语work变主语，can后接be + 过去分词finished。

exercises.q: The letter could be write by Mary.
exercises.answer: The letter could be written by Mary.
exercises.explain: write的过去分词是written，被动结构需用could be written。

exercises.q: The room can cleaned by the students.
exercises.answer: The room can be cleaned by the students.
exercises.explain: 情态动词can后缺少be，被动结构应为can be + 过去分词。

exercises.q: The old bridge ______ by the workers next month.
exercises.explain: 情态动词may后接be + 过去分词repaired构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The problem ______ by the teacher in class yesterday.
exercises.explain: might be + 过去分词explained构成被动语态，表示过去可能被解释。

exercises.q: These trees ______ by the students last spring.
exercises.explain: trees与plant是被动关系，could be + 过去分词planted。

exercises.q: The message ______ to all the parents soon.
exercises.explain: will be + 过去分词sent构成一般将来时被动语态。

exercises.q: The broken bike ______ by my father yesterday.
exercises.explain: bike与fix是被动关系，could be + 过去分词fixed。

exercises.q: The new library ______ ______ ______ (open) next year.
exercises.explain: will be + 过去分词opened构成一般将来时被动语态。

exercises.q: The homework ______ ______ ______ (must finish) before Friday.
exercises.explain: must be + 过去分词finished构成被动语态，表示必须被完成。

exercises.q: The lost dog ______ ______ ______ (might find) by the police.
exercises.explain: might be + 过去分词found构成被动语态，find的过去分词是found。

exercises.q: The sentence "The work could be done by him" means he definitely did the work.
exercises.explain: could表示可能性，不是确定的事实，所以不能理解为"他一定做了"。

exercises.q: In the passive sentence "The cake was eaten by the dog", the dog is the agent.
exercises.explain: by the dog是动作的执行者，即agent，在被动语态中表示动作来源。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in passive voice: Someone might steal your bike if you leave it unlocked.
exercises.answer: Your bike might be stolen if it is left unlocked.
exercises.explain: 主动转被动，宾语bike变主语，might be + 过去分词stolen。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in active voice: The letter could be written by the manager.
exercises.answer: The manager could write the letter.
exercises.explain: 被动转主动，by后的manager变主语，谓语用could + 动词原形write。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in passive voice: They can solve the problem easily.
exercises.answer: The problem can be solved easily.
exercises.explain: 主动转被动，宾语problem变主语，can be + 过去分词solved。

exercises.q: The windows could be break by the strong wind.
exercises.answer: The windows could be broken by the strong wind.
exercises.explain: break的过去分词是broken，被动结构需用could be broken。

exercises.q: The report must be write by the end of this week.
exercises.answer: The report must be written by the end of this week.
exercises.explain: write的过去分词是written，must be + 过去分词构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The ancient temple, which dates back to the Tang Dynasty, ______ by the government to preserve its historical value.
exercises.explain: temple与restore是被动关系，情态动词被动结构为could be + 过去分词restored。

exercises.q: The results of the experiment ______ before the conference begins.
exercises.explain: results与announce是被动关系，must be + 过去分词announced。

exercises.q: The endangered species ______ if immediate action is not taken.
exercises.explain: species与wipe out是被动关系，might be + 过去分词wiped构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The confidential documents ______ to unauthorized personnel under any circumstances.
exercises.explain: documents与show是被动关系，must not be + 过去分词shown表示禁止被展示。

exercises.q: The old factory, which has been abandoned for years, ______ into a modern art museum.
exercises.explain: factory与transform是被动关系，could be + 过去分词transformed。

exercises.q: The proposal ______ ______ ______ (should submit) to the committee before the deadline.
exercises.explain: should be + 过去分词submitted构成被动语态，表示应该被提交。

exercises.q: The historical documents ______ ______ ______ (might destroy) in the fire if they hadn't been moved.
exercises.explain: 对过去情况的推测用might have been + 过去分词destroyed，表示可能已经被毁。

exercises.q: The new policy ______ ______ ______ (can implement) by the local government next year.
exercises.explain: can be + 过去分词implemented构成被动语态，表示能够被实施。

exercises.q: In the sentence "The project could have been completed by the team", the completion definitely happened.
exercises.explain: could have been表示过去可能完成但实际未完成，不是确定的事实。

exercises.q: The passive structure "modal + be + past participle" can be used with any modal verb including could, might, and must.
exercises.explain: 情态动词被动结构适用于所有情态动词，形式为情态动词 + be + 过去分词。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in passive voice: The committee might have rejected the proposal due to budget constraints.
exercises.answer: The proposal might have been rejected by the committee due to budget constraints.
exercises.explain: 主动转被动，might have been + 过去分词rejected构成过去推测的被动语态。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in active voice: The ancient manuscripts could have been translated by the scholars.
exercises.answer: The scholars could have translated the ancient manuscripts.
exercises.explain: 被动转主动，by后的scholars变主语，谓语用could have + 过去分词translated。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in passive voice: They should have informed the residents about the power outage.
exercises.answer: The residents should have been informed about the power outage.
exercises.explain: 主动转被动，should have been + 过去分词informed构成过去本应被通知的被动语态。

exercises.q: The data could have been analyze by the researchers if they had more time.
exercises.answer: The data could have been analyzed by the researchers if they had more time.
exercises.explain: analyze的过去分词是analyzed，被动结构需用could have been analyzed。

exercises.q: The safety regulations must be strictly observe by all employees.
exercises.answer: The safety regulations must be strictly observed by all employees.
exercises.explain: observe的过去分词是observed，must be + 过去分词构成被动语态。

exercises.q: The old photos ______ by my grandmother many years ago.
exercises.explain: 主语 photos 是动作的承受者，需用被动语态 could be + 过去分词 taken。

exercises.q: This broken chair ______ by my father tomorrow.
exercises.explain: 情态动词被动结构为 can be + 过去分词，主语 chair 承受 repair 的动作。

exercises.q: The message ______ in English so that everyone can understand it.
exercises.explain: message 与 write 是被动关系，情态动词后用 be + 过去分词 written。

exercises.q: These old buildings ______ down next year to make room for a new park.
exercises.explain: buildings 承受 pull down 的动作，might be + 过去分词表示可能被拆除。

exercises.q: The homework ______ before Friday, or you will lose points.
exercises.explain: homework 与 hand in 是被动关系，should be + 过去分词 handed。

exercises.q: The window is broken. It ______ be ______ (repair) as soon as possible.
exercises.explain: 情态动词被动结构：should be + 过去分词 repaired。

exercises.q: These books ______ be ______ (return) to the library by next Monday.
exercises.explain: must be + 过去分词 returned 表示必须被归还。

exercises.q: The letter ______ be ______ (send) by email, so you don't need to print it.
exercises.explain: can be + 过去分词 sent 表示可以被发送。

exercises.q: The cake could be made by my sister yesterday.
exercises.explain: cake 承受 make 的动作，could be made 是被动结构，语法正确。

exercises.q: The song can be sing by the whole class.
exercises.explain: sing 的过去分词是 sung，应改为 can be sung。

exercises.q: People can grow rice in this area. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: Rice can be grown in this area.
exercises.explain: 主动语态转被动：主语 rice + can be + 过去分词 grown。

exercises.q: The room should be cleaned every day. (改为主动语态)
exercises.answer: Someone/We should clean the room every day.
exercises.explain: 被动转主动需补充主语，谓语用 should clean。

exercises.q: They might cancel the meeting because of the storm. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The meeting might be cancelled because of the storm.
exercises.explain: meeting 承受 cancel 的动作，might be + 过去分词 cancelled。

exercises.q: The dishes can be wash by the machine.
exercises.answer: The dishes can be washed by the machine.
exercises.explain: wash 的过去分词是 washed，被动结构需用过去分词。

exercises.q: This problem could be solve by the students themselves.
exercises.answer: This problem could be solved by the students themselves.
exercises.explain: solve 的过去分词是 solved，情态动词被动需用过去分词。

exercises.q: The ancient temple ______ by the earthquake, but fortunately it survived.
exercises.explain: could have been + 过去分词表示过去可能被摧毁但实际未发生，temple 承受动作。

exercises.q: The final decision ______ until all the members have expressed their opinions.
exercises.explain: decision 与 make 是被动关系，否定形式为 should not be made。

exercises.q: These rare animals ______ by law, so hunting them is illegal.
exercises.explain: animals 承受 protect 的动作，must be + 过去分词表示必须被保护。

exercises.q: The new bridge ______ by the end of next year, according to the plan.
exercises.explain: bridge 与 complete 是被动关系，will be + 过去分词表示将来被完成。

exercises.q: The secret ______ to anyone outside the company under any circumstances.
exercises.explain: secret 承受 tell 的动作，must not be + 过去分词表示禁止被泄露。

exercises.q: The results of the experiment ______ be ______ (announce) at the conference next week.
exercises.explain: will be + 过去分词 announced 表示将来被宣布。

exercises.q: These old machines ______ be ______ (replace) by more efficient ones in the near future.
exercises.explain: could be + 过去分词 replaced 表示可能被替换，与课文结构一致。

exercises.q: The injured player ______ be ______ (carry) off the field by two teammates.
exercises.explain: had to be + 过去分词 carried 表示过去不得不被抬走。

exercises.q: The documents might have been lost during the move, but luckily they were found.
exercises.explain: might have been lost 表示过去可能被丢失，documents 承受动作，结构正确。

exercises.q: The rules of the game should be explain to all players before it starts.
exercises.explain: explain 的过去分词是 explained，应改为 should be explained。

exercises.q: The company will launch the new product next month. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The new product will be launched by the company next month.
exercises.explain: product 承受 launch 的动作，will be + 过去分词 launched。

exercises.q: The homework must be finished before class. (改为主动语态)
exercises.answer: Students must finish the homework before class.
exercises.explain: 被动转主动需补充主语，谓语用 must finish。

exercises.q: They could not finish the project on time because of the delay. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The project could not be finished on time because of the delay.
exercises.explain: project 承受 finish 的动作，could not be + 过去分词 finished。

exercises.q: The old building might be tear down to build a shopping mall.
exercises.answer: The old building might be torn down to build a shopping mall.
exercises.explain: tear 的过去分词是 torn，被动结构需用 torn down。

exercises.q: These files can be access by all employees in the company.
exercises.answer: These files can be accessed by all employees in the company.
exercises.explain: access 的过去分词是 accessed，情态动词被动需用过去分词。

exercises.q: Had the evidence been presented earlier, the defendant ______ differently.
exercises.explain: 虚拟语气中 defendant 承受 judge 的动作，might have been + 过去分词表示过去可能被判决。

exercises.q: The proposal, once ______ by the committee, will be sent to the board for final approval.
exercises.explain: once + 过去分词作条件状语，proposal 与 review 是被动关系，省略了 it is。

exercises.q: The ancient manuscripts ______ for centuries before they were finally discovered in the cave.
exercises.explain: must have been + 过去分词表示对过去被隐藏的肯定推测，manuscripts 承受动作。

exercises.q: The controversial policy ______ by the government unless public opinion changes dramatically.
exercises.explain: be unlikely to be + 过去分词表示不太可能被采纳，policy 承受 adopt 的动作。

exercises.q: The data collected from the survey ______ before any conclusions can be drawn.
exercises.explain: data 承受 analyze 的动作，need to be + 过去分词表示需要被分析。

exercises.q: The controversial decision ______ have ______ (make) without consulting the stakeholders, which caused widespread criticism.
exercises.explain: should not have been + 过去分词表示过去本不该被做出，decision 承受动作。

exercises.q: The endangered species ______ be ______ (protect) by stricter laws if we want to prevent its extinction.
exercises.explain: must be + 过去分词 protected 表示必须被保护，species 承受动作。

exercises.q: The confidential files ______ have ______ (access) by unauthorized personnel, which triggered a security investigation.
exercises.explain: may have been + 过去分词表示过去可能被访问，files 承受 access 的动作。

exercises.q: The theory, having been widely accepted for decades, is now being challenged by new evidence.
exercises.explain: having been accepted 是完成被动式作状语，theory 承受 accept 的动作，结构正确。

exercises.q: The new regulations are expected to be fully implemented by the time the next fiscal year begins.
exercises.explain: are expected to be implemented 是被动结构，regulations 承受 implement 的动作。

exercises.q: The committee is said to have rejected the proposal. (改为被动语态，保持原意)
exercises.answer: The proposal is said to have been rejected by the committee.
exercises.explain: proposal 承受 reject 的动作，is said to have been rejected 是复合被动结构。

exercises.q: People believe that the ancient city was destroyed by a massive earthquake. (改为被动语态，保持原意)
exercises.answer: The ancient city is believed to have been destroyed by a massive earthquake.
exercises.explain: is believed to have been destroyed 是复合被动结构，city 承受 destroy 的动作。

exercises.q: The manager should have informed the staff about the changes. (改为被动语态)
exercises.answer: The staff should have been informed about the changes by the manager.
exercises.explain: staff 承受 inform 的动作，should have been informed 表示过去本应被通知。

exercises.q: The new software is reported to have been being tested for several months before its official release.
exercises.answer: The new software is reported to have been tested for several months before its official release.
exercises.explain: have been being tested 结构冗余，应改为 have been tested 表示被动完成。

exercises.q: The ancient artifacts, which were believed to be stolen from the museum, were found in a private collection.
exercises.answer: The ancient artifacts, which were believed to have been stolen from the museum, were found in a private collection.
exercises.explain: 偷窃发生在 believed 之前，需用 to have been stolen 表示先于主句动作的被动。
